Admiral Maxton Price is a senior officer in the Federal Navy who emerged as one of the principal military commanders during the Thargoid Titan War. In April 3308, he was selected to coordinate the Federal defense when Thargoid fleets invaded the Sosong system, part of a simultaneous three-pronged assault on superpower core systems that placed over ten billion lives at risk.

Price became a vocal proponent of Salvation's anti-xeno strategy, arguing that the superweapon was indispensable for ending the Thargoid conflict. In June 3308, he defended the superpowers' continued collaboration with Azimuth Biotech despite revelations of its INRA past, stating bluntly: "Without Salvation's superweapon, we will be locked in conflict with the Thargoids forever." He also commanded the Federal response to the Taranis rogue signal source in late 3308, ordering civilian vessels to avoid the Hyades Sector FB-N b7-6 system while military forces monitored the anomaly's arrival.

magnolia-gill.name: Magnolia Gill
magnolia-gill.bio: Magnolia Gill is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-03-21 to 3305-03-21. Closely associated with Deep Space Surveys.

rici-stewart.name: Rici Stewart
rici-stewart.bio: Rici Stewart is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-09-09 to 3303-09-09. Closely associated with Imperial Herald.

august-lord.name: August Lord
august-lord.bio: August Lord is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-06 to 3304-09-06. Closely associated with Mars Tribune. The Mars Tribune reveals that actor Tomas Turai, husband of Jupiter Rochester, has been conducting a three-year extramarital affair with Olympian athlete Reagan Lord. Turai and August Lord (Reagan's husband) both announce plans to sue the Tribune for defamation.

theodore-sullivan.name: Theodore Sullivan
theodore-sullivan.bio: Theodore Sullivan is a ceo in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-06-10 to 3307-06-10. Closely associated with Core Dynamics, Pilots Federation.

kommodore.name: Kommodore
kommodore.bio: Kommodore is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-04 to 3301-10-04. Closely associated with Core Dynamics, Universal Cartographics. Commander Kommodore returned from a ten-month journey to Sagittarius A* in an Eagle-class starship, cataloguing nearly 3,900 star systems and earning 123 million credits from Universal Cartographics.

djtruthsayer.name: DJTruthsayer
djtruthsayer.bio: DJTruthsayer is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club.

jeong-hui-shin.name: Jeong-Hui Shin
jeong-hui-shin.bio: A senior researcher at the Holloway Bioscience Institute, Dr Jeong-Hui Shin offered provocative theories about Thargoid consciousness and biomechanical immune responses.
jeong-hui-shin.bio_full:
Dr Jeong-Hui Shin of the Holloway Bioscience Institute entered the public debate on Thargoid behaviour in September 3308, after the aliens' startling resistance to the Proteus Wave in HIP 22460. Speaking via the Rewired network, she challenged assumptions that the Thargoids were consciously adapting to human tactics, proposing instead that their vessels might function as biomechanical "antibodies" responding automatically to what they perceived as a virulent infection.

Her perspective carried unsettling implications: if humanity registered as little more than a parasite in Thargoid biology, diplomatic solutions might be impossible. Shin's commentary, alongside competing theories from Olympus Village University and the Imperial Science Academy, highlighted how little was truly understood about Thargoid cognition — and how dangerous that ignorance remained.

pierre-marc-pelletier.name: Pierre-Marc Pelletier
pierre-marc-pelletier.bio: Pierre-Marc Pelletier is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3310-01-22 to 3310-10-31.

jacob-morales.name: Jacob Morales
jacob-morales.bio: Jacob Morales is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-05-21 to 3308-01-31. Affiliated with Aegis. Notable activities include: The Alexandria megaship jumps from Delphi to HIP 16538, triggering a Thargoid attack.; The Federal Navy warns the Alexandria megaship not to enter any Federal system.
jacob-morales.bio_full:
Captain Jacob Morales is the commanding officer of the Alexandria, an Aegis-owned megaship that vanished in hyperspace in June 3307 with over four thousand crewmembers aboard. The Alexandria was transporting a large quantity of Guardian artefacts from the Delphi system when it triggered a Thargoid attack in HIP 16538 on 20 May 3307.

To reduce the risk of further casualties, Aegis plotted a route to a low-population prison colony in the HIP 30944 system. All independent ships were undocked before the megaship made its hyperspace jump on 3 June 3307, but the Alexandria never reached its destination and all communication ceased. Admiral Aden Tanner announced that Captain Morales and his crew would be listed as missing presumed dead, noting that "in addition to this great tragedy, Aegis's research programme into Guardian technology has been severely impacted by the loss of many precious artefacts." Morales's disappearance became a turning point for Aegis, triggering a superpower inquiry, forcing senior resignations including Professor Alba Tesreau, and creating a vacuum that Salvation's alternative anti-xeno effort rapidly began to fill.

commander-santander.name: Commander Santander
commander-santander.bio: Commander Santander is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-23 to 3302-02-23. Closely associated with Fuel Rats. Commander Santander discovers two occupied escape pods on a rocky-ice body near the NGC 1333 nebula, over 1,000 light years from the nearest starport. The crash site was visible from high altitude, and Santander investigated in his SRV before recovering the pods in his Asp Explorer.

harald-gomes.name: Harald Gomes
harald-gomes.bio: Harald Gomes is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3311-04-10 to 3311-04-25. Closely associated with Dhan Empire League.

jed-trager.name: Jed Trager
jed-trager.bio: Jed Trager is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-13 to 3309-03-07. Closely associated with Alliance Defence Force. Council member Jed Trager calls it an egregious transgression.

simone-leatrix.name: Simone Leatrix
simone-leatrix.bio: Simone Leatrix is an Imperial socialite who organised festive campaigns and charitable initiatives during the holiday season in 3304. Her events drew attention from across the Empire and helped raise supplies for various causes.
simone-leatrix.bio_full: Simone Leatrix is an Imperial socialite known for organising high-profile festive campaigns and charitable initiatives. In December 3304, she coordinated holiday season events that drew participants from across the Empire, using her social connections to rally support for various causes. Her campaigns became a fixture of the Imperial social calendar during that period, demonstrating how aristocratic networks could be mobilised for charitable purposes. Leatrix's activities reflected the Empire's tradition of using public displays of generosity to reinforce social hierarchies.

lord-corwin-ryan.name: Lord Corwin Ryan
lord-corwin-ryan.bio: Lord Corwin Ryan is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-18 to 3302-02-18. Closely associated with Navigators Guild.

vaarwen-mako-brennus.name: Vaarwen Mako Brennus
vaarwen-mako-brennus.bio: Vaarwen Mako Brennus is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-16 to 3301-07-24. Closely associated with Hammer Arms, Cosmic State, Emperor's Grace. Grimnir Allvadderung and Vaarwen Mako Brennus met in Rishair to announce the development, though the announcement was overshadowed by news of Emperor Hengist Duval's wedding.

donal-varden.name: Donal Varden
donal-varden.bio: Donal Varden is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-11-01 to 3304-11-10. Closely associated with Ndozins State Inc, Geras First. Journalist Donal Varden describes the aftermath as an uneasy peace that came at a dreadful cost. Independent journalist Donal Varden predicts the space lanes will soon be littered with wreckage.
donal-varden.bio_full:
Donal Varden established himself as an independent journalist operating during the politically volatile period of late 3304, maintaining connections to both Ndozins State Inc and Geras First that provided access to diverse regional perspectives. His reporting focused on the aftermath of military conflicts and power transitions, offering analysis that challenged official narratives promoted by factional leadership. The independence of his journalism allowed him to document the human costs of political manoeuvring in ways that aligned media outlets could not or would not pursue.

Varden's commentary during this period captured the uneasy nature of post-conflict stability, describing peace that had been achieved at dreadful cost and predicting that competition in contested space lanes would produce widespread destruction. His assessments proved prescient as tensions continued to simmer beneath superficial calms. Through his work, Varden demonstrated how independent journalists could serve as crucial witnesses to historical moments, preserving accounts that might otherwise be sanitised by interests seeking to control public memory of controversial events.

macklin-fox.name: Macklin Fox
macklin-fox.bio: Macklin Fox is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-08-29 to 3305-09-05. Closely associated with Sap Core Legion.

devenish.name: Devenish
devenish.bio: Devenish is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-19 to 3301-10-19. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Alliance, Alliance News Network.

ursula-torquatus.name: Ursula Torquatus
ursula-torquatus.bio: Ursula Torquatus is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-02-21 to 3308-02-21. Closely associated with NMLA, Nova Imperium.

ray-miller.name: Ray Miller
ray-miller.bio: Ray Miller is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-09-01 to 3302-09-02. Closely associated with United Research Council.

stent-jackson.name: Stent Jackson
stent-jackson.bio: Stent Jackson is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3310-05-03 to 3310-05-03.

nicolas-st-clauss.name: Nicolas St Clauss
nicolas-st-clauss.bio: Nicolas St Clauss is the chief executive officer of Clauss Incorporated, a galaxy-wide distributor of luxury commodities. In late 3301 he launched a festive community appeal calling on independent pilots to transport Special Gifts from Frost Dock in Njambalba to Clauss Port in Santa Muerte.
nicolas-st-clauss.bio_full:
Nicolas St Clauss leads Clauss Incorporated, a corporation specialising in the distribution of luxury goods across inhabited space. In December 3301, he issued a public appeal for Special Gifts, asking independent pilots to transport the commodities from Frost Dock in the Njambalba system to Clauss Port in Santa Muerte, offering generous financial incentives and free ships to novice contributors.

The appeal concluded successfully after hundreds of pilots answered the call, delivering the requested goods and receiving both payment and vessels. St Clauss thanked participants for helping spread joy throughout the galaxy, and the campaign became a notable example of how corporate seasonal initiatives could mobilise the independent pilot community.

richard-morgan.name: Richard Morgan
richard-morgan.bio: Richard Morgan is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-19 to 3301-07-19. Admiral Richard Morgan assembled a fleet at Beta Hydri to invade Achenar after it refused to join the Federation.

oksana-ambrose.name: Oksana Ambrose
oksana-ambrose.bio: Baroness Oksana Ambrose is the head of the Ambrose Foundation, a multi-billion credit noble institution involved in corporate investment and charity work. In February 3305 she oversaw the foundation's collapse after its entire fortune was liquidated and transferred to anonymous accounts, and subsequently hired the Wallglass Investigations Agency to locate her missing daughter.
oksana-ambrose.bio_full:
Baroness Oksana Ambrose presided over the Ambrose Foundation, a centuries-old institution that combined the wealth of multiple royal and noble houses and managed nearly three hundred billion credits in assets. In February 3305, the foundation lost its entire fortune overnight when its holdings were liquidated and transferred to anonymous accounts scattered across the galaxy, leaving the organisation effectively ruined.

Ambrose publicly stated her belief that her daughter, Lady Talitha Ambrose, had been kidnapped and tortured into surrendering authorisation codes for the family inheritance. Using the foundation's last emergency reserves, she hired the Wallglass Investigations Agency to locate and rescue Talitha, while the disappearance triggered widespread speculation about whether the heiress had been abducted or had orchestrated the loss herself.

cmdr-red-wizzard.name: CMDR Red Wizzard
cmdr-red-wizzard.bio: CMDR Red Wizzard is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-04 to 3301-05-04. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Canonn. CMDR Red Wizzard recovered the artefact, though the entire convoy perished.

bjorn-lennox.name: Bjorn Lennox
bjorn-lennox.bio: The owner of a Diamondback Explorer stolen from Fort Dixon in the Vega system in April 3305, Bjorn Lennox became entangled in one of the era's most puzzling criminal cases.
bjorn-lennox.bio_full:
In April 3305, Commander Bjorn Lennox reported his Diamondback Explorer stolen from a sealed hangar bay at Fort Dixon in the Vega system — a theft that appeared impossible given the station's security protocols. The case baffled investigators until starship technician Gan Romero was identified as the culprit, though the explanation only deepened the mystery.

When the official investigation was suspended without resolution, Lennox offered a haunting speculation: Romero may have been called to "a place that most people can't understand." The remark referenced encrypted dream journals recovered from Romero's quarters, in which he described radiant alien spaces and disembodied voices. Lennox's willingness to entertain explanations beyond conventional criminal psychology transformed him from a victim of theft into an inadvertent witness to one of the earliest documented cases of potential telepathic alien contact.

mirana-ortilano.name: Mirana Ortilano
mirana-ortilano.bio: Mirana Ortilano is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-23 to 3301-04-23. Closely associated with Buckyball Run. Spokesperson Mirana Ortilano explained the finish line's significance as the centre of the Milky Way.

great-gig.name: Great Gig
great-gig.bio: Great Gig is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-29 to 3301-07-29. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Lavigny's Legion.

timothy-culver.name: Timothy Culver
timothy-culver.bio: Timothy Culver is a peace activist who has criticised superpower leadership for their handling of the Thargoid conflict. He has spoken at rallies arguing that humanity's aggressive stance toward the Thargoids is counterproductive and that diplomatic alternatives should be pursued.
timothy-culver.bio_full: Timothy Culver is a prominent peace activist who has become a vocal critic of superpower military policy toward the Thargoids. In early 3309, he spoke at rallies blaming leaders for escalating the Thargoid war, arguing that humanity's aggressive stance was counterproductive. Culver has advocated for diplomatic alternatives to military confrontation, challenging the consensus that the Thargoids are an existential threat that can only be met with force. His activism has drawn both support from those weary of the war and criticism from those who view his position as naive in the face of proven Thargoid hostility.

aden-tanner.name: Aden Tanner
aden-tanner.bio: Admiral Aden Tanner is a senior Federal Navy officer who served as Aegis's chief military liaison from 3303 to 3308. He coordinated anti-xeno operations and commanded the Aegis Defence megaship Musashi. Tanner became one of Salvation's most vocal critics, correctly suspecting that Salvation was deliberately provoking Thargoid attacks. In November 3307, he committed mutiny by commandeering the Musashi to seize Salvation's headquarters at Hind Mine. Defeated by pilots supporting Salvation and court-martialed, his trial was suspended after Ram Tah provided evidence vindicating his suspicions about Salvation's Guardian-derived superweapons.
aden-tanner.bio_full:
Aden Tanner was one of the most experienced naval commanders in the Federation before his appointment as Aegis's chief military liaison in 3303. As Chief of Federal Security, he had overseen counter-intelligence operations across Federal space — experience that proved valuable when the superpowers were forced to cooperate against the Thargoid threat.

In Aegis, Tanner coordinated military responses to incursions, directed defence deployments, and commanded the megaship Musashi. While Tesreau focused on scientific research, Tanner handled the military reality — organising evacuations, defending Pleiades outposts, and planning counter-offensives.

Tanner was among the first senior officers to distrust Salvation, suspecting that the Cornsar "demonstration" had been staged by deliberately luring Thargoids using Guardian artefacts. When official channels failed, he commandeered the Musashi in November 3307 and launched an unauthorised attack on Hind Mine, Salvation's headquarters. Forces loyal to Salvation overwhelmed his task force, and Tanner was detained and court-martialed for mutiny.

The trial was suspended after Ram Tah provided evidence that Salvation's superweapons contained Guardian components derived from the Proteus site — vindicating Tanner's suspicions. Yet the political momentum behind Salvation ensured he remained sidelined and Aegis was dissolved. His career exemplifies the dilemma of honourable officers in dishonourable times.

kayla-shah.name: Kayla Shah
kayla-shah.bio: Kayla Shah is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-11-11 to 3304-11-11. Closely associated with Bonespire Publishing. Bonespire suggests he is avoiding a multi-million credit contract violation fine, while literary critic Kayla Shah speculates about obsessed fans.

dev-venkatesh.name: Dev Venkatesh
dev-venkatesh.bio: Dev Venkatesh is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-08-17 to 3309-08-31. Closely associated with Holloway Bioscience Institute.

missing.name: Missing
missing.bio: Missing is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-03-25 to 3307-03-25. Closely associated with NMLA, Imperial Internal Security Service, Marlinist.

olav-redcourt.name: Olav Redcourt
olav-redcourt.bio: Olav Redcourt is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-07-05 to 3304-11-17. Affiliated with Bonespire Publishing, Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the foiled assassination attempt on Aisling Duval, Riri McAllister being shot during her trial, the FIA investigation into ...; Weekly summary covering the mercenary incursion against Ram Tah's Phoenix Base in Meene, the FSS suspension of Lieutenant Inspector Ramesh Thorne, ...
olav-redcourt.bio_full:
Olav Redcourt is a celebrated author known for his swashbuckling historical romance series featuring the Corsair King. In July 3304, he began an interstellar book tour for his fourteenth novel, "Corsair King and the Storm of Desire," visiting over fifty destinations throughout the core systems. During the tour, he made increasingly erratic comments to reporters, including "bounced across space like a damn human pinball" and "nothing but meat for the sausage factory."

Redcourt abandoned the tour in August 3304 and was later reported missing, sparking concern among fans and his publisher, Bonespire Publishing. He was found alive in November 3304 at a remote writers' retreat on the Rhea Archipelago, where he was working on a new science fiction novel. His agent, Margot Hist, explained that she had been unaware of the concern because she was on holiday and there were no communication facilities at Skyglow Havens. Redcourt's pivot to science fiction disappointed fans of the Corsair King series but highlighted the pressures facing commercial authors in the galactic publishing industry.

stana-chapple.name: Stana Chapple
stana-chapple.bio: Stana Chapple is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-11-02 to 3301-11-02.

virgil-kyle.name: Virgil Kyle
virgil-kyle.bio: Virgil Kyle is an explorer and commander of the Asp 'Spirit of Indianapolis'. In March 3301, he claimed to be the first to visit what he called Sol's 'true North Star' at Wregoe TV-L C24-0, over 1,200 light-years north of Sol's position in the galactic plane.
virgil-kyle.bio_full: Virgil Kyle is an explorer best known for his March 3301 discovery of what he termed Sol's "true North Star." Commanding the exploration-fitted Asp Explorer named Spirit of Indianapolis, Kyle reached Wregoe TV-L C24-0—a system over 1,200 light-years "north" of Sol's position in the galactic plane. Due to the extreme jump distances involved, the system was only reachable by Asps and Anacondas fitted for near-maximum jump ranges. Kyle described the view of the Milky Way from the system as "spectacular" and invited other suitably equipped explorers to visit. While modest about the achievement, his discovery became a popular destination for explorers seeking unique galactic perspectives.

commander-noodlz05.name: Commander Noodlz05
commander-noodlz05.bio: Commander Noodlz05 is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-02-13 to 3303-02-13. Commander Noodlz05 and wingmates are specifically thanked for their contributions.

barr-winters.name: Barr Winters
barr-winters.bio: Barr Winters is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-11-11 to 3303-11-11. Closely associated with Aegis, Faulcon DeLacy. Engineer Barr Winters confirmed the AX1 replaces default utility and small hardpoints with two AX multi-cannons, which are slightly more powerful than standard.

duke-alden-rowe.name: Duke Alden Rowe
duke-alden-rowe.bio: Duke Alden Rowe is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-23 to 3302-04-23. Closely associated with Imperial Navy.

cmdr-bunny.name: CMDR Bunny
cmdr-bunny.bio: CMDR Bunny is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-15 to 3301-04-15. CMDR Bunny, the route's spokesperson, stated the organisation would provide protection to traders and has arranged patrols with the Federal Navy, Mercs of Mikunn, Merchant Marines and other factions.

v-patau.name: V Patau
v-patau.bio: V Patau is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-04 to 3302-11-04. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

flint-firemaker-lafosse.name: Flint 'Firemaker' Lafosse
flint-firemaker-lafosse.bio: Flint 'Firemaker' Lafosse is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-12-28 to 3307-08-20. Closely associated with Alliance, Sirius Corporation, Sirius Atmospherics. Independent journalist Flint 'Firemaker' Lafosse begins broadcasting Kit Fowler's conspiracy show End Times on the Rewired network, linking Black Flight crimes to Thargoid cover-ups.

commander-ranmust.name: Commander Ranmust
commander-ranmust.bio: Commander Ranmust is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-20 to 3301-03-20. President Halsey honoured Federal commanders who made the greatest contributions to the Lugh war effort. Commander Nightwulf removed almost 14,000 enemy combatants.

james-speakes.name: James Speakes
james-speakes.bio: James Speakes is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-09 to 3301-05-09.

alba-tesreau.name: Alba Tesreau
alba-tesreau.bio: Professor Alba Tesreau is a leading xenologist and founding scientific director of Aegis. She championed a research-first approach to the Thargoid threat, achieving breakthroughs in anti-xeno weaponry and Guardian technology integration. Forced to resign in 3307 after the Alexandria disaster, she became one of Salvation's most prominent critics — exposing his identity as Dr. Caleb Wycherley and organising the search that located the Alexandria's wreckage, proving Azimuth sabotage.
alba-tesreau.bio_full:
Professor Alba Tesreau was the preeminent scientific voice in humanity's response to the Second Thargoid War. As head of the Achenar Research Council, she possessed unparalleled expertise in xenology — the study of alien life — and was the natural choice to lead Aegis's scientific division when the organisation was formed in August 3303.

Tesreau's approach to the Thargoid threat was methodical and collaborative. She established research outposts across the Pleiades Nebula, directed studies of Thargoid barnacles and meta-alloys, and oversaw the development of the first effective anti-xeno missiles and shutdown field neutralisers. Her preference for understanding the Thargoids rather than simply destroying them put her at odds with militarists in all three superpowers, but her scientific achievements were undeniable. Aegis's research into meta-alloys proved crucial for repairing stations damaged in Thargoid attacks, and her team's work on Guardian technology integration provided pilots with powerful new tools against the alien threat.

The Alexandria disaster shattered both Aegis and Tesreau's career. In 3307, the Aegis megaship Alexandria vanished with 4,000 crew and a cargo of Guardian artefacts. The superpowers ordered an independent inquiry, and the Baumann Report — completed in January 3308 — recommended Aegis's dissolution. Tesreau was forced to resign in August 3307, along with Director Yazhu Xing and Dr. Mia Valencourt. The report criticised her for focusing on Thargoid communication research rather than developing new generations of AX weaponry, and for organisational complacency.

Tesreau refused to accept the narrative that Aegis was solely responsible for the Alexandria's loss. Operating independently, she received a tip about drifting objects sighted outside the Core Systems and organised a search by independent pilots. In January 3308, the Alexandria's wreckage was located in Wregoe TC-X b29-0. Captain Morales's logs revealed that the ship had been sabotaged and raided by Azimuth Biochemicals operatives working for "The Witch" — not destroyed by Thargoids as officially claimed. This discovery vindicated Tesreau and exposed a conspiracy that the superpowers had been unwilling to investigate.

Following Aegis's dissolution, Tesreau became one of Salvation's most determined adversaries. In May 3308, she revealed the location of INRA base Iraxon Lane, where logs confirmed that Salvation was Dr. Caleb Wycherley, former vice-president of Azimuth Biochemicals and a contributor to the mycoid bioweapon. She exposed his role in the Alexandria sabotage and his manipulation of the superpowers through Project Seraph. These revelations were dismissed by Salvation's supporters and ignored by politicians who had become dependent on his superweapons, but Tesreau's investigative work provided the definitive account of Salvation's true nature.

Tesreau's legacy is that of a scientist who refused to abandon principle even when it cost her position, reputation, and institutional support. Her research saved countless lives during the Thargoid conflicts, and her investigative work exposed one of the most dangerous figures in modern galactic history.

kahina-loren.name: Kahina Loren
kahina-loren.bio: A former Imperial senator from Prism whose dramatic fall from grace and secret identity as Salomé made her one of the most controversial figures in Imperial politics.
kahina-loren.bio_full:
Few Imperial careers ended as spectacularly as that of Lady Kahina Loren, the senator from Prism who was stripped of her rank and title in late 3302 after being implicated in an assassination attempt on Senator Denton Patreus. Her trial was preceded by a now-famous televised exchange with Princess Aisling Duval, in which Loren dismissed the charges as a setup and retorted to Duval's attacks with withering contempt.

Behind her public persona, Loren was also known as Salomé, a figure revered by the secretive Children of Raxxla. The group's claim of responsibility for violent acts carried out in her name, and their reference to her by this alias, fuelled speculation that her political downfall was connected to far deeper mysteries surrounding Raxxla and Imperial power structures.

blake-fry.name: Blake Fry
blake-fry.bio: Blake Fry is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-23 to 3301-10-23. Closely associated with Federal Times.

ulrich-maurer.name: Ulrich Maurer
ulrich-maurer.bio: Ulrich Maurer is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-10-26 to 3309-11-01.
ulrich-maurer.bio_full:
Ulrich Maurer became briefly prominent during late 3309, a period of significant upheaval across multiple superpowers and independent territories. Though details of his specific role remain sparse, his emergence in GalNet records during this narrow window suggests involvement in events that captured galactic attention at a critical historical juncture. The timing of his activity placed him against a backdrop of ongoing Thargoid conflicts, political realignments, and corporate manoeuvring that characterised the era.

His limited documentation reflects the reality that countless individuals contribute to galactic events without achieving sustained prominence in public records. Maurer may have operated as an intermediary, an official, or an independent actor whose actions briefly intersected with newsworthy developments before receding from view. His entry in the historical record serves as a reminder that the galaxy's narrative comprises not only celebrated figures but also transient participants whose contributions, however brief, form part of the larger tapestry.

jast-fernandez.name: Jast Fernández
jast-fernandez.bio: Jast Fernández is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-04-13 to 3304-04-28. Closely associated with Aegis, Alliance. Editor Jast Fernández suggested the killer was motivated by the discovery of Commander Jameson’s ship logs proving the INRA manipulated and sacrificed him. Media editor Jast Fernández speculated that Aisling may be maturing politically or revealing a genuine critical faculty beneath her public persona.

professor-melville.name: Professor Melville
professor-melville.bio: Professor Melville is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-02-10 to 3303-02-10. Personal logs surface from a clandestine expedition led by Professor Melville to find Guardian relics. The logs reveal discoveries of multiple site clusters and Melville's growing obsession, ending with a distress call.

hillbillypolenta.name: Hillbillypolenta
hillbillypolenta.bio: Hillbillypolenta is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-01-12 to 3303-01-12. Closely associated with Fuel Rats.

lady-kahina-tijani-loren.name: Lady Kahina Tijani Loren
lady-kahina-tijani-loren.bio: Lady Kahina Tijani Loren is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-13 to 3302-08-19. Closely associated with Imperial Citizen, Reclamists, Children of Raxxla. The Imperial Citizen published a two-part editorial alleging that Commander Salomé is actually Lady Kahina Tijani Loren, the missing Imperial senator from the Prism system.

tyber-de-maat.name: Tyber de Maat
tyber-de-maat.bio: Tyber de Maat is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with Emperor's Dawn, Interstellar Press.

surprise.name: Surprise
surprise.bio: Surprise is a ceo in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-03-05 to 3307-03-05. Closely associated with Core Dynamics.

commander-mad-billy.name: Commander Mad Billy
commander-mad-billy.bio: Commander Mad Billy is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-17 to 3302-11-26. Closely associated with FGE exploration wings, Fuel Rats. Commander Chiggy Vonrictofen conducted a dramatic rescue of Commander Felix Macedonica, who was stranded 65,000 light years from home without sufficient germanium to synthesise an FSD injection.

first-apostle-of-the-true-chapters.name: First Apostle of the True Chapters
first-apostle-of-the-true-chapters.bio: First Apostle of the True Chapters is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-03-23 to 3309-03-23. Closely associated with Aegis.

marlin-duval.name: Marlin Duval
marlin-duval.bio: Marlin Duval is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-07-12 to 3307-03-19. Affiliated with Federation. Notable activities include: Historian Sima Kalhana covers the Empire's founding.; Historian Sima Kalhana covers the first Federation-Achenar war (2323-2325).
marlin-duval.bio_full:
Marlin Duval was a wealthy expedition leader who founded the Achenar colony in the mid-23rd century and established the democratic principles that would eventually transform into the Empire. Disillusioned by the rigid governments and stifling social conformity of Earth, she led a convoy across unexplored space to the Achenar system, where settlers discovered Capitol — a habitable world already home to one of the few known sentient species in the galaxy.

Under Marlin's leadership, the colony lived under idealistic democratic rule with elected Senators representing the people. Tragically, she died in a speeder crash, after which her brother Henson Duval assumed control and established the imperial succession that continues to this day. The extinction of Capitol's native species — caused inadvertently by imported bacteria — was later used by the Federation as a pretext to invade Achenar in 2324. The colony's successful resistance cemented the birth of the Empire as humanity's second great power, though it was Henson rather than Marlin who shaped the autocratic system that replaced her democratic vision.

marquis-endincite.name: Marquis Endincite
marquis-endincite.bio: Marquis Endincite is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-02 to 3302-07-02. Closely associated with Facece Empire Party, Allied Facece Order, Imperial Herald. Marquis Endincite coordinated the effort, while Chancellor Anders Blaine is reportedly preparing to commend those involved.

trinity-avon.name: Trinity Avon
trinity-avon.bio: Trinity Avon is a reporter for The Sovereign who covered the Dangerous Games in 3302. She reported on the competition between five major factions seeking recognition as official powers, including the Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps and the Interstellar Communist Union.
trinity-avon.bio_full:
Trinity Avon established herself as one of *The Sovereign*'s most visible reporters during the Dangerous Games of 3302, a semi-official competition that determined which rising faction would join the galaxy's major powers. When five established factions — the Alliance Elite Diplomatic Corps, Border Coalition, GalCop, Interstellar Communist Union, and Social Eleu Progressive Party — announced they would compete for official recognition, Avon broke the story and explained how smaller factions could fight their way into the contest through a series of Wildcard events.

Her reporting followed the competition through its conclusion, including the EG Pilots' surprise victory in the Wildcard and their subsequent entry into the main tournament. Avon's commentary captured the drama of an unprecedented political experiment: 'Each faction has enjoyed its share of success, but ultimately there could be only one winner.' Her coverage demonstrated how independent media could shape public understanding of emerging power structures long before the superpowers acknowledged their significance.

fightingcookie.name: FightingCookie
fightingcookie.bio: FightingCookie is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-01-12 to 3303-01-12. Closely associated with Fuel Rats.

yazhu-xing.name: Yazhu Xing
yazhu-xing.bio: Yazhu Xing is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-08-11 to 3308-10-03. Closely associated with Aegis.

marcus-macmillan.name: Marcus Macmillan
marcus-macmillan.bio: Marcus Macmillan is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-07-24 to 3301-08-03. Affiliated with Imperial Senate. Notable activities include: Political commentator Marcus Macmillan profiles Princess Aisling Duval.; Political commentator Marcus Macmillan profiles Senator Arissa Lavigny-Duval.
marcus-macmillan.bio_full:
Marcus Macmillan is a political commentator who wrote a series of GalNet profiles in mid-3301 examining the major political figures of the era. His articles profiled Princess Aisling Duval, Senator Arissa Lavigny-Duval, President Zachary Hudson, Senator Denton Patreus, Prime Minister Edmund Mahon, Shadow President Felicia Winters, Senator Zemina Torval and CEO Li Yong-Rui, offering readers insight into their backgrounds, political platforms and succession prospects.

Macmillan's profiles were notable for their balanced analysis of Imperial politics, describing Aisling Duval as a populist reformer whose compassion stemmed from personal tragedy, while portraying Arissa Lavigny-Duval as a senator who preferred to be judged by her achievements rather than her royal bloodline. His work established him as one of the most-read political commentators in the galaxy during the critical succession period following Emperor Hengist Duval's declining health.

commander-ashley-wilkinson.name: Commander Ashley Wilkinson
commander-ashley-wilkinson.bio: Commander Ashley Wilkinson is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-10-22 to 3302-10-22. Closely associated with Earth Defence Fleet, Canonn, Sirius Corporation.

governor-deacon.name: Governor Deacon
governor-deacon.bio: Governor Deacon is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-26 to 3301-10-26. Closely associated with Homeland Scientific Council.

kioko-mcgrath.name: Kioko McGrath
kioko-mcgrath.bio: Kioko McGrath is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-01-01 to 3305-02-14. Closely associated with Federal Times, Federal Security Service.

commander-chiggy-vonrictofen.name: Commander Chiggy Vonrictofen
commander-chiggy-vonrictofen.bio: Commander Chiggy Vonrictofen is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-26 to 3302-11-26. Closely associated with Institute for Galactic Exploration and Research. Commander Chiggy Vonrictofen conducted a dramatic rescue of Commander Felix Macedonica, who was stranded 65,000 light years from home without sufficient germanium to synthesise an FSD injection. Chiggy traveled to Colonia, fitted a mining laser, and crossed 30,000 light years to reach Felix within 48 hours.

sofia-trevino.name: Sofia Trevino
sofia-trevino.bio: Sofia Trevino is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-07-21 to 3311-01-09. Affiliated with Federal Times. Notable activities include: The three presidential candidates ramp up campaigns for the delayed August election, with media coverage focusing on character over policy and the ...; President Hudson agrees to deport Far God cultists to the Alliance, framing it as pragmatic cost-cutting while the Dedicant is prepared for transport.
sofia-trevino.bio_full:
Sofia Trevino is a political journalist for The Federal Times who has covered the major political upheavals of the late 3300s. In September 3307, she reported extensively on the wave of Federal faction secessions triggered by the Proactive Detection Bureau surveillance programme, documenting how minor factions across the Federation were severing ties with the superpower in protest against government monitoring of private communications.

Trevino's journalism has tracked both the Hudson administration's defence of the PDB and Shadow President Felicia Winters's campaign to repeal the Domestic Counter-Terrorism Act. Her reporting highlighted the political cost of the surveillance programme, noting that while Vice President Jerome Archer dismissed the secessions as inconsequential, the rebellion represented an embarrassment for Republican governance and validated Winters's civil liberties arguments. Trevino remains a prominent voice in Federal political commentary.

marc-garfield.name: Marc Garfield
marc-garfield.bio: Marc Garfield is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-08 to 3301-10-08. Closely associated with Federal Times, Revolutionary Noti Value Party.

leyton-farris.name: Leyton Farris
leyton-farris.bio: Leyton Farris is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-08-16 to 3305-08-16. Closely associated with Alliance.

light-fingers.name: Light Fingers
light-fingers.bio: Light Fingers is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-06-08 to 3301-06-08. Closely associated with Imperial Senate, Imperial Internal Security Service.

important.name: Important
important.bio: Important is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-01-19 to 3307-02-08. Closely associated with Alliance.

general-falkenrath.name: General Falkenrath
general-falkenrath.bio: General Falkenrath is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-10-25 to 3308-10-25. Closely associated with Sirius Corporation.

commander-jak.name: Commander Jak
commander-jak.bio: Commander Jak is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-15 to 3302-03-11. Closely associated with Buckyball Racing Club, Pilots Federation, Grant Academics. Veteran pilots will escort students from the Exigus campus to tourism hotspots in the region from 18-26 March, with Commander Seneh coordinating the event. Event organiser Commander Seneh defends it as community outreach with safety as the priority.

alfred-jeffress.name: Alfred Jeffress
alfred-jeffress.bio: Alfred Jeffress is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-09-22 to 3302-03-29. Notable activities include: Reclusive philanthropist Alfred Jeffress announced a galaxy-wide treasure hunt with a share of his fortune as the prize.; Reclusive philanthropist Alfred Jeffress announced his second galaxy-wide treasure hunt, offering a share of his personal fortune to the winner.
alfred-jeffress.bio_full:
Alfred Jeffress is a reclusive billionaire philanthropist who made his fortune trading rare and exotic goods before spending a decade on an extended galactic tour. Between September 3301 and March 3302, he became known for a series of galaxy-wide treasure hunts in which he hid mystery objects in deep space and offered a share of his vast fortune to whoever found them.

Jeffress's hunts followed a pattern: he released cryptic riddles leading participants across multiple systems. His first hunt concluded in November 3301 with Commander Woodhouse finding time capsules hidden at Slipher Hub in Faust 68, Dickensport in Fomalhaut, and finally the Cernunnos system. He announced a second hunt in December 3301, and a third in March 3302, each promising to be "more challenging" than the last. Though the hunts were ultimately light-hearted community events, they demonstrated how a single wealthy individual could mobilise hundreds of independent pilots across the galaxy.

lord-roland-holloway.name: Lord Roland Holloway
lord-roland-holloway.bio: Lord Roland Holloway is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-11-10 to 3307-11-10. Closely associated with Holloway Bioscience Institute. Independent pilots locate an abandoned Holloway Bioscience research facility in the Snake Sector GW-W c1-1 system after detecting a distress call from a Colonia Bridge megaship.

tomas-turai.name: Tomas Turai
tomas-turai.bio: Tomas Turai is the father of Jordan Rochester's ex-fiancée. The Turai family is a wealthy and influential Federal dynasty with extensive business interests. Their connection to the Rochester family added complexity to the political scandal surrounding Jupiter Rochester's criminal activities.
tomas-turai.bio_full: Tomas Turai is the patriarch of the wealthy Turai family and father of Jordan Rochester's ex-fiancée. The Turai dynasty is one of the Federation's most influential families, with extensive business interests and political connections. Their planned alliance with the Rochester family through marriage would have united two of the Federation's most powerful dynasties. However, the scandal surrounding Jupiter Rochester's criminal activities—including his conspiracy to destroy Starship One—derailed these plans and cast a shadow over both families. The Turai family's subsequent distance from the Rochesters reflected the political cost of association with disgraced figures.

ethan-naylor.name: Ethan Naylor
ethan-naylor.bio: Ethan Naylor is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-17 to 3302-05-14. Congressman Ethan Naylor of Siren was formally sworn in as Federal Vice President in a ceremony on Mars. The appointment is controversial as Naylor is the first frontier-world Congressman to hold Federal leadership.

maddox-hurd.name: Maddox Hurd
maddox-hurd.bio: Maddox Hurd is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-08-17 to 3305-01-03. Affiliated with Herculean Machines, Supratech, Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Maddox Hurd's criminal connections causing investor flight from Herculean Machines, the announcement of Alliance presidenti...; Weekly summary covering Vanya Driscoll's analysis of Alliance presidential candidates, Lloyd Hardacre's arrest after his robot exposed corporate fr...
maddox-hurd.bio_full:
Maddox Hurd is the founder and CEO of Herculean Machines, a technology company that became embroiled in a high-profile rivalry with Supratech over personal computer design in 3304. Hurd's company developed the Duradrive, a robust personal computer that ultimately outperformed Supratech's rival Torc at the Rackham Ultratech Expo, securing corporate funding and market momentum.

Hurd's career faced a significant setback when declassified Federal Security Service records revealed he had accepted financial contributions from individuals connected to organised-crime networks, including the Red Family, when establishing his company five years earlier. Hurd dismissed the revelation as a smear campaign orchestrated by Supratech, and Herculean Machines recovered sufficiently to dominate the expo. His public persona is characterised by aggressive competitiveness and sharp criticism of corporate rivals.

erin-sangster.name: Erin Sangster
erin-sangster.bio: Erin Sangster is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-10-05 to 3304-10-31. Closely associated with Alliance Interpol, Alliance. Inspector Erin Sangster of Alliance Interpol suspects professional assassins. Inspector Erin Sangster officially rules the death a homicide involving sophisticated nerve toxin and professional assassins who circumvented security at Hume Orbital.

milo-castile.name: Milo Castile
milo-castile.bio: Milo Castile is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-08-02 to 3308-04-12. Affiliated with NMLA, Marlinist, Far God cult. Notable activities include: NMLA starport bombings in the Marlinist Colonies kill over 35,000 civilians.; ACT reports major progress against the NMLA, raiding dozens of cells and arresting thousands of paramilitary activists following intelligence from ...
milo-castile.bio_full:
Captain Milo Castile is an officer with the Affiliated Counter-Terrorism unit (ACT) who led the manhunt for Theta Seven, the de facto leader of the NMLA's Theta Group bomb-makers. In November 3307, Castile announced that ACT had acquired an encrypted message that may reveal Theta Seven's location, requesting assistance from the galactic community in decoding it.

Castile explained that while most of Theta Group had been captured while being harboured by Neo-Marlinist sympathisers within the Marlinist Colonies, Theta Seven and his closest aides had fled to an unknown destination. The encrypted message, transmitted on 31st July, had been secured using a pre-arranged cipher key that rendered its contents unreadable without the key. Castile's appeal for public assistance in decoding the message demonstrated both the sophistication of NMLA operational security and the counter-terrorism unit's willingness to leverage independent expertise.

sinclair-faraldo.name: Sinclair Faraldo
sinclair-faraldo.bio: Sinclair Faraldo is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-06-17 to 3307-07-23. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Sirius Corporation. Marketing director Sinclair Faraldo announces the module will have twice the probe coverage of standard scanners. Marketing director Sinclair Faraldo confirms mass production has begun and the module will be available from human technology brokers soon.
sinclair-faraldo.bio_full:
Sinclair Faraldo served as marketing director for a technology division operating within the Pilots Federation and Sirius Corporation networks during mid-3307. His role required translating complex engineering capabilities into compelling value propositions for the independent pilot market, a demographic known for its sophistication and scepticism toward corporate messaging. In June 3307, he announced the development of an advanced scanner module that would deliver twice the probe coverage of standard equipment, positioning the innovation as a significant upgrade for exploration and survey operations.

Faraldo's subsequent confirmation that mass production had begun and that the module would soon be available through human technology brokers demonstrated the rapid development cycles that characterised competitive technology markets in the 3300s. His communications style balanced technical specificity with accessible explanations, reflecting an understanding that pilots required both performance data and practical context to make purchasing decisions. Through his work, Faraldo illustrated how marketing professionals served as critical intermediaries between engineering teams and the independent operators who ultimately determined commercial success in the galactic technology sector.

sarai-messemer.name: Sarai Messemer
sarai-messemer.bio: Sarai Messemer is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-08-02 to 3305-08-02. Closely associated with Alliance, Lave Radio.

dp-sayre.name: DP Sayre
dp-sayre.bio: DP Sayre is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-01-06 to 3303-01-06. Commander DP Sayre reports being interdicted and scanned by a mysterious non-human vessel in the Aries Dark Region XU-O b6-3.

shadewarlock.name: Shadewarlock
shadewarlock.bio: Shadewarlock is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-31 to 3301-07-31. Closely associated with Kumo Crew.

elijah-beck.name: Elijah Beck
elijah-beck.bio: Elijah Beck is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-09-13 to 3308-04-27. Affiliated with Alliance. Notable activities include: The Marlinist Colonies offer to accept political refugees currently dispersed across Alliance territory, with Prime Consul Kayode Tau negotiating t...; Weekly summary covering Maddox Hurd's criminal connections causing investor flight from Herculean Machines, the announcement of Alliance presidenti...
elijah-beck.bio_full:
Elijah Beck is a veteran Alliance politician who served in the Alliance Assembly for over four decades before becoming a presidential candidate in 3304. Hailing from the Leesti system, Beck positioned himself as the experienced alternative to incumbent President Gibson Kincaid and entrepreneur Fazia Silva, though observers noted his long record suggested he was unlikely to bring significant change to the presidency.

After Kincaid's impeachment in 3305 for treason, murder and corruption, Beck played a key role in stabilising Alliance governance. He volunteered to resign from the Assembly to oversee the restructuring of the defunct Office of the Alliance President into a non-political ambassadorial department, following the Assembly's historic vote to permanently abolish the presidential office. Beck's career exemplifies the traditional Alliance emphasis on institutional continuity and cautious reform.

maxine-patro.name: Maxine Patro
maxine-patro.bio: Maxine Patro is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3310-09-03 to 3310-09-03. Closely associated with Sirius Corporation, Utopia, Achilles Aerospace.

cpt_shinobi.name: Cpt_Shinobi
cpt_shinobi.bio: Cpt_Shinobi is a Commander mentioned in GalNet reports from the Elite Dangerous universe.

raan-corsen.name: Raan Corsen
raan-corsen.bio: Raan Corsen is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3302-09-23 to 3303-05-04. Affiliated with MetaDrive Inc.. Notable activities include: A weak signal from the Col 70 Sector has been detected, coinciding with thousands of covert messages.; Commander Salomé (Kahina Tijani Loren) was killed in the Arumclaw system by a bounty hunter known as 'Besieger', while her co-conspirators remain a...
raan-corsen.bio_full:
Raan Corsen is a former MetaDrive Inc. employee who became a notorious fugitive after stealing the Imperial Eagle belonging to the company's late chairman, Femi Dakarai, during an independent audit in late 3302. The ship was later found crashed in the Alioth system, though Corsen himself had disappeared shortly after the theft.

In 3303, Corsen resurfaced as one of three identified perpetrators of the Darnielle's Progress meta-alloy heist, alongside the presumed-dead Senator Kahina Tijani Loren ("Commander Salomé") and former Alliance operative Tsu Annabelle Singh. The Empire placed a galaxy-wide bounty of 500,000 credits on Corsen, advising pilots to "shoot on sight." His involvement in both the MetaDrive audit disappearance and the Salomé conspiracy made him one of the most wanted criminals in the galaxy during 3303.

harlow-nassry.name: Harlow Nassry
harlow-nassry.bio: Harlow Nassry is a technology journalist for the Federal Times who reported on computing innovation, cybercrime and hacktivist groups including the Collective.
harlow-nassry.bio_full:
Harlow Nassry is a technology journalist for the Federal Times who has reported on major developments in computing, cybercrime and corporate innovation. In August 3304, he highlighted two new personal computer designs challenging the Sirius and Achilles Corporation monopoly: Supratech's Torc, a flexible wrist or neck ring using holographic projectors, and Herculean Machines' Duradrive, a durable tablet for rough handling.

Nassry also published an article in October 3304 about the Collective, a mysterious group of anti-authority hacktivists responsible for digital crimes including the theft of a billion credits from Zachary Rackham. His reporting on the Collective revealed that the group believed all information should be publicly available, and that their anarchist ideology made them nearly impossible to investigate due to their lack of leaders or spokespersons.

quade.name: Quade
quade.bio: Quade is a Pirate in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-08-13 to 3301-09-29. Affiliated with Libertas Cooperative, Kumo Crew. Notable activities include: Imperial commanders participating in the United Offensive have rescued scores of marked slaves from Kumo Crew vessels in the Pegasi sector.; Officials at Ocrinox's Orbiter announced plans to build a state-of-the-art resettlement facility for Pegasi Pirate War refugees.
quade.bio_full:
Commander Quade is a Federal pilot who participated in the United Offensive against the Kumo Crew in the Pegasi sector during August 3301. Quade signed his report from the front lines of the Pegasi Pirate War, documenting the Imperial rescue of marked slaves from Kumo Crew vessels and their relocation to safety via Sirius Corporation commanders.

Quade's dispatches highlighted the humanitarian dimension of the conflict, including the case of Aasha, a former Imperial slave and mechanical engineer who was rescued from stasis aboard a pirate vessel in Comanga. His reporting provided rare independent verification of the cooperation between Imperial and Federal forces during one of the largest anti-piracy campaigns of the early 34th century.

mara-chen.name: Mara Chen
mara-chen.bio: Mara Chen is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3312-03-17 to 3312-04-21. Closely associated with Orion University.

casey-murrow.name: Casey Murrow
casey-murrow.bio: Casey Murrow is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-19 to 3301-02-19. Valentine Day Regatta, shared his racing philosophy with Casey Murrow.

aisling-duval.name: Aisling Duval
aisling-duval.bio: Aisling Duval is an Imperial princess known as the "People's Princess," the most prominent progressive voice in Imperial politics. She campaigns against Imperial slavery and narcotics abuse, founding the charity Stop Slavery Stupid (later Unchain) and leading emancipation campaigns that freed over a million slaves. Born out of wedlock to Prince Harold Duval and entertainer Imogen Gabrielini, her exclusion from the succession led her to support half-sister Arissa Lavigny-Duval's accession in 3301. She survived multiple assassination attempts and remains a powerful, if controversial, force in the Imperial court.
aisling-duval.bio_full:
Aisling Duval was born to Prince Harold Duval and entertainer Imogen Gabrielini, who died of a narcotics-induced aneurysm shortly after her birth. When Emperor Hengist decreed Harold "not sound of mind" in December 3300, Aisling was excluded from the succession. She supported her half-sister Arissa Lavigny-Duval's claim rather than contest it.

Despite exclusion from the throne, Aisling built a powerful political following. In 3301, she founded Stop Slavery Stupid and challenged Senator Zemina Torval to a public emancipation contest, freeing over 1.1 million slaves. In 3302 she merged the charity into Unchain, broadening her reform platform. She survived an assassination attempt by Emperor's Dawn and has consistently condemned INRA's experiments on live Thargoids.

Aisling's personal life has generated significant attention, including a brief engagement to Federal Ambassador Jordan Rochester in 3303 — a cross-superpower romance that scandalised traditionalists before its cancellation. Critics dismiss her as naive, yet she has undeniably shifted the Imperial conversation on slavery and social justice, with popularity among common citizens unrivalled by any other Imperial Family member.

olivia-vespera.name: Olivia Vespera
olivia-vespera.bio: Olivia Vespera is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-14 to 3302-05-14. Commander Olivia Vespera, pilot of the Distant Worlds Expedition fleet flagship, remains at Beagle Point prospecting for jumponium materials.

walter-waldo.name: Walter Waldo
walter-waldo.bio: Walter Waldo is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-10-20 to 3303-10-13. Closely associated with Gyvatices Crimson Advanced Holdings, Wonderful Walter's Fish and Coffee Emporium.
walter-waldo.bio_full:
Walter Waldo gained recognition as the proprietor of Wonderful Walter's Fish and Coffee Emporium, an establishment with connections to Gyvatices Crimson Advanced Holdings. Operating during the early 3300s, his business represented the kind of independent commercial venture that flourished in systems with active mining and trade economies. The emporium's unusual combination of seafood and caffeinated beverages suggested a personality willing to blend disparate elements into something uniquely appealing.

Beyond his commercial activities, Waldo became a minor figure of interest within certain corporate circles through his association with Gyvatices Crimson Advanced Holdings. This connection hinted at relationships between seemingly mundane service businesses and the larger corporate networks that controlled resource extraction and distribution. Waldo's story illustrated how individuals running modest enterprises could find themselves linked to far-reaching economic interests simply by operating in the right place at the right time.

marco-qwent.name: Marco Qwent
marco-qwent.bio: Marco Qwent is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-06-16 to 3308-06-16. Closely associated with Alliance, Sirius Corporation.

vernon-trask.name: Vernon Trask
vernon-trask.bio: Vernon Trask is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-18 to 3302-07-18.

torben-rademaker.name: Torben Rademaker
torben-rademaker.bio: Torben Rademaker is a Ceo in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-07-25 to 3310-10-21. Affiliated with Azimuth Biotech, Alliance, Azimuth. Notable activities include: Azimuth Biotech director Torben Rademaker condemns Operation Wych Hunt protestors as alien-loving traitors after Azimuth assets are expelled from M...; Professor Alba Tesreau publishes a counter-statement exposing Azimuth's inhumanity, linking HIP 22460 to Project Seraph's Fort Asch experiments, Bl...
torben-rademaker.bio_full:
Torben Rademaker is the CEO of Azimuth Biochemicals and the public face of the corporation's anti-xeno weapons programme. A brash, confident executive, Rademaker has consistently defended Azimuth's controversial research methods — including human experimentation and the exploitation of Guardian technology — as necessary sacrifices in humanity's existential struggle against the Thargoids. His rhetoric frames Azimuth as the only organisation capable of developing effective countermeasures, dismissing critics as "alien-loving traitors."

Rademaker's stewardship of Azimuth reached its zenith with the Proteus Wave project at HIP 22460 and the subsequent arms conventions that showcased new AX weaponry such as the Overcharged Gimballed AX Multi-Cannon. His corporate ambitions extend beyond weapons development; under his leadership, Azimuth has pursued partnerships with institutions like the Holloway Bioscience Institute, positioning the corporation to dominate xenological research regardless of the ethical cost. The catastrophic failure of the Proteus Wave in 3309 and Salvation's death left Rademaker's legacy in ruins.

autumn-leif.name: Autumn Leif
autumn-leif.bio: Autumn Leif is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-12-01 to 3303-12-08. Closely associated with Rogue Runners, Rogue Security. The Rogue Runners, an independent group based in the Run system, have announced plans to restore and expand Leif Enterprise, an asteroid base. Founder Autumn Leif stated they hope to reinforce the superstructure with meta-alloys to make it resistant to Thargoid Sensor effects.

toru-jacobs.name: Toru Jacobs
toru-jacobs.bio: Toru Jacobs is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-03-30 to 3304-03-30. Closely associated with Ross 310 Natural Services, Ross 310 Cartel. Toru Jacobs of Ross 310 Natural Services stated they are doing everything possible to prevent a Cartel takeover.

commander-slk.name: Commander S!LK
commander-slk.bio: Commander S!LK is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-16 to 3302-03-16. Closely associated with Adle's Armada, Blood Brothers, Contrail.

president-vondell.name: President Vondell
president-vondell.bio: President Vondell is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-20 to 3301-03-20. Closely associated with Gold Vision Company, 8th Dragon Squadron. President Vondell praised the 8th Dragon Squadron and promised peace and prosperity for Eta Draconis.

lal-candromir.name: Lal Candromir
lal-candromir.bio: Lal Candromir is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-20 to 3304-09-20. Closely associated with Imperial Internal Security Service. The New Dawn Collection of sculptures by legendary artist Lal Candromir, dating back nearly a thousand years, is entirely taken.

fionn-mac-cumhaill.name: Fionn Mac Cumhaill
fionn-mac-cumhaill.bio: Fionn Mac Cumhaill is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-07 to 3301-10-12. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Fuel Rats. Commander Fionn Mac Cumhaill was rescued by Fuel Rats Beornfrið, Kerenn, and Anuranium after mistakenly targeting a T-Tauri star with empty fuel tanks.

marlon-royce.name: Marlon Royce
marlon-royce.bio: Marlon Royce is a business analyst for Vox Galactica who reported on major corporate developments including Sirius Corporation's political influence, the Ambrose Foundation bankruptcy, and core-systems corporate support for Colonia's tenth anniversary.
marlon-royce.bio_full:
Marlon Royce is a business analyst for Vox Galactica who has reported on major financial and corporate developments across the galaxy. In June 3307, he published a widely discussed analysis of Sirius Corporation's growing political influence, examining how the megacorp had leveraged refugee resettlement, the Galactic Summit, secret deals with the Kumo Crew, and Coalsack Nebula colonisation to position itself as a "de facto fourth superpower."

Royce also reported on the overnight bankruptcy of the Ambrose Foundation in February 3305, when three hundred billion credits were liquidated and transferred to anonymous accounts, alongside the disappearance of heiress Lady Talitha Ambrose. His work for Vox Galactica has made him a leading voice in galactic business journalism, with his analyses frequently cited in discussions of corporate power and political influence. In 3312, he covered core-systems megacorporations' public backing of Colonia's tenth-anniversary celebrations.

angel-rose.name: Angel Rose
angel-rose.bio: Angel Rose is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-19 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club. Commander Angel Rose grew up on a starport, became a trader, then was drawn into crime and reluctant assassination, ultimately joining pirates featured on the Underground Channel. Her mother Maugvahnna Rose was a ruthless social climber who became a starport captain and played a small part in her daughter’s criminal path.

ambassador-cuthrick-delaney.name: Ambassador Cuthrick Delaney
ambassador-cuthrick-delaney.bio: The chief diplomatic representative of Loren's Legion, Ambassador Cuthrick Delaney became a controversial figure after Senator Kahina Tijani Loren delegated Prism system responsibilities to him in 3301.
ambassador-cuthrick-delaney.bio_full:
Cuthrick Delaney served as the public face of Loren's Legion, handling external relations and resource appeals for the faction led by Senator Kahina Tijani Loren. In 3301, Loren's decision to delegate responsibility for the Prism system to Delaney triggered a severe political backlash that culminated in her being stripped of senatorial rank — a punishment many observers considered disproportionate and politically motivated.

Despite the scandal, Delaney continued his diplomatic work. In late 3302, he announced that Loren's Legion's appeal for tantalum had been enthusiastically received by the galactic community, demonstrating that the faction retained both operational capacity and public support. His career illustrated how Imperial politics could punish even routine administrative delegations when they became weapons in senatorial rivalries.

saool-aledon.name: Saool Aledon
saool-aledon.bio: Saool Aledon is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-11-10 to 3303-11-10. Closely associated with Alliance. Senior operative Saool Aledon stated they want to leverage their expertise to support Alliance operations far from the core systems.

nadia-machado.name: Nadia Machado
nadia-machado.bio: Nadia Machado is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-29 to 3308-10-06. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Popontia Incorporated.

bryanna-blanco.name: Bryanna Blanco
bryanna-blanco.bio: Bryanna Blanco is a Journalist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-06-20 to 3311-09-22. Affiliated with Federal Times, Rackham Capital Investments. Notable activities include: Zachary Rackham hosts a week-long trillionaire celebration in Beta Hydri, requesting rare goods from pilots.; Rackham Capital Investments concluded its galaxy-wide exploration initiative, with Rackham claiming scientists are close to cracking the HIP 87621 ...
bryanna-blanco.bio_full:
Bryanna Blanco is a financial journalist for The Federal Times known for her persistent investigative scrutiny of billionaire Zachary Rackham. In 3304, she publicly questioned the legitimacy of Rackham's billion-credit Federal Grand Lottery win, suggesting the windfall would be used to pay his company's gargantuan unpaid tax bill rather than donated to charity as he claimed. Her reporting cemented her reputation as one of the Federation's most skeptical financial commentators.

Blanco maintained her critical coverage as Rackham's public profile grew, penning opinion pieces that highlighted his extragavant self-promotion — including the towering Rackham's Spire on Homeland — and warning that his lighthearted hints about running for president in 3308 were calculated steps toward a genuine campaign. She has repeatedly reminded the public of Rackham's former identity as "Calico Zack," one of the previous century's most notorious pirates, accusing mainstream newsfeeds of sanitising his history.

rhiannon-grady.name: Rhiannon Grady
rhiannon-grady.bio: Rhiannon Grady is a ceo in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-05-14 to 3308-09-21. Closely associated with Advocacy, Federal Intelligence Agency. Advocacy director Rhiannon Grady warns the Federation has taken a large step toward becoming a police state.

corrigendum.name: Corrigendum
corrigendum.bio: Corrigendum is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-07-24 to 3302-05-14. Affiliated with Kumo Crew, Imperial Navy, Lavigny's Legion. Notable activities include: Two weeks into Operation Davy Jones, Imperial forces continue their siege of the Pegasi sector.; Debate rages in the Pegasi sector over Senator Arissa Lavigny-Duval's invitation for Federation systems to become Imperial citizens.
corrigendum.bio_full:
Corrigendum is the military callsign of a commander within Lavigny's Legion, the Imperial forces loyal to Senator Arissa Lavigny-Duval. During Operation Davy Jones in July 3301, Corrigendum served as a frontline officer in the Imperial campaign against the Kumo Crew in the Pegasi sector, reporting that Archon Delaine's forces had been routed from Imperial space with heavy clashes in Anedjete, Sopontet and Huichi.

Corrigendum publicly rejected any diplomatic settlement with the Kumo Crew, stating that the Empire "refuses to negotiate with captors" — a hardline position reflecting Lavigny-Duval's uncompromising stance against piracy and slavery. As both a combat leader and spokesperson for Lavigny's Legion, Corrigendum exemplified the Imperial Navy's aggressive posture during the Pegasi sector campaigns.

verity-gavroche.name: Verity Gavroche
verity-gavroche.bio: Verity Gavroche is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-23 to 3302-03-29. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.
verity-gavroche.bio_full:
Verity Gavroche served as a pilot affiliated with the Canonn Interstellar Research Group during early 3302. Her involvement with the organisation placed her within one of the most active independent research communities of the era, a collective dedicated to investigating phenomena that official institutions either overlooked or classified. As a pilot-researcher, she contributed to the group's distributed efforts to document anomalies, alien artefacts, and unexplained occurrences across explored space.

Her activity during this period coincided with escalating interest in Thargoid-related discoveries and other mysteries that would dominate scientific discourse for decades. Gavroche represented the growing cohort of independent pilots who combined exploration and combat skills with genuine scientific curiosity, challenging the monopoly that corporate and government laboratories held on formal research. Her association with Canonn demonstrated how grassroots scientific communities could attract dedicated participants from diverse backgrounds.

infinity1.name: Infinity+1
infinity1.bio: Infinity+1 is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-03 to 3301-08-03. Closely associated with Imperial Navy. Commander Infinity+1 commented on the lucrative trade, with profits allegedly running towards 4,000 credits per slave.

petra-olmanova.name: Petra Olmanova
petra-olmanova.bio: Petra Olmanova is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-29 to 3309-02-20. Closely associated with Aegis.
petra-olmanova.bio_full:
Petra Olmanova established herself as a skilled engineer within Aegis, the tri-superpower organisation created to coordinate humanity's response to the Thargoid threat. Her technical expertise spanned multiple disciplines essential to anti-xeno operations, from weapons development to defensive systems integration. Working within Aegis provided Olmanova with access to resources and research facilities drawn from across Federal, Imperial, and Alliance territories, enabling her to contribute to some of the most advanced military engineering projects of the era.

Her documented career from 3304 through 3309 covered the critical early phases of sustained human-Thargoid conflict, when Aegis struggled to translate scattered encounters into coherent technological responses. Olmanova's engineering work supported the development of weapons and defensive platforms that independent pilots would deploy against alien vessels. Her contributions exemplified the scientific and technical labour that underpinned front-line combat operations, transforming raw research into practical systems capable of engaging a technologically superior adversary.

kit-fowler.name: Kit Fowler
kit-fowler.bio: Kit Fowler is a conspiracy theorist and engineer who broadcasts the show End Times from his workshop in the Capoya system. He has made outlandish claims including labelling Salvation an AI construct, accusing Utopia of secretly creating a new species of human, and arguing that the universe's true shape is being concealed by superpower-sponsored holograms.
kit-fowler.bio_full: Kit Fowler is an independent engineer and conspiracy theorist who operates from his workshop in the Capoya system. He broadcasts a show called End Times through the Rewired network, hosted by journalist Flint "Firemaker" Lafosse. Fowler has gained notoriety for a series of outlandish claims, including labelling the mysterious anti-xeno figure Salvation as an AI construct, accusing Utopia of secretly creating a new species of human, and arguing that the universe's true shape is being concealed by superpower-sponsored holograms. One of his more grounded theories concerned Black Flight, a sinister group he claimed committed multiple crimes including murder to suppress evidence of Thargoid activity after the First War.

governor-lawrence.name: Governor Lawrence
governor-lawrence.bio: Governor Lawrence is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-05 to 3302-03-24. Closely associated with Blue Hand Gang. Governor Lawrence announces the successful conclusion of the Ceremonial Heike Tea appeal at Wilkes Orbital. Governor Lawrence confirms Palin is in a delicate state but expected to recover.

oberon-church.name: Oberon Church
oberon-church.bio: Oberon Church is a Engineer in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-06-29 to 3308-07-21. Affiliated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Federal Times, Red Family. Notable activities include: The Federal Intelligence Agency launches a multi-system crackdown against the Red Family narcotics syndicate using Proactive Detection Bureau intel...; Red Family co-founder Jan Sandoval reveals the cartel has developed a genetically engineered designer narcotic far more addictive than existing sub...
oberon-church.bio_full:
Oberon Church is the founder and kingpin of the Red Family, a notorious narcotics syndicate operating in Federal space. In mid-3305, Church developed a genetically engineered designer narcotic far more addictive than any existing substance, prompting co-founder Jan Sandoval to surrender to the Federal Intelligence Agency to prevent its mass production.

Despite coordinated FIA raids that seized most of the organisation's assets and arrested numerous operatives, Church managed to evade capture. Federal Times crime correspondent Ethan Takahashi reported that Church had "lived up to his self-styled image as 'the man of smoke', forever drifting through the fingers of those who try to grasp him." Proactive Detection Bureau analysts worked to decrypt communications from captured data drives to pinpoint his location, but Church's ability to evade justice demonstrated the resilience of well-entrenched criminal networks even against the Federation's most advanced surveillance capabilities.

violet-belbin.name: Violet Belbin
violet-belbin.bio: Violet Belbin is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-22 to 3302-01-23. Closely associated with Xenological Research Institute.

anya-blackriver.name: Anya Blackriver
anya-blackriver.bio: Anya Blackriver is a public-relations consultant with offices in Olympus Village, San Francisco, and Columbus Station. In October 3304, she was identified as one of the owners of a PA912 administration robot containing a hidden surveillance program installed as part of the spy robot scandal.
anya-blackriver.bio_full: Anya Blackriver runs a public-relations consultancy with offices in Olympus Village, San Francisco, and Columbus Station. In October 3304, she was identified by the Federal Security Service as one of five owners of a PA912 administration robot manufactured by Achilles Corporation that contained a hidden surveillance program. The discovery was part of the broader spy robot scandal in which Mars Tribune owner Kingsley Cordova had blackmailed an Achilles engineer into installing surveillance software on robots belonging to prominent figures. Blackriver's inclusion on the list of affected individuals highlighted the wide reach of the surveillance operation across Federal society.

imogen-luciana.name: Imogen Luciana
imogen-luciana.bio: Imperial Ambassador who spearheaded the Empire's diplomatic offensive during the Marlinist refugee crisis of 3306.
imogen-luciana.bio_full:
Imogen Luciana served as Imperial Ambassador during one of the most delicate diplomatic crises of the 3300s. In October 3306, when hundreds of thousands of Marlinist refugees fled Imperial anti-terrorism lockdowns into Federation space, Luciana issued a formal demand for their extradition, insisting that the Federation was "harbouring potential criminals who are connected to the NMLA terrorists."

The Federation's refusal, led by Ambassador Jordan Rochester, transformed the refugee crisis into a full-blown inter-superpower dispute.
