alex-snoori.name: Alex Snoori
alex-snoori.bio: Alex Snoori is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-28 to 3301-05-28. Alex Snoori, host of 'Beyond Top Secret', spread conspiracy theories about Starship One's disappearance, rejecting the Frame Shift Drive failure explanation.

cmdr-kamzel.name: CMDR Kamzel
cmdr-kamzel.bio: CMDR Kamzel is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-01 to 3301-03-01. CMDR R4nger0 and CMDR Kamzel rendezvoused at EACTAINDS GN-W C1-6 on the far side of the galaxy, 43,000 light years from home. R4nger0 was crossing the galaxy in a Sidewinder; Kamzel was returning from an 8-week survey along the galactic outer rim.

gabriel-sanchini.name: Gabriel Sanchini
gabriel-sanchini.bio: Gabriel Sanchini is a ceo in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-25 to 3304-08-25. Closely associated with Herculean Machines, Supratech.

florence-lavigny.name: Florence Lavigny
florence-lavigny.bio: Florence Lavigny is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-07-18 to 3309-09-01. Affiliated with Imperial Palace, Imperial Senate. Notable activities include: Archduke Otto Lombardo-Duval requests materials to construct Duval family statues across Imperial worlds, with mixed reactions from the palace.; Emperor Hengist Duval appeared before the Senate, calling on senators to work together for the good of the Empire.
florence-lavigny.bio_full:
Lady Florence Lavigny is an Imperial noblewoman, the widow of Prince Aristide de Lavigny and mother of Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval. Though she has typically sought to avoid the spotlight, she was thrust into prominence by her engagement to Emperor Hengist Duval in 3301. On their wedding day, the Emperor was fatally attacked, and Lavigny emerged as a dignified voice of calm amid the succession crisis.

Decades earlier, her husband Prince Aristide died in a mysterious accident in 3250. The later revelation that Arissa had been sired by Hengist Duval transformed her family's standing, with Arissa adopting the surname Lavigny-Duval upon becoming Emperor. In 3309, a serious illness prompted renewed attention to Lavigny's role as a unifying figure within the Imperial Family, with observers suggesting she alone might heal the rifts between Arissa, Princess Aisling Duval, and Hadrian Duval.

mahina-dillon.name: Mahina Dillon
mahina-dillon.bio: Mahina Dillon is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-31 to 3302-08-31.

adalyn-cross.name: Adalyn Cross
adalyn-cross.bio: Adalyn Cross is a Journalist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-10-03 to 3307-07-23. Affiliated with Rockforth Corporation, Interstellar Association for Agriculture, Federal Intelligence Agency. Notable activities include: The IAA confirms mass crop spoilage is caused by a new advanced blight of unknown origin.; A tri-superpower taskforce confirms the EX7 fertiliser was deliberately contaminated with a synthetic compound designed to introduce an aggressive ...
adalyn-cross.bio_full:
Adalyn Cross is a journalist for Vox Galactica who reported extensively on the societal impact of the 3305 blight crisis. Her coverage documented how core systems adapted to food shortages, with freeze-dried goods returning to favour, restaurant menus shrinking, and the fishing industry experiencing a boom as pescatarian diets rose.

Cross noted that billions relied on food cartridges and ration packs offering only basic nutrition, while welfare charities were stretched to breaking point. She also reviewed the blight's aftermath, reporting on the Interstellar Association for Agriculture's pledge to intensify screening regulations and intelligence agencies' reviews of strategies for tackling interstellar terrorism. Her journalism captured both the immediate humanitarian crisis and the longer-term policy shifts that followed the Scythe of Panem's biochemical attack.

queen-jezza.name: Queen Jezza
queen-jezza.bio: Queen Jezza is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-08 to 3302-04-08. Commander Lysianassa declares herself 'Queen of Sagittarius A*' after making the 26,000 light-year journey in a heavily armed Federal Corvette.

maristela-silva.name: Maristela Silva
maristela-silva.bio: Maristela Silva is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-01 to 3308-11-01. Closely associated with Imperial Senate, Federal Navy, Alliance.

elias-pope.name: Elias Pope
elias-pope.bio: Elias Pope is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-21 to 3308-11-25.

lieutenant-barringer.name: Lieutenant Barringer
lieutenant-barringer.bio: Lieutenant Barringer is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-30 to 3301-05-30. Closely associated with Federal Transport Safety Administration.

caius.name: Caius
caius.bio: Caius is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-27 to 3301-07-27. Closely associated with Dukes of Mikunn.

solomon-helios.name: Solomon Helios
solomon-helios.bio: Solomon Helios is a Journalist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-05-26 to 3308-01-01. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Aisling Duval's anti-slavery campaign merging with Universal Liberty to form Unchain, Lori Jameson's denunciation of the Le...; Weekly summary covering Riri McAllister being unmasked as Nexus and framing Admiral Varma, the hunt for League strongholds in Zibal and Ienpalang, ...
solomon-helios.bio_full:
Solomon Helios is an entertainment journalist who covers Imperial court politics and celebrity gossip, with a particular focus on Princess Aisling Duval's romantic life. In mid-3304, Helios secured exclusive coverage of Aisling's diplomatic functions with Federal Ambassador Jordan Rochester, correctly identifying Vice Admiral Juno Rochester as a potential "future in-law" before the engagement was announced.

Helios's reporting on the Aisling-Rochester romance combined entertainment journalism with genuine political insight, speculating on whether Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval and President Hudson would attend the wedding or intervene to prevent the union. His commentary on the cancelled wedding in August 3304 — noting the political earthquake it caused — demonstrated that Imperial entertainment media could shape public perception of superpower diplomacy.

omar-jordan.name: Omar Jordan
omar-jordan.bio: Omar Jordan is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-12 to 3301-08-12. Closely associated with Apalar Labour. Governor Omar Jordan of Svavarsson Terminal stated the system is strategically positioned between Archon Delaine, Zachary Hudson, Zemina Torval, and Denton Patreus territories.

kali-rochester.name: Kali Rochester
kali-rochester.bio: Kali Rochester is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-27 to 3304-07-29. Closely associated with Core Dynamics. Members of the Rochester family come under personal and political attack following Jordan Rochester's engagement to Aisling Duval. Kali Rochester, Jordan's teenage niece, is physically assaulted by students chanting anti-Imperial slogans at Olympus Village University.

kayode-tau.name: Kayode Tau
kayode-tau.bio: Kayode Tau is a Diplomat in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-07-13 to 3308-04-21. Affiliated with NMLA, Marlinist, Alliance. Notable activities include: The NMLA bombs Stillman Hub in HIP 22550 and Tilman Point in Hyades Sector RO-P b6-6, killing tens of thousands.; NMLA starport bombings in the Marlinist Colonies kill over 35,000 civilians.
kayode-tau.bio_full:
Kayode Tau is a politician and leader of the Free Marlinist Movement who competed to become the first prime consul of the Marlinist Consulate in 3307. Tau positioned himself as the moderate alternative to Verity Dexter of the Marlinism Reformation Party — the NMLA's political wing — directly opposing Dexter's bid for Imperial patronage and her representation of Neo-Marlinist extremism.

The Marlinist Consulate election became a referendum on whether the colonies would align with the NMLA's political apparatus or maintain independence from terrorism. Senator Lorcan Scordato championed Dexter's candidacy, which Chancellor Blaine approved as an Imperial patronage, but Tau's Free Marlinist Movement represented the anti-extremist faction that sought diplomatic legitimacy without terrorist associations. Tau's political career embodies the internal struggle within Marlinism between republican idealism and violent revolutionary tactics.

octavia-volkov.name: Octavia Volkov
octavia-volkov.bio: Octavia Volkov is a Senator in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-06-07 to 3309-10-16. Affiliated with NMLA, Marlinist, Alliance. Notable activities include: Minister Aaron Whyte proposes a peace deal between the NMLA and Empire, with the Marlinism Reformation Party offering to represent the terrorists p...; Political rifts and public protests erupt across the Marlinist Colonies following NMLA starport bombings, with Parliament descending into heated ac...
octavia-volkov.bio_full:
Octavia Volkov is a Marlinist political leader who rose to prominence as head of the Exiled Marlinist Assembly of Baltah'Sine. She first gained power in the Hyades Sector RO-P b6-2 system in June 3307 after voters rejected the Marlinism Reformation Party for granting asylum to Neo-Marlinists. Volkov immediately distinguished herself as a fierce opponent of the NMLA, declaring that her party followed Marlin Duval's example by building independent democracies rather than reforming the Empire.

In August 3307, Volkov led anti-NMLA forces to victory in the Marlinist Civil War against Aaron Whyte's faction. Elected First Minister days later, she consolidated control over all eight colony systems and established formal diplomatic channels with the Alliance and Federation. Under her leadership, the colonies navigated continued political challenges including a public referendum on Imperial protectorate status and the Thargoid threat. By 3309, Volkov had become a respected diplomatic figure, congratulating President-elect Felicia Winters on her Federal election victory.

shamus-madigan.name: Shamus Madigan
shamus-madigan.bio: Shamus Madigan is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-09-05 to 3310-10-16. Affiliated with Aegis. Notable activities include: Classified footage from the Battle of HIP 22460 is leaked to newsfeeds, revealing the so-called 'Thargoid roar' and fuelling public anxiety as inte...; The rise of the xeno-peace movement has caused a number of public figures to discuss coexisting peacefully with the Thargoid race.
shamus-madigan.bio_full:
Shamus Madigan is a professor of xenology at Olympus Village University and a leading academic authority on Thargoid behaviour. In September 3308, he published a paper in The Empirical analysing the Thargoids' resistance to the Proteus Wave superweapon in HIP 22460, arguing that their upgraded technology and altered behaviour indicated that humanity had become "a problem that must be dealt with."

Madigan also analysed classified footage leaked from the Battle of HIP 22460, interpreting the so-called "Thargoid roar" as "residual electromagnetic radiation from the Thargoids' energy pulse." His scholarly work provided a grounded scientific counterpoint to more alarmist theories, though he consistently warned that humanity's lack of understanding of Thargoid biology and technology left the species dangerously unprepared for the escalating conflict.

ihazevich.name: Ihazevich
ihazevich.bio: Ihazevich is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-31 to 3302-08-31. Independent pilots Noctrach and Ihazevich discovered mysterious wreckage on planet 9a in the Pleiades Sector AB-W B2-4 system after a galaxy-wide hunt coordinated by the Granger Gang.

rose-trebek.name: Rose Trebek
rose-trebek.bio: Rose Trebek is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-25 to 3302-03-05. Closely associated with Blue Hand Gang, Joint Security Taskforce. Rose Trebek speculates the gang bought the escape pods without knowing their contents. Rose Trebek, a former soldier, establishes the Joint Security Taskforce to clean up the Orulas system from the ruthless Blue Hand Gang.

kaii.name: Kaii
kaii.bio: Kaii is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-01-04 to 3305-03-07. Closely associated with Deep Space Surveys.

erimus.name: Erimus
erimus.bio: Erimus is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-04 to 3301-10-04. Closely associated with Core Dynamics, Universal Cartographics.

nikolas-glass.name: Nikolas Glass
nikolas-glass.bio: Nikolas Glass is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-04-13 to 3310-01-08. Affiliated with Sirius Corporation, Alliance, Alliance Defence Force. Notable activities include: Sirius Corporation deploys megaships to the Coalsack and Witch Head Nebulas to provide anti-xeno support for the Alliance.; Sirius Corporation claims the Thargoid incursions prove the necessity of its strategic defence pact with the Alliance.
nikolas-glass.bio_full:
Admiral Nikolas Glass is a highly decorated officer of the Sirius Navy who was appointed to the Alliance Council of Admirals in January 3308, becoming the first seventh member and the first representative from outside the Alliance to serve on the body. His appointment followed the Alliance-Sirius Corporation defence pact, with Glass tasked to coordinate the Alliance Defence Force's anti-Thargoid operations with direct Sirius military support.

The unprecedented expansion of the Council drew criticism from figures including Councillor Nakato Kaine and Admiral George Varma, who warned against merging commercial interests with military matters. Glass's appointment symbolised the deep integration of corporate power into Alliance defence policy, reflecting the superpower's reliance on Sirius technology and naval strength to compensate for the ADF's inferiority compared to the Federal and Imperial fleets.

otto-lombardo-duval.name: Otto Lombardo-Duval
otto-lombardo-duval.bio: Archduke Otto Lombardo-Duval is a member of the Imperial Duval dynasty, related to Emperor Hengist Duval's extended family.
otto-lombardo-duval.bio_full:
Archduke Otto Lombardo-Duval is a member of the Imperial Duval dynasty, related to the main line through Emperor Hengist Duval's extended family. He holds the title of Archduke and is counted among the senior Imperial Family members who publicly supported Emperor Arissa during the succession crisis and Nova Imperium conflict.

In 3309, Otto joined Princess Aisling Duval, Countess Guinevere Lavigny and other family members in sending well-wishes to Lady Florence Lavigny — the Emperor's mother — during a medical emergency. His inclusion in such family communications underscores his status as a recognised member of the Duval-Lavigny extended family, though he holds no direct claim to the throne. Otto's public role has been limited to ceremonial and familial duties rather than political or military leadership.

larry-oldman.name: Larry Oldman
larry-oldman.bio: Larry Oldman is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-27 to 3302-05-27.

jaya-chaudhary.bio: Jaya Chaudhary is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-02 to 3309-11-01.

commander-erimus-kamzel.bio: Commander 'Erimus' Kamzel is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-17 to 3302-06-17. Closely associated with FGE exploration wings, Fuel Rats.

li-yong-rui.name: Li Yong Rui
li-yong-rui.bio: Li Yong-Rui is a Ceo in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-06-10 to 3311-07-17. Affiliated with Sirius Corporation, Alliance, Utopia. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the Alliance Assembly's decision to create the Office of the Alliance President without executive powers, Sirius Corporatio...; Weekly summary covering the mercenary incursion against Ram Tah's Phoenix Base in Meene, the FSS suspension of Lieutenant Inspector Ramesh Thorne, ...
li-yong-rui.bio_full:
Li Yong-Rui is the CEO of Sirius Corporation and architect of many of the megacorp's most consequential political manoeuvres. He brokered the strategic defence pact with the Alliance in 3308, granting Sirius military access in exchange for economic partnerships, and proposed the establishment of independent Marlinist colonies in 3306 to defuse the refugee crisis threatening war between the Empire and Federation. His calm, business-first diplomacy has made Sirius a de facto fourth superpower.

Yong-Rui's leadership has drawn increasing criticism, particularly from Alliance Councillor Nakato Kaine, who accused him of failing to deliver promised capital ships and adequate Thargoid defence. The Alliance Assembly launched a formal evaluation of the Sirius pact in late 3309, questioning whether the partnership's returns justified its costs. Despite this pressure, Yong-Rui has maintained Sirius's influence across all three superpowers, positioning the corporation as an indispensable mediator in galactic affairs.

gan.name: Gan
gan.bio: A Utopian explorer who spoke for humanity's expansionist ambitions at the founding symposium of the Pioneers Cooperative in 3302.
gan.bio_full:
Commander Gan represented Utopia at the inaugural symposium of the Pioneers Cooperative in January 3302, an event that brought together delegates from over twenty independent pilot organisations including Loren's Legion, the Canonn, Adle's Armada and the Distant Worlds Admins. The gathering sought to formalise support for humanity's expansion beyond the core systems.

Gan encapsulated the Utopian philosophy in a single sentence: "To live is to grow, and mankind must push ever outwards." Citing the success of the Utopian commune in Takurua and Obsidian Orbital in Maia as proof that deep-space settlement was viable, Gan helped establish the Pioneers Cooperative as a coordinating body for independent exploration and colonisation efforts across the galaxy.

oghmios-ttt.name: Oghmios-TTT
oghmios-ttt.bio: Oghmios-TTT is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-03-29 to 3309-03-29. Closely associated with Alliance, Empire.

commander-cly.name: Commander Cly
commander-cly.bio: Commander Cly is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-29 to 3302-07-01.

admiral-brice.name: Admiral Brice
admiral-brice.bio: Admiral Brice is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-06 to 3301-05-06. Closely associated with Alliance.

carver.name: Carver
carver.bio: Carver is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-03-10 to 3308-06-23. Closely associated with Alliance.

erik-gunnarson.name: Erik Gunnarson
erik-gunnarson.bio: Erik Gunnarson is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-04-02 to 3307-12-23. Affiliated with Wallglass Investigations Agency, Pilots Federation. Notable activities include: Francesca Wolfe details the discovery of the Hesperus alongside the Scriveners Clan dredger in the Perseus Dark Region.; Pilots report new contact from 'Salvation' near the Hesperus and Adamastor.
erik-gunnarson.bio_full:
Erik Gunnarson is an investigative journalist with the Wallglass Investigations Agency who specialises in uncovering hidden or forgotten human societies. In 3307, he published a groundbreaking study of the Dredger Clans — nomadic tribes that roam deep space in converted bulk cruisers, scavenging and occasionally raiding to sustain tens of thousands of inhabitants whose cultures have evolved over centuries of isolation.

Gunnarson's research revealed that these dredgers function as generation ships, with each clan hosting distinct societies that have diverged significantly from mainstream galactic culture. His work brought academic legitimacy to what had previously been dismissed as spacer folklore, including childhood nightmares about the Phagos clan's cannibalistic reputation. His article on the dredgers directly preceded the discovery of the Scriveners Clan alongside the Hesperus megaship, validating his thesis that these nomadic societies were not merely surviving but actively pursuing their own agendas in the galaxy's fringes.

otto-granger.name: Otto Granger
otto-granger.bio: Otto Granger is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-31 to 3302-09-09. Independent pilots Noctrach and Ihazevich discovered mysterious wreckage on planet 9a in the Pleiades Sector AB-W B2-4 system after a galaxy-wide hunt coordinated by the Granger Gang. Smuggler Otto Granger has demanded credit for the discovery of mysterious debris in the Pleiades Nebula, claiming he and his friends found it first.

niamh-seutonia.name: Niamh Seutonia
niamh-seutonia.bio: Niamh Seutonia is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-04-21 to 3307-05-21. Affiliated with League of Reparation, Imperial Internal Security Service, Alliance. Notable activities include: The murder of Imperial Senator Nestor Cartesius has sparked widespread speculation about the INRA.; Weekly summary covering the Socho system being overtaken by the Socho Gold Raiders, Aegis's Eagle Eye success in repelling Thargoids, five ships de...
niamh-seutonia.bio_full:
Captain Niamh Seutonia was an officer of the Imperial Internal Security Service who rose to prominence leading the investigation into the 3304 murder of Senator Nestor Cartesius. She helped uncover the League of Reparation, a terrorist group targeting descendants of INRA members, and served in the tri-superpower taskforce that dismantled it alongside Alliance Interpol and the Federal Intelligence Agency.

In 3307, Seutonia was appointed co-leader of the Affiliated Counter-Terrorism unit (ACT), a tri-superpower agency formed to combat the NMLA after the Nine Martyrs starport bombings. While investigating NMLA suppliers in the Mudhrid system, her ship the Valkyrie went missing. The wreckage was discovered weeks later in the Trianguli sector GW-W B1-0 system, with all crew dead. Seutonia had secured her mission logs moments before the crash, providing vital evidence linking a Neo-Marlinist faction to the bombings. She was posthumously awarded the Achenar Service Cross.

anton-vern.name: Anton Vern
anton-vern.bio: A Federal admiral affiliated with the Close Encounters Corps and Federal Security Service, Anton Vern oversaw survey operations during a brief but active period in late 3304.
anton-vern.bio_full:
During October 3304, Admiral Anton Vern emerged as the public face of a Federal initiative to coordinate exploratory survey operations. Working through the Close Encounters Corps in partnership with the Federal Security Service, he reported strong interest from multiple independent survey groups eager to participate in organised reconnaissance efforts.

The collaboration represented an unusual intersection of civilian exploration enthusiasm and Federal security interests. Vern's public statements emphasised gratitude to participating pilots, suggesting the programme relied heavily on volunteer commanders rather than uniformed personnel. Though his tenure in the spotlight lasted barely two weeks, the model he helped establish foreshadowed later superpower efforts to harness independent pilot networks for large-scale survey and monitoring campaigns.

selena-conley.name: Selena Conley
selena-conley.bio: Selena Conley is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-13 to 3304-09-22. Closely associated with Libertas Cooperative, Munshin Manatee Meat. Progenitor Selena Conley states the project will bring Munshin's fine meat to a wider consumer base. Progenitor Selena Conley thanks pilots and states increased manatee meat production will boost the Munshin system's economy.
selena-conley.bio_full:
Selena Conley served as a progenitor and project leader within the Libertas Cooperative during the mid-3300s, championing an initiative to expand the distribution of Munshin Manatee Meat beyond its traditional regional market. Her vision centred on bringing the product to a wider consumer base across independent and aligned territories, requiring both logistical innovation and persuasive marketing to overcome the challenges of interstellar food distribution. The project represented a significant investment in local agricultural capacity with ambitions for galactic-scale commercial reach.

In September 3304, Conley publicly thanked the independent pilots who had supported the initiative, confirming that increased manatee meat production would generate substantial economic benefits for the Munshin system. Her statements framed the project as a model for how cooperative ventures could leverage pilot networks to achieve economic development goals that might otherwise require corporate or superpower intervention. Conley's work illustrated the entrepreneurial energy that characterised independent systems seeking to build sustainable economies through specialised agricultural and food production industries.

don-antonaci.name: Don Antonaci
don-antonaci.bio: Don Antonaci is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-19 to 3302-05-19. Closely associated with Wolf 359, Hutton Orbital Truckers. Pirate leader Don Antonaci of Wolf 359 calls for an 'anything goes' battle royale against the Hutton Orbital Truckers in the Wyrd system.

commander-nicholas-powell.name: Commander Nicholas Powell
commander-nicholas-powell.bio: A commander with the Canonn Interstellar Research Group who helped pioneer systematic methods for locating barnacle sites across the galaxy.
commander-nicholas-powell.bio_full:
Commander Nicholas Powell was among the early members of the Canonn Interstellar Research Group who transformed barnacle hunting from chance discovery into systematic science. In mid-3302, he contributed to the publication of "Barnacle Search Criteria," a document that advised pilots on the planetary conditions most likely to host the mysterious alien growths.

His work came at a critical moment. While Commander Wobblytickle's discovery of barnacles in the California Nebula was being celebrated, Powell and his colleagues were already noting with concern the loss of several Pleiades barnacles through destruction or over-harvesting. The search criteria he helped develop enabled more efficient location of new sites, directly supporting the expanding research into meta-alloys and their role in countering the technological plague.

rocco-gandara.name: Rocco Gandara
rocco-gandara.bio: Rocco Gandara is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-10-01 to 3306-10-08. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Keltim Empire League.

andrew-jones.name: Andrew Jones
andrew-jones.bio: Andrew Jones is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-04-18 to 3308-04-18. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Alliance, Imperial Navy.

remy-leroux.name: Remy Leroux
remy-leroux.bio: Remy Leroux is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-28 to 3308-11-29. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Alliance.

renia-rakowski.name: Renia Rakowski
renia-rakowski.bio: Renia Rakowski is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-08-14 to 3309-08-17. Closely associated with Universal Cartographics. Commander Renia Rakowski reports a non-aggressive Thargoid interceptor encounter far from the Maelstroms, raising questions about Thargoid distribution and motives.

sylvia-rockforth.name: Sylvia Rockforth
sylvia-rockforth.bio: Sylvia Rockforth is a ceo in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-11-02 to 3305-11-05. Closely associated with Interstellar Association for Agriculture, Rockforth Corporation, Scythe of Panem. Rockforth Corporation faces criticism for its role in distributing the contaminated EX7 fertiliser. Rockforth Corporation CEO Sylvia Rockforth apologises for the company's role in distributing the blight pathogen via EX7 fertiliser.

tanya-ramirez.name: Tanya Ramirez
tanya-ramirez.bio: Tanya Ramirez is a Terrorist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-05-24 to 3307-11-19. Affiliated with League of Reparation, Imperial Internal Security Service, Federal Intelligence Agency. Notable activities include: The Alliance, Empire and Federation have created a centralised agency dedicated to investigating and eliminating the NMLA paramilitary group.; *Pilots Federation ALERT* Assistance is needed to track down an ACT operative who vanished while on a mission to identify NMLA suppliers.
tanya-ramirez.bio_full:
Senior Agent Tanya Ramirez is an officer of the Federal Intelligence Agency who served as co-leader of the Affiliated Counter-Terrorism unit (ACT) alongside Captain Niamh Seutonia during the NMLA crisis. In November 3307, Ramirez announced the capture of the NMLA's bomb-making engineers known as Theta Group, though their leader Theta Seven remained at large. She revealed that the breakthrough came from intercepting Theta Group's communications with Neo-Marlinist sympathisers.

Earlier in her career, Ramirez was a member of the tri-superpower taskforce investigating the League of Reparation in 3304, working alongside Alliance Interpol and the Imperial Internal Security Service. Her counter-terrorism expertise spanned two of the most significant threats to galactic security in the 34th century — from INRA-descendant vengeance killings to Neo-Marlinist starport bombings — making her one of the most experienced intelligence officers in the Federation.

tahir-west.name: Tahir West
tahir-west.bio: Tahir West is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-06-21 to 3308-11-01. Closely associated with Alliance, Council of Admirals.

titus-torval.name: Titus Torval
titus-torval.bio: Titus Torval is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-04-04 to 3309-04-04. Closely associated with Imperial Senate. Caine-Massey accuses Senator Zemina Torval of ordering the assassination of CEO Johann Fleischer, claiming an Imperial Intelligence hitman was responsible.

ivano-colombera.name: Ivano Colombera
ivano-colombera.bio: Ivano Colombera is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-09-05 to 3310-10-24. Affiliated with Aegis, Alliance. Notable activities include: Aegis requests resource deliveries in Duamta to fast-track mass production of the caustic sink launcher module.; Aegis develops and begins unmanned testing of the Thargoid pulse neutraliser, building on Elvira Martuuk's 3303 shutdown field neutraliser design.
ivano-colombera.bio_full:
Ivano Colombera is the director of xenological studies at the Imperial Science Academy and a leading authority on Thargoid behaviour. In September 3308, he responded to the Thargoids' resistance to the Proteus Wave superweapon in HIP 22460, hypothesising that their ability to disrupt Guardian technology was first conceived millions of years ago during the Guardian-Thargoid conflict.

Colombera's academic work focused on developing practical countermeasures against Thargoid capabilities, though he acknowledged that humanity's understanding of Thargoid biology remained extremely limited. His research contributed to Aegis's development of the caustic sink launcher module and other anti-xeno technologies, bridging the gap between theoretical xenology and military application during the escalating Thargoid war.

cmdr-john-paul-wilson.name: CMDR John Paul Wilson
cmdr-john-paul-wilson.bio: CMDR John Paul Wilson is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-09 to 3301-03-09. Closely associated with Banki Gold Gang, Gold Advanced Partners, Federal Navy.

randolph-plaskett.name: Randolph Plaskett
randolph-plaskett.bio: Randolph Plaskett is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-05-01 to 3309-09-18. Closely associated with Federal Times.

takio-diomedes.name: Takio Diomedes
takio-diomedes.bio: Takio Diomedes is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-03 to 3304-08-05. Closely associated with Imperial Internal Security Service, Unchain. Captain Takio Diomedes reports that explosive charges of amateur design were detected and disabled.

commander-turkwinif.name: Commander turkwinif
commander-turkwinif.bio: Commander turkwinif is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-18 to 3302-04-18. Commander turkwinif becomes the first pilot to reach Rho Cassiopeiae, a class-F hypergiant visible from Earth located in the difficult-to-navigate Formidine Rift.

captain-millington.name: Captain Millington
captain-millington.bio: Captain Millington is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-13 to 3301-02-13. Captain Millington announced details of the St.

beornfrið.name: Beornfrið
beornfrið.bio: Beornfrið is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-07 to 3301-07-07. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Fuel Rats. Commander Fionn Mac Cumhaill was rescued by Fuel Rats Beornfrið, Kerenn, and Anuranium after mistakenly targeting a T-Tauri star with empty fuel tanks.

sal-riley.name: Sal Riley
sal-riley.bio: Sal Riley is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-08-18 to 3303-08-18. Closely associated with Secoya Emperor's Grace.

theta-seven.name: Theta Seven
theta-seven.bio: Theta Seven is a Engineer in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-07-29 to 3307-12-31. Affiliated with NMLA, Marlinist, Far God cult. Notable activities include: The NMLA bombs Stillman Hub in HIP 22550 and Tilman Point in Hyades Sector RO-P b6-6, killing tens of thousands.; ACT reports major progress against the NMLA, raiding dozens of cells and arresting thousands of paramilitary activists following intelligence from ...
theta-seven.bio_full:
Theta Seven is the adopted moniker of the NMLA's principal bomb-maker and de facto military leader, originally designated prisoner number seven of the Theta Group during incarceration at Serene Harbour — an Imperial Intelligence penal facility in the R CrA Sector AF-A d42 system. After escaping alongside his fellow engineers, he adopted his prisoner designation as a political statement against the Empire's treatment of Neo-Marlinists, and his group went on to construct the caustic enzyme bombs used in the NMLA's starport terror campaign.

Theta Group was directly responsible for 17 starport bombings that killed nearly 800,000 people and injured twice as many. In November 3307, ACT captured most of Theta Group but Theta Seven remained at large, prompting an intensified manhunt and encrypted message decoding operation. His survival represented a continued existential threat to Imperial stability and a symbol of the NMLA's resilience against tri-superpower counter-terrorism efforts.

meglamaniac.name: MeglaManiac
meglamaniac.bio: MeglaManiac is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-10 to 3302-01-10.

tashmira-silva.name: Tashmira Silva
tashmira-silva.bio: Tashmira Silva is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-09-14 to 3305-06-13. Affiliated with Alliance, Alliance Interpol. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the conclusion of the Fazia Silva homicide investigation with no convictions and Tashmira Silva assuming control of her sis...; President Gibson Kincaid is removed from office by the Alliance Assembly on charges of treason, murder and corruption, and is detained while attemp...
tashmira-silva.bio_full:
Tashmira Silva is a corporate executive who assumed control of the Silva corporate empire following the assassination of her sister, Fazia Silva, in October 3304. Fazia had been a candidate in the Alliance presidential race when she was poisoned at Hume Orbital, a murder that remains officially unsolved but was widely suspected to involve political rivals.

Tashmira's most significant political intervention came in mid-3305, when she privately commissioned a Wallglass Investigations Agency report into her sister's death. The report, combined with testimony from Admiral Frederick Yamamoto, exposed President Gibson Kincaid's conspiracy to assassinate Fazia Silva and his broader pattern of treason, murder and corruption. Tashmira's public statement following Kincaid's impeachment — that "the Alliance has been purged of such a corrupt presence" — underscored both her personal loss and her role in exposing one of the most serious constitutional crises in Alliance history.

edgar-starwalker.name: Edgar Starwalker
edgar-starwalker.bio: Edgar Starwalker is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-29 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Lavigny's Legion. Commander Edgar Starwalker, aligned with Arissa Lavigny-Duval, questioned prioritising distant systems over corruption on Imperial doorsteps.
edgar-starwalker.bio_full:
Commander Edgar Starwalker emerged as an outspoken Imperial pilot during the turbulent political climate of 3301, openly aligning himself with Senator Arissa Lavigny-Duval's campaign against corruption. His public statements challenged the Imperial establishment's tendency to prioritise distant military expeditions over addressing systemic graft within its own territories. This stance placed him at odds with more traditionalist elements of Imperial society who viewed external expansion as essential to the Empire's prestige and security.

Starwalker's associations extended beyond Imperial circles to include contacts with Kumo Crew and Lavigny's Legion, suggesting a pragmatic approach to alliance-building that transcended conventional factional boundaries. His willingness to question Imperial priorities from a position of loyalty rather than opposition distinguished him from more radical critics. In this respect, Starwalker represented a particular strain of Imperial reformism that sought to strengthen the Empire through internal purification rather than external conquest.

xiona.name: Xiona
xiona.bio: Xiona is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-10-05 to 3307-10-05. Closely associated with Kumo Crew.

harald-harksing.name: Harald Harksing
harald-harksing.bio: Harald Harksing is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-12-15 to 3309-12-15. Eccentric inventor Harald Harksing's gift-delivery database is corrupted, preventing his latest batch of custom inventions from reaching their celebrity recipients.

emil-varga.name: Emil Varga
emil-varga.bio: Emil Varga is a Commodore in the Alliance Defence Force and the Alliance's military liaison to Aegis. In May 3309, he warned that all eight Maelstrom systems were affected by an anti-Guardian field and that weapons based on Guardian technology would not function inside them, advising pilots to replace them with other anti-xeno armaments.
emil-varga.bio_full: Emil Varga is a Commodore in the Alliance Defence Force who serves as the Alliance's military liaison to Aegis. In May 3309, he provided a critical tactical briefing following the first pathfinder missions into the Maelstroms. Varga confirmed that independent pilots had encountered significant Thargoid presence in the core regions and warned that all eight Maelstrom systems were affected by the same anti-Guardian field first witnessed in HIP 22460. His advisory that "weapons based on Guardian technology will not function and should be replaced with other anti-xeno armaments" became essential guidance for pilots preparing to enter the caustic clouds.

chen-emerson.name: Chen Emerson
chen-emerson.bio: Chen Emerson is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-11 to 3304-08-16. Closely associated with MacArthur Mining Ltd. Director Chen Emerson suspects human error placed the unit in incorrect standby mode, triggering a preset program. Director Chen Emerson confirms the robot had been placed in incorrect standby mode, with its comms array disrupted by local signals.
chen-emerson.bio_full:
Chen Emerson served as a director within MacArthur Mining Ltd during the mid-3300s, responsible for overseeing technical operations and equipment deployment at multiple extraction sites. In August 3304, he became the public face of an unusual incident involving an autonomous mining unit that had apparently malfunctioned in the field. His initial assessment suggested human error had placed the unit in an incorrect standby mode, triggering a preset programme that caused unexpected behaviour.

Further investigation confirmed Emerson's hypothesis, revealing that the robot's communications array had also been disrupted by local signal interference, compounding the operational confusion. The incident highlighted the challenges of managing automated equipment in environments where unpredictable conditions could interact with human oversight failures. Emerson's transparent handling of the situation demonstrated how corporate technical leaders could address public concerns while maintaining operational continuity during unexpected equipment failures.

raijiin.name: Raijiin
raijiin.bio: Raijiin is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-12-06 to 3303-09-29. Closely associated with Candy Crew Guild, Buckyball Racing Club. The Candy Crew Guild is dominating the midpoint of the Kick The Alien Buckyball race, with Commander Nookie Mr.Smith leading followed by Commanders Raijiin and Rewision.
raijiin.bio_full:
Commander Raijiin established a reputation as a skilled independent pilot active within the Candy Crew Guild, an organisation known for its distinctive approach to both commerce and community engagement. During late 3302 and 3303, Raijiin participated in the Kick The Alien Buckyball race, one of the more unusual competitive events organised by the Buckyball Racing Club. This race challenged pilots to navigate through Thargoid-influenced territories at maximum speed, combining the technical demands of precision flying with the additional pressure of operating in potentially hostile space.

Raijiin's performance in the race placed him among the top competitors, trailing only Commander Nookie Mr.Smith and ahead of Commander Rewision at the midpoint. This achievement demonstrated both exceptional piloting skill and the courage to push personal and ship limits in environments where conventional wisdom would counsel caution. Through participation in such events, Raijiin exemplified the competitive spirit that drove many independent pilots to test their abilities against peers in increasingly challenging conditions.

governor-albrecht.name: Governor Albrecht
governor-albrecht.bio: Governor Albrecht is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-06 to 3301-10-06. A memorial was unveiled at Hart Station in Bast by Governor Albrecht to honor the over 100,000 victims of the devastating outbreak.

dr-derthek.name: Dr Derthek
dr-derthek.bio: Dr Derthek is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-13 to 3302-05-13. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group, Universal Cartographics.

commander-alesia.name: Commander Alesia
commander-alesia.bio: Commander Alesia is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-01 to 3302-11-01. Closely associated with Colonia Citizens Network, Pilots Federation. Commander Alesia of the Pilots Federation recorded the first data, and mycologist Dr James Morel identified two species visually from telemetry and urged explorers to handle specimens with care.

allitnil.name: Allitnil
allitnil.bio: Allitnil is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-12-23 to 3302-12-23. Commander Allitnil has set a new record by travelling from Sol to Jaques Station in Colonia without stopping or equipping a fuel scoop, covering 5,489 hyperspace jumps in nine days aboard an Anaconda.

trystan-law.name: Trystan Law
trystan-law.bio: Trystan Law is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-06-21 to 3304-06-21. Closely associated with INRA, Alliance Interpol, League of Reparation. Chief Inspector Kay Kilbride foils a League of Reparation assassination attempt on Dinah Law, a descendant of INRA employee Trystan Law.

broker-del-boy.name: Broker Del Boy
broker-del-boy.bio: Broker Del Boy is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11. Closely associated with Alliance. Top contributors included Broker Mrozak, Broker HawX, Tycoon Ace Rimzy, Tycoon Thalios Abraxas and Broker Del Boy.

jan-sandoval.name: Jan Sandoval
jan-sandoval.bio: Jan Sandoval is a Engineer in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-06-29 to 3305-08-02. Affiliated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Red Family Cartel. Notable activities include: Red Family co-founder Jan Sandoval reveals the cartel has developed a genetically engineered designer narcotic far more addictive than existing sub...; Red Family co-founder Jan Sandoval unexpectedly surrenders to the Federal Intelligence Agency and offers to testify against the cartel's leadership...
jan-sandoval.bio_full:
Jan Sandoval is a co-founder of the Red Family, one of the Federation's most notorious narcotics cartels. In June 3305, she unexpectedly surrendered to the Federal Intelligence Agency at its Olympus Village headquarters, offering to testify against the cartel's leadership — including kingpin Oberon Church, to whom she was believed to be second in command.

Executive Agent Viola Trask described Sandoval's surrender as "by far the most notorious" voluntary arrest in FIA history. Sandoval was placed in protective custody, but the cartel responded with a mercenary hit squad that infiltrated FIA headquarters in July 3305 in an assassination attempt. The squad carried false identification to bypass security but was neutralised before reaching Sandoval. Her testimony ultimately provided the intelligence foundation for the FIA's dismantling of the Red Family, making her one of the most consequential informants in Federal narcotics enforcement history.

axel-cyprian.name: Axel Cyprian
axel-cyprian.bio: Axel Cyprian is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-11-05 to 3306-11-12. Closely associated with L.Y.S Corp, LTT 1935 Confederacy, Imperial Internal Security Service.

cmdr-boter.name: CMDR Boter
cmdr-boter.bio: CMDR Boter is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-08 to 3301-03-08. Closely associated with Imperial Slavers Association, Future of Synteini.

commander-felix-dyson.name: Commander Felix Dyson
commander-felix-dyson.bio: Commander Felix Dyson is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-11 to 3302-07-23. Closely associated with Diamond Frogs, Paladin Consortium. Commander Kermit Laphroaig praised his fellow mercenaries for their tenacity under hostile conditions.

elana-lorax.name: Elana Lorax
elana-lorax.bio: Elana Lorax is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-09-02 to 3302-09-02. Closely associated with Federation.

joy-senne.name: Joy Senne
joy-senne.bio: Joy Senne is a Diplomat in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-07-13 to 3309-02-07. Affiliated with Alliance. Notable activities include: Vox Galactica reports from the front lines as coalition forces battle Thargoid swarms while Salvation's superweapon nears completion.; A grassroots xeno-peace movement gains traction following the Battle of HIP 22460, promoting diplomatic dialogue with Thargoids through media figur...
joy-senne.bio_full:
Joy Senne is an ICE-caster and community liaison for the Thargoid Advocacy Project, a xeno-peace movement that advocated for diplomatic relations with the Thargoids. In late 3308, Senne distanced herself from radical anti-authoritarian protests that blamed superpower leaders for the Thargoid war, noting that many former xeno-peace members had abandoned the movement's principles.

Senne's ICE-cast provided a platform for debate about Thargoid policy, including interviews with Bernadette Wells of the Thargoid Advocacy Project, who rejected claims that the approaching rogue signal sources were hostile. Senne's measured approach contrasted with more militant activists like Heimar Borichev, and her withdrawal from the radical fringe demonstrated the fracture within the xeno-peace movement as the Maelstroms made diplomatic solutions appear increasingly untenable.

himari-grey.name: Himari Grey
himari-grey.bio: Himari Grey is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-12-14 to 3309-10-10. Affiliated with Interstellar Health Organisation, Vox Galactica, Vitadyne Labs. Notable activities include: The first humans rescued from Thargoid Titans arrive and survive extraction, with Dr Grey observing their physical and psychological state.; The IHO reviews Vitadyne Labs's nanomedicines amid an ethical debate: should revolutionary healthcare technology be freely distributed despite Utop...
himari-grey.bio_full:
Dr Himari Grey is a healthcare analyst who became a prominent voice in the ethical debate surrounding Vitadyne Labs's nanomedicines in January 3305. The Interstellar Health Organisation was reviewing the company's revolutionary healthcare technology, which Vitadyne admitted was based on advanced technology originally developed by Utopia.

Grey discussed the situation via Vox Galactica, noting that Pranav Antal had formally complained that replicating Utopian technology without permission was "tantamount to theft." She outlined the competing ethical considerations: many in the medical community argued that Utopia was selfish to hoard medicines capable of treating many illnesses and injuries, while investors had pumped millions into Vitadyne Labs convinced that profits would run into the billions. Grey warned that if nanomeds became a commercial commodity, "only the very wealthy will be able to afford Vitadyne's product." Her analysis exposed the fundamental tension between proprietary communal technology and galactic healthcare needs, framing a debate that would resonate throughout the pharmaceutical industry and influence the IHO's eventual ruling.

hector-mordanticus-duval.name: Hector Mordanticus Duval
hector-mordanticus-duval.bio: Hector Mordanticus Duval is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-12-02 to 3307-12-09. Closely associated with Nova Paresa, Imperial Herald. Hadrian Duval's wife Astrid gives birth to a son named Hector Mordanticus Duval, prompting celebrations across the Empire and a commodity gathering initiative in Paresa.

commander-alec-turner.name: Commander Alec Turner
commander-alec-turner.bio: Commander Alec Turner is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-30 to 3302-11-22. Closely associated with Buckyball Racing Club.

cedrik-stone.name: Cedrik Stone
cedrik-stone.bio: Cedrik Stone is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-05-09 to 3305-05-30. Closely associated with Zende Partners, Segnen Exchange.
cedrik-stone.bio_full: Cedrik Stone is a figure associated with frontier and independent operations. His activities have intersected with various mercenary, exploration and trading initiatives across the galaxy.

admiral-brennus.name: Admiral Brennus
admiral-brennus.bio: Admiral Brennus is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-05 to 3301-07-08. Closely associated with Emperor's Grace, Imperial Navy. Aisling Duval's anti-slavery activists were expelled from Rishair after Admiral Brennus of Emperor's Grace intervened. Grimnir Allvadderung and Admiral Brennus celebrated with mead and an axe-throwing contest.

karen-keish.name: Karen Keish
karen-keish.bio: Karen Keish is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-22 to 3302-05-06. Closely associated with Carmack Intergalactic Mining Association.

miyu-azusa.name: Miyu Azusa
miyu-azusa.bio: Miyu Azusa is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3311-04-01 to 3311-04-01. Closely associated with Imperial Navy.

francesca-wolfe.name: Francesca Wolfe
francesca-wolfe.bio: Francesca Wolfe is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-04-02 to 3307-10-19. Affiliated with Wallglass Investigations Agency, Azimuth Biochemicals. Notable activities include: Francesca Wolfe details the discovery of the Hesperus alongside the Scriveners Clan dredger in the Perseus Dark Region.; Pilots report new contact from 'Salvation' near the Hesperus and Adamastor.
francesca-wolfe.bio_full:
Francesca Wolfe is an investigative journalist and commentator on xenological and fringe-science topics. In mid-3307, she reported on pilots being contacted by the mysterious figure known as "Salvation" near the Hesperus and Adamastor megaships, documenting Commander Tyler Thorsen's account of receiving direct requests to locate old signal beacons that could help find survivors.

Wolfe's reporting highlighted the expanding network of pilot contacts that Salvation was building, as well as his apparent access to Azimuth Biochemicals' historical data from two centuries prior. Her work on the Hesperus mystery — alongside Erik Gunnarson's investigations — helped piece together the connections between the ghost ships, the Scriveners Clan and Salvation's hidden agenda, foreshadowing the eventual revelation of his true identity as a figure with deep ties to Azimuth's legacy.

elaine-boyd.name: Elaine Boyd
elaine-boyd.bio: Elaine Boyd is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-08-04 to 3302-04-23. Affiliated with Federal Times. Notable activities include: Encrypted data packages automatically sent by Elaine Boyd upon her death revealed a connection between Vice President Nigel Smeaton's death and the...; The Federal Times revealed that Agent Susan Monroe, whom Elaine Boyd was accused of murdering, was part of Vice President Nigel Smeaton's protectio...
elaine-boyd.bio_full:
Elaine Boyd was a Federal Times reporter who became a central figure in the Antares conspiracy scandal in 3301. Accused of murdering her partner, Agent Susan Monroe of the Presidential Protection Detail, Boyd went into hiding before her body was discovered in a low-rent hotel in Wyrd following an anonymous tip-off.

An off-the-record source revealed that a suicide note was found, allegedly stating that Boyd could no longer live with the guilt of killing her lover. The Federal Times refused to comment on her fate. Boyd's apparent suicide deepened the Federal scandal surrounding the Antares incident and Starship One conspiracy, adding a layer of personal tragedy to the political crisis that would eventually lead to the trial of Fleet Admiral Lucas Vincent.

criosx.name: Criosx
criosx.bio: Criosx is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-04 to 3302-04-04. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

andee-x-.name: Andee-X-
andee-x-.bio: Andee-X- is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-02-03 to 3307-02-03. Closely associated with Imperial Internal Security Service.

leo-magnus.name: Leo Magnus
leo-magnus.bio: Leo Magnus is a Terrorist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3306-10-27 to 3307-12-09. Affiliated with Nova Imperium, NMLA. Notable activities include: NMLA assassins attack Imperator Hadrian Duval at Dyson City in Paresa, severely wounding him.; Imperator Hadrian Augustus Duval of Nova Imperium marries his consort Astrid Minerva in a closed ceremony attended by Princess Aisling Duval.
leo-magnus.bio_full:
Leo Magnus is the Praetor and head of security for Nova Imperium, the isolationist movement led by Imperator Hadrian Augustus Duval. In November 3306, Magnus commented on Princess Aisling Duval's unorthodox intervention to save Hadrian following an NMLA assassination attempt, noting that while the Praetorian Guard appreciated Her Highness's assistance, it remained a mystery how the terrorists came so close to succeeding.

As Nova Imperium's chief security officer, Magnus oversees the protection of the movement's leadership and investigates threats against its members. His role places him at the intersection of Imperial politics and counter-terrorism, defending an organisation that the Empire has outlawed for sedition while maintaining its own security apparatus independent of the Imperial Guard.

commander-jayridium.name: Commander Jayridium
commander-jayridium.bio: Commander Jayridium is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-04-01 to 3303-04-01. Imperial pilots are defying the kill-on-sight order on Commander Salomé (Kahina Tijani Loren), offering escort services, fuel, and rewards to others willing to help protect her.

angelo-defries.name: Angelo Defries
angelo-defries.bio: Angelo Defries is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-09-18 to 3309-09-18. Closely associated with Wallglass. Wallglass confirms Zachary Rackham was the pirate lord 'Calico Zack', with evidence from Angelo Defries's archive causing high-profile supporters to withdraw.

felix-dyson.name: Felix Dyson
felix-dyson.bio: Felix Dyson is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-04 to 3302-05-17. Closely associated with Diamond Frogs, Pilots Federation.

ernesto-rios.name: Ernesto Rios
ernesto-rios.bio: Ernesto Rios is a key figure in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-11-30 to 3312-02-03. Affiliated with Imperial Navy, Aegis, Alliance. Notable activities include: Thargoid attacks intensify across the California, Coalsack, Pleiades, and Witch Head Nebulas, with anti-xeno squadrons struggling to repel unusuall...; Thargoid vessels continue to appear in over two dozen populated systems near nebulas, with organised pilot task forces achieving mixed success agai...
ernesto-rios.bio_full:
Ernesto Rios is a field correspondent for Vox Galactica who has reported from some of the most dangerous frontlines of the Thargoid conflicts. In August 3308, he published a widely circulated dispatch from the aftermath of the HIP 22460 massacre, describing the information blackout imposed by authorities and the refusal of medical personnel to grant press access to survivors aboard Azimuth Biotech's surviving megaships.

Rios's reporting has consistently highlighted the gap between official narratives and ground-level reality during the Thargoid war. His dispatches from HIP 22460 captured both the scale of human suffering and the deliberate obfuscation by military and corporate authorities, establishing him as one of the most courageous war correspondents covering the Second Thargoid War.

commander-ian-doncaster.name: Commander Ian Doncaster
commander-ian-doncaster.bio: Commander Ian Doncaster is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-17 to 3302-06-17.

peter.name: Peter
peter.bio: Peter is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-19 to 3301-07-19. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Sirius Corporation, Imperial Navy.

taja-gavaris.name: Taja Gavaris
taja-gavaris.bio: Taja Gavaris is a former pirate leader who blackmailed her way into Rackham Capital Investments as CFO following Aaron Salazar's death. Journalist Bryanna Blanco exposed her criminal history as a rival of Zachary Rackham, alleging she was eliminating his loyal supporters to seize control of the company.
taja-gavaris.bio_full: Taja Gavaris rose from pirate rival to corporate executive in one of the more notorious career transitions in Federal business history. Following the death of Rackham Capital Investments CFO Aaron Salazar in March 3305, Gavaris was installed as his replacement while CEO Zachary Rackham grieved. Federal Times journalist Bryanna Blanco exposed Gavaris's criminal background, revealing she had been a pirate rival of Rackham and used blackmail to force her way into the organisation. Blanco alleged that Gavaris was systematically eliminating Rackham's loyal supporters in a vendetta to seize control. Gavaris ultimately resigned as CFO in April 3305, though the criminal investigation Blanco demanded never materialised.

commander-denneb.name: Commander Denneb
commander-denneb.bio: Commander Denneb is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-05 to 3302-11-05.

margaux-hist.name: Margaux Hist
margaux-hist.bio: Margaux Hist is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-05 to 3304-08-02. Closely associated with Bonespire Publishing. Redcourt makes cryptic comments about being bounced across space and meat for the sausage factory, which his agent Margaux Hist dismisses as character development thinking. Agent Margaux Hist expresses hope the niche science-fiction genre will sell well enough to cover legal bills.
margaux-hist.bio_full:
Margaux Hist worked as a literary agent affiliated with Bonespire Publishing during the mid-3300s, representing authors operating within the niche science-fiction genre. Her professional responsibilities included managing client relationships, negotiating publishing contracts, and guiding the public presentation of her authors' work. In 3304, she found herself managing the increasingly erratic behaviour of Redcourt, an author whose cryptic public comments about being "bounced across space" and references to "meat for the sausage factory" raised concerns among readers and critics alike.

Hist's approach to these controversies reflected the pragmatism required of publishing professionals navigating unconventional talent. She dismissed Redcourt's more alarming statements as "character development thinking," while privately expressing hope that the book's sales would generate sufficient revenue to cover mounting legal bills. Her experience illustrated the challenges facing agents who represented artists whose creative impulses did not always align with conventional commercial or legal expectations.

quinn-damico.name: Quinn Damico
quinn-damico.bio: Quinn Damico is a councillor in the Aranbarahun system who defended the Far God cult's right to freedom of religion in 3304. While acknowledging the worshippers were strange, he insisted they were essentially harmless and warned that criminal acts against them, including incitement to violence, could result in prosecution.
quinn-damico.bio_full:
Quinn Damico serves as a councillor in the Aranbarahun system and became a notable defender of religious freedom during the controversy over the Far God cult in 3304. As public hostility toward the Thargoid-worshipping sect mounted—with anti-xeno campaigner Juanita Bishop demanding their expulsion—Damico took a measured stance. He acknowledged the cultists were strange but insisted they were essentially harmless, warning citizens that criminal acts against them, including incitement to violence, could result in prosecution.

Damico's defence of the Far God worshippers was grounded in the principle that freedom of religion was protected by law in all systems where the sect had a presence. His position contrasted sharply with more reactionary voices and demonstrated that even in times of heightened xenophobia, some officials remained committed to constitutional protections. The cult's later victimisation by other doomsayer groups and anti-xeno activists would validate Damico's assessment that they posed no security threat.

commander-morningstar.name: Commander Morningstar
commander-morningstar.bio: Commander Morningstar is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11.

hanna-darrold.name: Hanna Darrold
hanna-darrold.bio: Hanna Darrold is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-08-16 to 3305-08-16. Closely associated with Alliance. Local author Hanna Darrold releases the metafictional bestseller 'Chronicles of Olgrea'.

devin-kaneda.name: Devin Kaneda
devin-kaneda.bio: Devin Kaneda is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3310-10-15 to 3311-12-16. Closely associated with Zorgon Peterson, Faulcon DeLacy.

commander-alot.name: Commander Alot
commander-alot.bio: Commander Alot is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-22 to 3301-05-22. Closely associated with Buckyball Run. Commander Alot broke the galactic record for the Buckyball Run A* rally race twice in less than a month, reducing his time to Sagittarius A* from 11 hours 46 minutes to 9 hours 39 minutes. Commander Kligg subsequently surpassed Alot's record by 8 minutes using an Anaconda named 'Rub Tub'.

stateira-starcloak-eleshenar.name: Stateira 'Starcloak' Eleshenar
stateira-starcloak-eleshenar.bio: Stateira Starcloak Eleshenar is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-18 to 3301-08-18. Closely associated with Interstellar Press, Office of Imperial Statistics, Facece Empire Party. Early reviews from Commanders Corrigendum and Stateira 'Starcloak' Eleshenar praised its handling and combat performance.

leonard-chamberlain.name: Léonard Chamberlain
leonard-chamberlain.bio: Léonard Chamberlain is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-23 to 3301-05-22. Closely associated with Buckyball Run.

dr-james-morel.name: Dr James Morel
dr-james-morel.bio: Dr James Morel is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-01 to 3302-11-01. Closely associated with Colonia Citizens Network, Pilots Federation. Commander Alesia of the Pilots Federation recorded the first data, and mycologist Dr James Morel identified two species visually from telemetry and urged explorers to handle specimens with care.

alot.name: Alot
alot.bio: Alot is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-26 to 3302-01-26. Closely associated with Buckyball Racing Club. Commander Alot set a new Buckyball record by traveling from Sol to Sagittarius A* in 7 hours, 56 minutes, and 41 seconds, breaking the eight-hour barrier.

rainy-day.name: Rainy Day
rainy-day.bio: Rainy Day is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club. Light-class rounds featured fast-paced jousting with Bodmans and Rainy Day advancing.

professor-ishmael-palin.name: Professor Ishmael Palin
professor-ishmael-palin.bio: Professor Ishmael Palin is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-10-26 to 3302-10-27. Closely associated with Palin Institute. A Farragut-class Battlecruiser blockaded Maia A 3 a near Professor Ishmael Palin's research base, redirecting pilots who strayed too close. Alliance Prime Minister Edmund Mahon called it "an egregious act of oppression" and Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval demanded the Federation curtail restrictions on Palin's freedoms.

zimm_macugz.name: Zimm_Macugz
zimm_macugz.bio: Zimm_Macugz is a Commander mentioned in GalNet reports from the Elite Dangerous universe.

gryph-jones.name: Gryph Jones
gryph-jones.bio: Gryph Jones is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-17 to 3301-05-09. A local farmer, Gryph Jones, voiced cynicism about Federal intentions and hoped no violence would occur.

verity-dexter.name: Verity Dexter
verity-dexter.bio: Verity Dexter is a Marlinist politician who led the Marlinism Reformation Party and ran for prime consul of the Marlinist Consulate in 3307. She promised to speak for the Neo-Marlinist fringe and sought Imperial patronage through Senator Lorcan Scordato. She ultimately lost the election to Kayode Tau of the Free Marlinist Movement.
verity-dexter.bio_full: Verity Dexter is a Marlinist politician who led the Marlinism Reformation Party and ran for prime consul of the Marlinist Consulate in 3307. She promised to speak for the Neo-Marlinist fringe—a position that put her in direct opposition to Kayode Tau of the Free Marlinist Movement. Senator Lorcan Scordato championed her bid and proposed she be recognised as an Imperial patron to represent pro-Marlinist citizens of the Empire. Chancellor Blaine approved the patronage despite protests. Dexter ultimately lost the election to Tau, with her defeat seen as a rejection of NMLA-aligned politics.

commander-tverez.name: Commander T'Verez
commander-tverez.bio: Commander T'Verez is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-03-16 to 3309-03-16. Closely associated with Universal Cartographics.

consuela-knight.name: Consuela Knight
consuela-knight.bio: Consuela Knight is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-01-10 to 3305-02-02. Closely associated with The Sovereign, The Rewired, Astrogator Tours. Journalist Flint 'Firemaker' Lafosse fuels speculation about Consuela Knight's disappearance, suggesting causes ranging from Thargoid weapons to the Far God consuming organic tissue in hyperspace. The Consuela Knight disappearance causes a drop in consumer confidence for commercial space travel, with luxury yacht sales plummeting and cruise bookings being cancelled across the galaxy.
consuela-knight.bio_full: Consuela Knight is a media personality and news anchor who has reported on significant galactic events. Her work has contributed to public discourse on matters ranging from political scandals to military conflicts.

bethany-blake.name: Bethany Blake
bethany-blake.bio: Bethany Blake is a Terrorist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-04-06 to 3308-09-12. Affiliated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Proactive Detection Bureau, Federal Congress. Notable activities include: The Federal Intelligence Agency establishes the Proactive Detection Bureau to scan civilian communications for terrorist activity following congres...; The Azaladshu Free faction secedes from the Federation, declaring its four systems independent in protest against surveillance laws.
bethany-blake.bio_full:
Bethany Blake is the Deputy Director of the Federal Intelligence Agency who led a multi-system crackdown against the Red Family narcotics syndicate in 3308. The operation was made possible by intelligence gathered through the Proactive Detection Bureau, the Federal surveillance system established in 3307 following NMLA attacks.

Blake's public statement to the Federal Times confirmed that the FIA's algorithms had intercepted key messages identifying Red Family's allies within local security forces and legal businesses, enabling mass arrests across over a dozen Federal systems. Her candid admission that "the Proactive Detection Bureau monitors all communications within the Federation" revealed how counter-terrorism surveillance infrastructure was rapidly repurposed for conventional law enforcement, raising significant civil liberties concerns.

professor-d-luffy.name: Professor D Luffy
professor-d-luffy.bio: Professor D Luffy is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-11-26 to 3302-04-22. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Professor D Luffy at Bond Hub in the Varati system appeals for meta-alloys to reverse the technological plague affecting stations. Professor D Luffy's team at Bond Hub in the Varati system successfully restores the station to full operation through weeks of meta-alloy harvesting, matching the success achieved at Obsidian Orbital.

commander-ranger-one.name: Commander Ranger-One
commander-ranger-one.bio: Commander Ranger-One is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-10-13 to 3303-10-13. Closely associated with Secret Billionaires. Commander Ranger-One thanked the community for restoring peace and stability.

shanaeri-rynale.name: Shanaeri Rynale
shanaeri-rynale.bio: Shanaeri Rynale is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-05 to 3302-11-05.

georgio-algeria.name: Georgio Algeria
georgio-algeria.bio: The flamboyant president of the Kappa Fornacis Farmers Union, whose defiant stand against Federal prohibition made him the face of the Onionhead conflict.
georgio-algeria.bio_full:
Georgio Algeria led the Kappa Fornacis Farmers Union with a style more reminiscent of a revolutionary poet than an agricultural lobbyist. In March 3301, six months after Onionhead was banned in Federal space, he addressed crowds at Harvestport with a message of unapologetic defiance: "You can't stop the crop. It's always out there, man. That's nature, that's just how it works."

His declaration that "the people know what they want, and what they want is 100% organic, original blend Onionhead" transformed a local narcotics dispute into a symbol of Federal overreach. Algeria's refusal to capitulate set in motion a conflict that would draw in Federal military forces, cementing his place as one of the early 3300s' most colourful anti-establishment figures.

ewan-klein.name: Ewan Klein
ewan-klein.bio: Ewan Klein is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3310-09-17 to 3310-09-17. Closely associated with Federal Congress.

felicity-farseer.name: Felicity Farseer
felicity-farseer.bio: Felicity Farseer is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-17 to 3302-06-17.

kate-panamen.name: Kate Panamen
kate-panamen.bio: Kate Panamen is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-02-25 to 3303-02-25. Closely associated with Mars High Astrocartography Institute. Kate Panamen of the Mars High Astrocartography Institute calls the event peculiar.

pascal-roux.name: Pascal Roux
pascal-roux.bio: Pascal Roux is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-12-06 to 3301-12-06. Closely associated with Gutamaya Shipyards, Imperial Herald.

doveenigma13.name: DoveEnigma13
doveenigma13.bio: DoveEnigma13 is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-02-01 to 3304-02-01. Closely associated with Colonia Council. The Dove Enigma was commissioned by the Colonia Council in commemoration of Commander DoveEnigma13 and is the destination of the Enigma Expedition.

lishan-abara.name: Lishan Abara
lishan-abara.bio: Lishan Abara is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-10-29 to 3309-12-15. Closely associated with Colonia Council, Holloway Bioscience Institute.

commander-dr-simms.name: Commander Dr Simms
commander-dr-simms.bio: Commander Dr Simms is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-18 to 3302-06-18.

frederick-yamamoto.name: Frederick Yamamoto
frederick-yamamoto.bio: Frederick Yamamoto is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-11-21 to 3305-06-21. Affiliated with Alliance, Alliance Defence Force. Notable activities include: President Gibson Kincaid is removed from office by the Alliance Assembly on charges of treason, murder and corruption, and is detained while attemp...; President Gibson Kincaid assumes direct command of the Zaonce fleet through Admiral Frederick Yamamoto, bypassing the ADF command structure in a sh...
frederick-yamamoto.bio_full:
Admiral Frederick Yamamoto was the head of the Alliance fleet in Zaonce who was arrested in June 3305 for the assassination of former Alliance presidential candidate Fazia Silva. A private investigation by Tashmira Silva, Fazia's sister and CEO of Silva Holdings Inc, hired the Wallglass Investigations Agency to uncover the truth after the official inquiry closed without resolution.

The Wallglass report identified that Yamamoto had personally arranged to have Fazia killed during the presidential election campaign, presumably to remove her political threat to his friend Gibson Kincaid. Alliance Interpol verified the report and detained Yamamoto pending trial, placing the Zaonce fleet under joint command of the Council of Admirals. Yamamoto's arrest exposed a deep conspiracy within the Alliance military-political establishment and triggered the eventual impeachment of President Kincaid.

ophelia-kaufmann.name: Ophelia Kaufmann
ophelia-kaufmann.bio: Ophelia Kaufmann is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-11-23 to 3306-12-08. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Alliance. Professor Ophelia Kaufmann links the instability to political tensions between the Empire and Federation.

gan-romero.name: Gan Romero
gan-romero.bio: Gan Romero is a former military veteran who stole a Diamondback Explorer from Fort Dixon in the Vega system in April 3305. He bypassed all security protocols and flew the ship into deep space despite having no piloting experience, leaving investigators baffled.
gan-romero.bio_full: Gan Romero is a former military veteran who became the centre of one of the era's most bizarre criminal mysteries. In April 3305, he stole a Diamondback Explorer from Fort Dixon in the Vega system, bypassing all security protocols and authorisation checks despite having no piloting experience. Station security was at a loss to explain how he gained entry to a docked and sealed ship and flew out unchallenged. The case deepened when investigators discovered Romero had been experiencing vivid dreams that may have driven his actions, raising questions about possible telepathic alien influence.

lilith-galloway.name: Lilith Galloway
lilith-galloway.bio: Lilith Galloway is a Engineer in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-06-01 to 3305-04-17. Affiliated with Aegis. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the Socho system being overtaken by the Socho Gold Raiders, Aegis's Eagle Eye success in repelling Thargoids, five ships de...; The campaign to repair starports in the Pleiades Nebula receives huge quantities of construction materials.
lilith-galloway.bio_full:
Lilith Galloway is a Senior Engineer with Aegis who played a key role in the organisation's Guardian technology programme. In April 3305, she announced Aegis's partnership with engineer Ram Tah to manufacture Guardian-related technology on a larger scale, bringing Aegis's considerable resources to bear on the production of hybrid weaponry.

Galloway confirmed that technology brokers would remain licensed distributors of the Trident, Javelin and Lance XG fighters. Her leadership in the Aegis-Ram Tah partnership helped institutionalise Guardian technology research within humanity's primary anti-xeno organisation, ensuring sustained development of the hybrid modules that became critical in the fight against the Thargoids.

dinah-law.name: Dinah Law
dinah-law.bio: Dinah Law is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-06-21 to 3304-06-24. Closely associated with Alliance Interpol, League of Reparation, INRA. Chief Inspector Kay Kilbride foils a League of Reparation assassination attempt on Dinah Law, a descendant of INRA employee Trystan Law.

carl-simmons.name: Carl Simmons
carl-simmons.bio: Carl Simmons is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-06-30 to 3302-03-23. Affiliated with Newton Dock Medical. Notable activities include: Medical personnel at Hart Station praised 765 independent pilots who delivered medicines to the Bast system.; Chief Medical Officer Carl Simmons confirmed isolated Cerberus Plague incidents in Dajoar, Eleu, and 20 Ophiuchi, believed to be travellers from BD...
carl-simmons.bio_full:
Carl Simmons is the Chief Medical Officer of Newton Dock in the BD-02 4304 system who led the response to the Cerberus Plague outbreak in 3301. He confirmed isolated incidents of the plague in Dajoar, Eleu and 20 Ophiuchi, believed to be travellers from BD-02 4304 before restrictions were imposed, and initiated containment operations to prevent full outbreaks.

Simmons called on independent pilots to help contain the disease and confirmed that the name "Cerberus Plague" came from the organism's unusual three-pronged structure. His leadership during the crisis exemplified the critical role of medical professionals in coordinating inter-system responses to galactic health emergencies, and his work at Newton Dock became a model for subsequent plague containment efforts.

femi-abram.name: Femi Abram
femi-abram.bio: Femi Abram is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-06-09 to 3304-06-10. Closely associated with Garden City security.

jeremy-archer.name: Jeremy Archer
