jeremy-archer.bio: Jeremy Archer is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3310-11-07 to 3310-11-07. Closely associated with Utopia.

ronan-brock.name: Ronan Brock
ronan-brock.bio: Ronan Brock is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-02-17 to 3308-02-17. Closely associated with NMLA, Darkwater Inc, Imperial Navy.

laura-bishop.name: Laura Bishop
laura-bishop.bio: Laura Bishop is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-29 to 3301-10-29. Technical supervisor Laura Bishop reported power outages and widespread system failures over the past 24 hours, with the cause still under investigation.

arlo-cortez.name: Arlo Cortez
arlo-cortez.bio: Arlo Cortez is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-13 to 3302-05-13. Arlo Cortez, a member of Jasmina Halsey's personal staff, rebuffs conspiracy theorist Ricardo Bentonio's claims that Halsey has been silenced by governmental powers.

jarah-kael.name: Jarah Kael
jarah-kael.bio: Jarah Kael is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-09-22 to 3303-09-22. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Aegis. Lieutenant Jarah Kael of the Federal Navy addresses rumours that Thargoids attacked in self-defence, stating that black box data from the Farragut-class Battlecruiser proves the attack was unprovoked.

commander-jack-hilding.name: Commander Jack Hilding
commander-jack-hilding.bio: Commander Jack Hilding is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-11-09 to 3301-11-09. Closely associated with Imperial Navy, Cayutorme Syndicate. Imperial Navy forces and auxiliary commanders score major victories against the Cayutorme Syndicate fleet, which may be forced to surrender or face destruction as it deploys reinforcements.

guinevere-lavigny.name: Guinevere Lavigny
guinevere-lavigny.bio: Guinevere Lavigny is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-07-03 to 3309-08-18. Closely associated with Imperial Palace. Lady Florence Lavigny suffers a sudden illness, prompting Emperor Arissa to cancel all appointments; family members including Hadrian send well-wishes in an apparent reconciliation gesture. Lady Florence Lavigny's recovery prompts calls for Imperial Family unity, with speculation that she could heal rifts between Arissa, Aisling, and Hadrian Duval.

king-justice-ii.name: King Justice II
king-justice-ii.bio: King Justice II is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-19 to 3301-07-31. Closely associated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Justice Party. No official statement was made, but speculation centres on his close relations with local rulers King Justice II of the Justice Party and Supreme Leader Anxo Lino of BD-22 3573 Flag. Marling presented evidence that Xander received financial support from local leaders King Justice II and Supreme Leader Anxo Lino, causing a dramatic decrease in Federation popularity in the sector.

commander-saool.name: Commander Saool
commander-saool.bio: Commander Saool is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-28 to 3302-04-28. Closely associated with Alliance, Spinward Marches Alliance Concern. Commanders Saool and Dennehy coordinate the effort.

polly-cartesius.name: Polly Cartesius
polly-cartesius.bio: Polly Cartesius is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-03 to 3304-08-11. Closely associated with Imperial Internal Security Service, Alliance, League of Reparation. Deputy Inspector Mara Klatt reports that Polly Cartesius, daughter of Senator Nestor Cartesius murdered by the League of Reparation, fired a concealed laser firearm from the visitors' gallery. Polly Cartesius is extradited to the IISS and taken to Capitol for trial for attempted murder.

broker-mrozak.name: Broker Mrozak
broker-mrozak.bio: Broker Mrozak is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11. Closely associated with Alliance. Top contributors included Broker Mrozak, Broker HawX, Tycoon Ace Rimzy, Tycoon Thalios Abraxas and Broker Del Boy.

blanca-carbonell.name: Blanca Carbonell
blanca-carbonell.bio: Blanca Carbonell is a ceo in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-06-03 to 3307-06-03. Closely associated with Core Dynamics, Pilots Federation. CEO Owen McKenna vows to wipe out Rochester's 'deranged cult' while Jupiter Division VP Blanca Carbonell calls for supporters to defend corporate rule.

commander-noir1787.name: Commander NOIR1787
commander-noir1787.bio: Commander NOIR1787 is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-22 to 3302-03-22. Closely associated with Alliance, Interstellar Press, Radio Sidewinder.

luria.name: Luria
luria.bio: Luria is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-21 to 3308-11-21.

soundwave.name: Soundwave
soundwave.bio: Soundwave is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-09 to 3301-10-09. Closely associated with Fuel Rats, Olympus Corporation.

arnold-cochran.name: Arnold Cochran
arnold-cochran.bio: Arnold Cochran is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-05-11 to 3304-05-18. Closely associated with Moritasgus Imperial Corporation. Superintendent Arnold Cochran stated the expanded facilities can now safely contain some of the Empire's worst criminals.

earl-prawnetto.name: Earl Prawnetto
earl-prawnetto.bio: Earl Prawnetto is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-16 to 3301-05-16. Closely associated with Eotienses Citizens' Forum. Top contributors honoured include Viscount Plo Koon, Baron Coiling Dragon, Earl Prawnetto, Earl Morton and Baron Kosmetas.

rodion-stathos.name: Rodion Stathos
rodion-stathos.bio: Rodion Stathos is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-11-26 to 3306-11-26. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Alliance. Rodion Stathos, funded by pharmaceutical and bioengineering companies.

commander-wobblytickle.name: Commander Wobblytickle
commander-wobblytickle.bio: Commander Wobblytickle is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-07 to 3302-06-07. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

ramesh-thorne.name: Ramesh Thorne
ramesh-thorne.bio: Ramesh Thorne is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-09-20 to 3304-11-24. Affiliated with Federal Security Service, Achilles Corporation, Mars Tribune. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Gibson Kincaid's re-election as Alliance President, the foiled raid on Ram Tah's Phoenix Base, the FSS targeting The Mars T...; Weekly summary covering the Alliance Assembly's decision to create the Office of the Alliance President without executive powers, Sirius Corporatio...
ramesh-thorne.bio_full:
Lieutenant Inspector Ramesh Thorne is an officer of the Federal Security Service who led the investigation into the spy robot scandal of 3304. The case began when a PA912 administration robot manufactured by Achilles Corporation exposed corporate fraud during a shareholder meeting, and Thorne's inquiry subsequently uncovered dozens of similar robots fitted with concealed surveillance programs targeting prominent Federal citizens.

Thorne's investigation established that the robots' owners included former congressman Morgan Unwin, actor Tomas Turai, and public-relations consultant Anya Blackriver — all of whom had been subjects of exclusives published by the Mars Tribune. The FSS used Thorne's findings to interview Tribune staff and explore links between corporate surveillance and journalistic sourcing, making the case one of the most significant privacy scandals in recent Federal history.

commander-falchion.name: Commander Falchion
commander-falchion.bio: Commander Falchion is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-09-09 to 3302-09-09. Closely associated with Sports Zeta Weekly. Commander Falchion of the Chi Orionis system has won the Melee Masters arena competition, using a ruse in the final bout to draw their opponent into firing range.

nigel-smeaton.name: Nigel Smeaton
nigel-smeaton.bio: Nigel Smeaton is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-07-29 to 3302-04-23. Affiliated with Federal Times, Core Dynamics. Notable activities include: Encrypted data packages automatically sent by Elaine Boyd upon her death revealed a connection between Vice President Nigel Smeaton's death and the...; The Federal Times revealed that Agent Susan Monroe, whom Elaine Boyd was accused of murdering, was part of Vice President Nigel Smeaton's protectio...
nigel-smeaton.bio_full:
Nigel Smeaton was the Vice President of the Federation whose death in early 3301 was officially declared an accident, though circumstances suggested foul play. Encrypted data packages sent automatically by journalist Elaine Boyd upon her death revealed that Smeaton was related to a crew member aboard the Highliner Antares, which disappeared on its maiden flight 50 years earlier. He had been conducting a private off-the-books investigation into the incident, suspecting sabotage rather than drive component failure.

Smeaton had spoken to senior officers involved in the original Antares inquiry, and Boyd's information implied he may have been killed to stop his investigation. The revelation linked his death to the Antares Incident and Core Dynamics, suggesting a far-reaching conspiracy spanning decades. Smeaton's case remains one of the most significant unsolved political mysteries in Federal history, exposing the dangerous intersection of corporate power and government secrecy.

tori-theopolis.name: Tori Theopolis
tori-theopolis.bio: Tori Theopolis is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-14 to 3304-08-17. Closely associated with Federal Grand Lottery, Cobra Wing, Church of Eternal Void. Spokesperson Tori Theopolis asks citizens to check with lottery players they know.
tori-theopolis.bio_full:
Tori Theopolis served as a public spokesperson during the mid-3300s, most notably representing the Federal Grand Lottery during a period of significant public interest in the organisation's activities. Her role required her to communicate with citizens across Federal space, encouraging participation in lottery programmes that funded various government and charitable initiatives. The position placed her within a network of public relations professionals who shaped how Federal institutions presented themselves to the populations they served.

Beyond her work with the lottery, Theopolis maintained connections to both Cobra Wing and the Church of Eternal Void, suggesting either personal affiliations or professional relationships that spanned disparate organisational cultures. Her public appeal for citizens to check with lottery players they knew demonstrated a communications strategy designed to leverage social networks rather than relying solely on official channels. This approach reflected broader trends in Federal public engagement during an era of increasing media fragmentation and decentralised information flow.

commander-moonweb.name: Commander MoonWeb
commander-moonweb.bio: Commander MoonWeb is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-10-22 to 3302-10-22. Closely associated with Earth Defence Fleet, Canonn.

ramon-lamor.name: Ramon Lamor
ramon-lamor.bio: Ramon Lamor is the Deputy Communications Officer of Humason Orbital in the Carns system. In July 3301, he announced plans to shift the system from mining to high-tech operations, acquiring robotics for new product lines and replacing extraction and industrial concerns.
ramon-lamor.bio_full: Ramon Lamor serves as Deputy Communications Officer of Humason Orbital in the Carns system. In July 3301, he announced ambitious plans to shift the system's economy from mining to high-tech operations after reports suggested mining would become uneconomical. Lamor outlined an extensive acquisition programme for robotics to support new product lines, which would replace both extraction and industrial concerns. He pledged financial and logistical support to existing businesses during the transition, framing the change as an opportunity for Carns to become a greater player in the regional economy.

taniyah-sharpe.name: Taniyah Sharpe
taniyah-sharpe.bio: Taniyah Sharpe is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-02-28 to 3305-03-07. Closely associated with Macrosphere, DS Leonis Industries.

ishmael-palin.name: Ishmael Palin
ishmael-palin.bio: Professor Ishmael Palin is a leading expert on Thargoid technology and founder of the Palin Institute. Originally with the Federal Homeland Scientific Council, he went independent in 3301 after his Unknown Artefact research was terminated. He survived a kidnapping in 3302, retired from the Institute's directorship, and established himself as an engineer at Abel Laboratory in the Arque system. Palin has made crucial contributions to meta-alloy research, Thargoid spire site analysis, and hybrid Guardian-Thargoid technology.
ishmael-palin.bio_full:
Professor Ishmael Palin began his career with the Federation's Homeland Scientific Council, leading research into Unknown Artefacts in September 3301. The programme was abruptly terminated after one week under external pressure, prompting Palin to establish the independent Palin Institute at Christian Dock in October 3301. He relocated to Obsidian Orbital in the Maia system by early 3302, issuing appeals for meta-alloy deliveries to counter the technological plague affecting starports.

On 9 February 3302, Palin was kidnapped en route to Maia B1BA by black-clad assailants who interrogated him for days about his research. Discovered a month later in escape pods recovered from the Blue Hand Gang, he described his captors as representing "control, oppression, and the obviation of civil liberties." The ordeal led him to retire from the Palin Institute in April 3302, passing directorship to Professor Cora Shaw, though he continued independent research and established himself as an engineer specialising in thrusters and frame shift drives.

Forced to evacuate Maia by a Thargoid offensive in July 3305, Palin relocated to Abel Laboratory in the Arque system. He remained an active researcher throughout the conflict, collaborating with Ram Tah on hybrid Guardian-Thargoid artefacts in 3308 and announcing a breakthrough in Thargoid spire site analysis in November 3309. His work contributed directly to the Guardian nanite torpedo project in early 3310, making him one of the most consulted scientists in the anti-xeno effort.

julissa-silver.name: Julissa Silver
julissa-silver.bio: Julissa Silver is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-02 to 3301-10-02. Closely associated with Bacon Cats.

patrician-mitchell.name: Patrician Mitchell
patrician-mitchell.bio: Patrician Mitchell is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-02-02 to 3304-02-02. Closely associated with Angeli Imperial Enterprises. Spokesperson Patrician Mitchell praised participating pilots and recommended several wines and beers from the establishment.

saeed-mcnamara.name: Saeed McNamara
saeed-mcnamara.bio: Saeed McNamara is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-03 to 3301-09-03. Closely associated with Interstellar Press, Utopia. McNamara declined to address rumors that subjects emerge with radically altered personalities.

itsuko-harada.name: Itsuko Harada
itsuko-harada.bio: Itsuko Harada is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-11-08 to 3308-06-09. Closely associated with Upaniklis Vision Incorporated, Interstellar Health Organisation.

tyllerius-adle-iii.name: Tyllerius Adle III
tyllerius-adle-iii.bio: Tyllerius Adle III is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-06-22 to 3301-07-16. Closely associated with Adle's Armada, Federation. Adle's Armada, a long-standing Federal-leaning vigilante group, declared itself a sovereign power independent of all galactic powers. Post Commander Tyllerius Adle originally pulled his force from a classified inter-factional combat force in 3200, rebranding as Adle's Armada.
tyllerius-adle-iii.bio_full:
Post Commander Tyllerius Adle III founded what would become one of the most recognisable independent military organisations in the galaxy when he extracted his force from a classified inter-factional combat unit in 3200 and rebranded it as Adle's Armada. This decision to abandon official service in favour of independent operations established a template for vigilante groups that would operate across Federal space for decades to come. His military background provided the Armada with professional discipline and tactical expertise that distinguished it from less organised mercenary bands.

In mid-3301, Adle made the momentous declaration that his organisation would function as a sovereign power independent of all galactic authorities, including the Federation with which it had traditionally aligned. This assertion of independence reflected a broader trend among powerful non-state actors seeking autonomy from superpower oversight. Adle's leadership demonstrated how individual commanders with sufficient resources and loyal followings could establish viable alternatives to traditional political structures, challenging the monopoly that superpowers claimed over organised military force.

general-kendrick.name: General Kendrick
general-kendrick.bio: General Kendrick is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-02-21 to 3305-02-28. Closely associated with Namab Purple Brothers, Drevlyada League. A long-standing personal rivalry between General Kendrick of the Namab Purple Brothers and Marshal Cooper of the Drevlyada League escalates into open conflict in the Drevlyada system.

kulzar.name: Kulzar
kulzar.bio: Kulzar is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-20 to 3301-08-20. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Alliance.

admiral-yorke.name: Admiral Yorke
admiral-yorke.bio: A Federal Navy admiral who led the successful defence of the Daramo system in mid-3302, Yorke became notorious for his inflammatory post-battle rhetoric targeting the Empire.
admiral-yorke.bio_full:
Admiral Yorke commanded Federal forces during the Battle of Daramo in June 3302, coordinating the Independents of Daramo and GR 316 Silver Universal Group in a three-day campaign that repelled both Imperial and pirate incursions. His tactical leadership proved decisive in preserving Federal control of a system that both superpowers had claimed as strategically vital.

Yorke's post-victory statement, however, nearly overshadowed the military achievement itself. He publicly mocked the Empire as "nothing more than a gaggle of clueless colonists on Achenar 6d" while the Federation controlled over a thousand systems, deliberately using the word "enemies" to describe the rival superpower. The remarks triggered a diplomatic firestorm that demonstrated how even routine territorial disputes could escalate into existential rhetorical confrontations between the galaxy's dominant powers.

commander-josh-hawkins.name: Commander Josh Hawkins
commander-josh-hawkins.bio: Commander Josh Hawkins is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-19 to 3302-04-19. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Commander Josh Hawkins recovers an escape pod containing Canonn scientist Shannon Day.

commander-zenith-ddraiglas.name: Commander Zenith Ddraiglas
commander-zenith-ddraiglas.bio: Commander Zenith Ddraiglas is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-17 to 3302-03-17. Closely associated with Alliance.

henrik-de-lacerda.name: Henrik de Lacerda
henrik-de-lacerda.bio: Henrik de Lacerda is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-06-29 to 3304-11-29. Closely associated with Aegis. Senior engineer Henrik de Lacerda explains that new meta-alloy application procedures require only extremely small quantities to shield systems from disruption.

barnabas-cole.name: Barnabas Cole
barnabas-cole.bio: Barnabas Cole is a Pirate in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-12-06 to 3305-04-11. Affiliated with Children of Tothos, Federal Intelligence Agency. Notable activities include: The Federal Intelligence Agency reveals that the Children of Tothos cult has stolen a portable nuclear weapon called the Lucifer Device from a rese...; The Children of Tothos seize control of Archambault Terminal in the Chun Tstar system, threatening to detonate the Lucifer Device and forcing the F...
barnabas-cole.bio_full:
Barnabas Cole was the leader of the Children of Tothos, an apocalyptic cult that seized Archambault Terminal in early 3305 and threatened to detonate a nuclear weapon known as the Lucifer Device. Cole orchestrated a campaign of mass-sacrifice ceremonies intended to summon the deity Tothos by killing millions of starport inhabitants.

In April 3305, as Cole prepared to activate the Lucifer Device, he was shot dead by Senior Agent Rochelle Karim of the Federal Intelligence Agency, who had infiltrated the cult by posing as a worshipper. The FIA's deep-cover operation — which included staging the death of a team member to gain access — successfully disarmed the device and arrested Cole's acolytes. The Children of Tothos incident demonstrated both the lethal threat posed by apocalyptic cults and the effectiveness of intelligence infiltration in preventing mass-casualty terrorism.

morag-halloran.name: Morag Halloran
morag-halloran.bio: Morag Halloran is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3306-11-12 to 3308-08-25. Affiliated with Alliance, Salvation, Azimuth Biotech. Notable activities include: Salvation confirms his anti-xeno superweapons successfully routed Thargoids from Delphi, Maia and Merope, and urges unity behind his crusade while ...; Commodore Morag Halloran reveals that hundreds of naval officers from all three superpowers and Sirius have resigned to join Salvation's anti-xeno ...
morag-halloran.bio_full:
Commodore Morag Halloran is an Alliance naval officer who defected from the Alliance Defence Force to join Salvation's anti-xeno project in 3308, becoming one of hundreds of officers from all three superpowers who resigned their commissions to serve Azimuth Biochemicals' experimental weapons programme. Her defection exemplified the crisis of confidence that plagued military establishments during the Second Thargoid War, when conventional forces proved unable to halt the Maelstrom onslaught and Salvation's superweapons offered seemingly miraculous results.

Halloran's decision to abandon the ADF for Azimuth was politically explosive, forcing Alliance leaders to confront the inadequacy of their own military capabilities and the seductive appeal of unethical shortcuts. Her subsequent role in Salvation's operations — coordinating naval assets and personnel drawn from multiple superpowers — demonstrated both her tactical competence and the dangerous erosion of institutional loyalty that Azimuth's success provoked. The failure of the Proteus Wave left Halloran and her fellow defectors professionally and morally stranded.

simion-petrescu.name: Simion Petrescu
simion-petrescu.bio: Simion Petrescu is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-09-17 to 3307-09-30. Closely associated with EG Union, Federation.

doctor-elana-lorax.name: Doctor Elana Lorax
doctor-elana-lorax.bio: Doctor Elana Lorax is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-25 to 3302-02-25. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Doctor Elana Lorax, a leading xeno biologist, condemns the destruction of barnacles for meta-alloys.

jacob-harris.name: Jacob Harris
jacob-harris.bio: Jacob Harris is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-15 to 3302-04-23. Closely associated with Federal Times, Imperial Senate, Core Dynamics. Federal politician Jacob Harris claims the destruction of Starship One was deliberate sabotage by Imperial agents, not mechanical failure.

commander-wolzan.name: Commander Wolzan
commander-wolzan.bio: Commander Wolzan is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-25 to 3301-05-25. Closely associated with Faveol family, Shadow Navy, Crimson Fortune Company. Crimson Fortune Company CEO Ellie Blossum denounced claims that Commander Wolzan and the Shadow Navy were terrorists.

mikalus.name: Mikalus
mikalus.bio: Mikalus is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-22 to 3301-09-17. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Interstellar Press.

nodus-cursorius.name: Nodus Cursorius
nodus-cursorius.bio: Nodus Cursorius is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-23 to 3302-08-23. Closely associated with Children of Raxxla.

commander-matzov.name: Commander Matzov
commander-matzov.bio: Commander Matzov is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-08 to 3302-03-14. Closely associated with Pan Galactic Mining Corp, Federal Bar Council.

juanita-bishop.name: Juanita Bishop
juanita-bishop.bio: Juanita Bishop is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-06-30 to 3304-12-22. Affiliated with Far God cult, Federal Congress, Federal Intelligence Agency. Notable activities include: The Far God cult, a fringe religion worshipping Thargoids, faces widespread mistrust and hostility.; The Church of Eternal Void, which worships the Guardians, declares war on the Far God cult.
juanita-bishop.bio_full:
Juanita Bishop is an anti-xeno campaigner who rose to prominence in 3304 through her vocal condemnation of the Far God cult, a fringe religion worshipping the Thargoids. Building a following on fear and paranoia, she demanded that governments expel cult members and accused them of being alien collaborators infiltrating human society.

In August 3304, Bishop launched an independent candidacy for Federal Congress, promising to outlaw the Far God sect. She later called for capital punishment of all its adherents, triggering considerable debate among congressmen. Her campaign collapsed in October after journalist Gethin Okonkwo's investigation found no evidence linking the cult to the Thargoids, and Congress condemned her for cultivating civil unrest and violating religious freedom. She was later described as a disgraced politician when she unsuccessfully demanded a ban on Okonkwo's book about the sect.

vienna-langhorne.name: Vienna Langhorne
vienna-langhorne.bio: Vienna Langhorne is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-28 to 3304-07-29. Closely associated with Blackshadow Productions, Andromedaries Superlative Society, Church of Eternal Void. Original creator Vienna Langhorne expresses dismay.

hector-lemans.name: Hector LeMans
hector-lemans.bio: Hector LeMans is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-22 to 3302-01-22. Closely associated with Buckyball Racing Club. Station entertainment director Hector LeMans dismissed the allegations and warned racers about strict speed limits.

daniel-parry.name: Daniel Parry
daniel-parry.bio: Daniel Parry is a Rear Admiral in the Federal Navy and the Federal military liaison to Aegis. In 3309, he coordinated Federal involvement in anti-xeno activities and reported on the first pathfinder missions into the Maelstroms.
daniel-parry.bio_full: Daniel Parry serves as a Rear Admiral in the Federal Navy and acts as the Federal military liaison to Aegis. In February 3309, he was assigned to this role—a reduced version of the position formerly occupied by Admiral Aden Tanner—as the Federation pledged ships, personnel, and materials to support Aegis's reformation. In May 3309, Parry reported on the first pathfinder missions into the Maelstroms, confirming that armed ships crewed by military and xenology specialists had entered each Maelstrom to gather tactical and environmental data. His reports provided crucial intelligence on Thargoid presence in the core regions of the caustic clouds.

stanley-steamer.name: Stanley Steamer
stanley-steamer.bio: Stanley Steamer is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-04 to 3302-11-04. Noted SRV racer Stanley Steamer has released a statement rebutting archaeologist Jeremy Grant's accusations of recklessness at the ancient ruins site. Steamer claims the rubble is the remains of an ancient racetrack and that racing honours those who built it.

steven-eisler.name: Steven Eisler
steven-eisler.bio: Steven Eisler is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-09-01 to 3302-09-06. Closely associated with Okinura Xenobiology Institute.

niko-shirakawa.name: Niko Shirakawa
niko-shirakawa.bio: Niko Shirakawa is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-04-05 to 3309-10-12. Closely associated with Shadow President.

lyran-betar.name: Lyran Betar
lyran-betar.bio: Lyran Betar is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-18 to 3301-05-20. Chief Xeno-Chemist Lyran Betar confirmed no known human technology could have created them, yet they do not align with known Thargoid materials.

brendan-paul-darius.name: Brendan Paul Darius
brendan-paul-darius.bio: Brendan Paul Darius is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-08-05 to 3301-08-27. Affiliated with Imperial Guard. Notable activities include: Emperor Hengist Duval was attacked by a high-ranking official during his wedding ceremony to Florence Lavigny.; Chancellor Anders Blaine accepted governance of the Empire until the succession is determined.
brendan-paul-darius.bio_full:
Brendan Paul Darius was a high-ranking Imperial official who assassinated Emperor Hengist Duval during the Emperor's wedding ceremony to Florence Lavigny in August 3301. Darius stabbed the Emperor before being killed by Imperial Guard personnel, dying before he could be interrogated. The attack triggered a total communications blackout across Capitol and threw the Empire into its most severe succession crisis in centuries.

Investigations subsequently linked Darius to the isolationist insurgent group Emperor's Dawn, revealing that his act was part of a broader conspiracy against the Duval dynasty. The assassination exposed deep fractures in Imperial stability and set in motion a chain of events that would reshape Imperial politics — from Arissa Lavigny-Duval's eventual ascension to the NMLA terror campaign and the Lords of Restoration scandal. Darius's name remains synonymous with the most successful act of regicide in modern Imperial history.

maxim-lagunov.name: Maxim Lagunov
maxim-lagunov.bio: Maxim Lagunov is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-08-04 to 3308-09-08. Closely associated with Azimuth Biotech.

commander-tyrit-shadowstalker.name: Commander Tyrit Shadowstalker
commander-tyrit-shadowstalker.bio: Commander Tyrit Shadowstalker is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-15 to 3302-03-15. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Congressional Oversight Committee.

harper-vargas.name: Harper Vargas
harper-vargas.bio: Harper Vargas is a Engineer in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-10-19 to 3304-11-17. Affiliated with Meene Defence Force, Sirius Corporation. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the mercenary incursion against Ram Tah's Phoenix Base in Meene, the FSS suspension of Lieutenant Inspector Ramesh Thorne, ...; Armed intruders attempt to access Phoenix Base in the Meene system, home of engineer Ram Tah.
harper-vargas.bio_full:
Harper Vargas is the Security Chief of Phoenix Base in the Meene system, the research facility of engineer Ram Tah. In October 3304, Vargas led the defence of Phoenix Base against armed intruders who attempted to breach the base's perimeter in an apparent attempt to steal Guardian technology research.

Vargas reported that defensive systems alerted security teams to the breach, and his teams engaged the intruders in combat and forced them back to a waiting ship. Although the intruders used explosives to sabotage the base's power network, Vargas's quick response prevented the theft of research data or Guardian technology samples. The raid highlighted the vulnerability of independent scientific operations to corporate or state-sponsored espionage, and Vargas's leadership ensured that Ram Tah's critical research into Guardian technology continued uninterrupted.

archangel-evangeline.name: Archangel Evangeline
archangel-evangeline.bio: Archangel Evangeline is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-06-13 to 3305-06-20. Closely associated with Evangeline's Elite Expeditionary Force. Evangeline's Elite Expeditionary Force requests superconductors, computer components and insulating membranes from pilots to construct the megaship EFS Archangel in the Shana Bei system. Evangeline's Elite Expeditionary Force successfully completes construction of the megaship EFS Archangel in the Shana Bei system following pilot-supported material deliveries.

gianna-tachibana.name: Gianna Tachibana
gianna-tachibana.bio: Gianna Tachibana is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-02-16 to 3304-02-16. Closely associated with Aegis, Imperial Herald. As Thargoid attacks continue in the Pleiades, Imperial Senator Gianna Tachibana has criticized the lack of an effective military response.

gideon-salamanca.name: Gideon Salamanca
gideon-salamanca.bio: Gideon Salamanca is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-04-26 to 3308-04-26. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Alliance. Archon Delaine appoints Callan Salamanca as a new arch-corsair on the Kumo Council.

durien-ballas.name: Durien Ballas
durien-ballas.bio: Durien Ballas is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-07 to 3304-09-15. Closely associated with Alliance, Alioth Independents. Chairman Durien Ballas confirms Prime Minister Edmund Mahon and three Council of Admirals members will attend. Chairman Durien Ballas introduces candidates Fazia Silva and Elijah Beck alongside incumbent Gibson Kincaid.

cmdr-r4nger0.name: CMDR R4nger0
cmdr-r4nger0.bio: CMDR R4nger0 is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-01 to 3301-03-01. CMDR R4nger0 and CMDR Kamzel rendezvoused at EACTAINDS GN-W C1-6 on the far side of the galaxy, 43,000 light years from home. R4nger0 was crossing the galaxy in a Sidewinder; Kamzel was returning from an 8-week survey along the galactic outer rim.

daxton-sung.name: Daxton Sung
daxton-sung.bio: Daxton Sung is a key figure in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3303-08-12 to 3304-01-12. Affiliated with Imperial Herald, Aegis, Federation. Notable activities include: The Federation has withdrawn its ships from the Pleiades Nebula, signaling a potential end to the Federal-Imperial cold war.; Following the Federation's withdrawal, the Empire has pulled its ships from the Pleiades Nebula, signaling the end of the Federal-Imperial cold war.
daxton-sung.bio_full:
Daxton Sung is a political commentator for the Imperial Herald who covered the Federal-Imperial cold war in the Pleiades Nebula during 3303. In August 3303, he reported on the Sirius Corporation's establishment of outposts in the Merope system, arguing that the megacorporation was "playing the long game" by positioning itself near Thargoid barnacles to seize control of meta-alloy extraction if the Federation withdrew.

Sung's analysis proved prescient as both superpowers did indeed pull their military forces from the Pleiades later that year, effectively ending the cold war. His commentary highlighted the growing strategic importance of Thargoid-derived materials and the willingness of corporate actors like Sirius to exploit gaps left by superpower retrenchment. Sung's reporting exemplified the Imperial Herald's focus on Federal corporate strategy during the early Thargoid contact period.

katherine-ryder.name: Katherine Ryder
katherine-ryder.bio: Katherine Ryder is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-17 to 3303-04-29. Closely associated with Imperial Navy, Emperor's Dawn, Imperial Herald. Freelance journalist Katherine Ryder commented that the conflict over meta-alloys between the Empire and Federation is a cold war that may lead to open war. Journalist Katherine Ryder reported from the frontlines of Senator Patreus's campaign against Emperor's Dawn in the Dakshmandi and Maausk systems.

riri-mcallister.name: Riri McAllister
riri-mcallister.bio: Riri McAllister is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-04-13 to 3304-11-21. Affiliated with League of Reparation, Alliance, Alliance Defence Force. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Riri McAllister being unmasked as Nexus and framing Admiral Varma, the hunt for League strongholds in Zibal and Ienpalang, ...; Weekly summary covering the dismantling of the League of Reparation and Riri McAllister's arrest, the Church of Eternal Void being declared illegal...
riri-mcallister.bio_full:
Rear Admiral Riri McAllister was a senior officer in the Alliance Defence Force who was unmasked in July 3304 as "Nexus," the central coordinator of the League of Reparation terrorist group. McAllister had used her position to frame Admiral George Varma with false leads, misdirecting the tri-superpower taskforce investigating the League's murders of INRA descendants. She was arrested and formally charged with conspiracy to commit terrorism following a breakthrough by Deputy Inspector Mara Klatt of Alliance Interpol.

McAllister's betrayal shocked Alliance military leadership and exposed profound security vulnerabilities at the highest levels of the ADF. The decrypted data from her arrest revealed the locations of two major League enclaves, enabling the taskforce to launch operations to eradicate remaining terrorist cells. Her exposure as Nexus remains one of the most disturbing instances of senior military personnel orchestrating mass murder in modern galactic history.

fazia-silva.name: Fazia Silva
fazia-silva.bio: Fazia Silva is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-09-13 to 3305-06-13. Affiliated with Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the conclusion of the Fazia Silva homicide investigation with no convictions and Tashmira Silva assuming control of her sis...; President Gibson Kincaid is removed from office by the Alliance Assembly on charges of treason, murder and corruption, and is detained while attemp...
fazia-silva.bio_full:
Fazia Silva was a successful entrepreneur from the Vamm system who ran for the Alliance presidency in 3304 as a political outsider. Campaigning on her business acumen and proposed financial reforms, she quickly gained support rivalling that of incumbent President Gibson Kincaid and veteran politician Elijah Beck. She delegated control of her corporate empire to her sister Tashmira to focus on the campaign.

On October 5th 3304, Silva was found dead at Hume Orbital, poisoned by a sophisticated nerve toxin administered by professional assassins. The investigation closed without convictions. The following year, Admiral Frederick Yamamoto confessed that he had arranged her assassination on direct orders from President Kincaid, as part of a wider conspiracy to consolidate executive power. Kincaid was subsequently impeached and removed from office, while Tashmira Silva assumed permanent control of the corporate empire her sister had built.

mackenzie-coates.name: Mackenzie Coates
mackenzie-coates.bio: Mackenzie Coates is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-10-26 to 3309-10-27.

therealflame.name: TheRealFlame
therealflame.bio: TheRealFlame is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-03-31 to 3307-03-31. Closely associated with NMLA, Imperial Internal Security Service, Marlinist.

kieran-rayne.name: Kieran Rayne
kieran-rayne.bio: Kieran Rayne is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-04-25 to 3309-04-25. The FIA reveals the assassin is a freelance mercenary named Kieran Rayne with no Imperial connections, and Caine-Massey withdraws its accusation against Torval.

paramemetic.name: Paramemetic
paramemetic.bio: Paramemetic is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-12 to 3302-05-17. Closely associated with Diamond Frogs, Pilots Federation, Universal Cartographics.

defensive.name: Defensive
defensive.bio: Defensive is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-03-03 to 3307-03-03. Closely associated with Alliance, Marlinist, Aegis.

corinne-macintyre.name: Corinne Macintyre
corinne-macintyre.bio: Corinne Macintyre is a political commentator who has covered Imperial politics and the activities of Senator Kahina Tijani Loren. She provided analysis on the Prism Senator's controversial Federation tour and subsequent disappearance.
corinne-macintyre.bio_full: Corinne Macintyre is a political commentator who has covered Imperial politics, particularly the controversial career of Senator Kahina Tijani Loren of the Prism system. Macintyre provided analysis on Loren's unprecedented Federation tour in early 3301, her cryptic statements to the press, and her mysterious disappearance in the Cemiess system. Her reporting helped frame the Prism Senator affair as both a diplomatic incident and a potential harbinger of deeper political instability within the Empire.

commander-father-cool.name: Commander Father Cool
commander-father-cool.bio: Commander Father Cool is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-11-29 to 3301-11-29. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Fuel Rats Mischief, Fuel Rats.

amphetamine-rush.name: Amphetamine Rush
amphetamine-rush.bio: Amphetamine Rush is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-26 to 3301-10-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club.

commander-khemsa.name: Commander Khemsa
commander-khemsa.bio: Commander Khemsa is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-17 to 3302-03-17. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Beta Hydri Corporation. Commander Khemsa, who made the largest single contribution, is honoured by President Hudson with the privilege of naming the new ship.

kyle-kurowski.name: Kyle Kurowski
kyle-kurowski.bio: Kyle Kurowski is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-11-04 to 3301-11-11. Closely associated with Cayutorme Syndicate, Imperial Navy, Kumo Crew. Imperial forces defeat the Cayutorme Syndicate mercenary fleet, restoring order to the system; leader Kyle Kurowski is missing and captured vessels will be sold at a discount from Adkins Port.
kyle-kurowski.bio_full:
Kyle Kurowski emerged as the leader of the Cayutorme Syndicate mercenary fleet during the turbulent period of late 3301, commanding a force that challenged Imperial authority in contested systems. His operations drew the attention of both the Imperial Navy and independent observers, as the Syndicate's activities disrupted trade and governance across multiple territories. The precise origins of Kurowski's force remained obscure, though its tactical capabilities suggested professional military training and substantial logistical support.

In November 3301, Imperial forces launched a decisive campaign against the Cayutorme Syndicate that culminated in the defeat of Kurowski's fleet and the restoration of order to the affected system. Kurowski himself went missing in the aftermath, while captured vessels were sold at discount from Adkins Port, generating speculation about whether he had escaped, been killed, or fallen into Imperial custody. The rapid suppression of his forces demonstrated the Empire's willingness to deploy overwhelming military power against mercenary groups that threatened its territorial control.

commander-aradish.name: Commander aRadish
commander-aradish.bio: Commander aRadish is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-03-16 to 3309-03-16. Closely associated with Universal Cartographics.

post-commander-crownan.name: Post Commander Crownan
post-commander-crownan.bio: Post Commander Crownan is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-20 to 3301-03-20. President Halsey honoured Federal commanders who made the greatest contributions to the Lugh war effort. Commander Nightwulf removed almost 14,000 enemy combatants.

estelath.name: Estelath
estelath.bio: Estelath is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club.

commander-afterglow.name: Commander Afterglow
commander-afterglow.bio: Commander Afterglow is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-10-06 to 3303-10-06. Closely associated with Secret Billionaires.

arissa-lavigny-duval.name: Arissa Lavigny-Duval
arissa-lavigny-duval.bio: Arissa Lavigny-Duval is the 16th Emperor of the Empire, crowned in October 3301 after a turbulent succession crisis. Born in 3243 as the illegitimate daughter of Emperor Hengist Duval and Florence Lavigny, she was raised as a Lavigny and became a respected Senator before revealing her true parentage in December 3300. She is the first woman to hold the Imperial Throne. Her reign has been marked by Thargoid conflicts, the Marlinist refugee crisis, and challenges from Imperial hardliners including Nova Imperium and the NMLA.
arissa-lavigny-duval.bio_full:
Arissa Lavigny-Duval was born in 3243 during an affair between Emperor Hengist Duval and Florence Lavigny. Raised as a Lavigny, she became a senator and built a reputation for tackling corruption and championing honour. In December 3300, she publicly declared her true parentage after Hengist decreed his legitimate son Harold unfit to rule.

Following Hengist's assassination by Emperor's Dawn in August 3301, the Senate deliberated for two months before electing Arissa on 6 October 3301. She became the first woman on the Imperial Throne, defeating competing claims from Aisling Duval and Denton Patreus.

Her reign faced immediate existential challenges: Thargoid incursions from 3303, the Marlinist refugee crisis of 3306-3307, and her own abduction by the Lords of Restoration in January 3307 — a conspiracy covered up for over a year using a body double. Arissa's governance combines cautious conservatism with rigorous emphasis on honour and anti-corruption, making her one of the most consequential rulers in Imperial history.

ogden-smith.name: Ogden Smith
ogden-smith.bio: Ogden Smith is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-28 to 3304-07-28. Closely associated with Andromedaries Superlative Society, Blackshadow Productions. Fan society president Ogden Smith defends the reboot as returning to the gritty drama fans enjoyed as children.

darkstar.name: DarkStar
darkstar.bio: DarkStar is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-14 to 3301-07-14. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Alliance, Nova Fleet.

commander-stern-winter.name: Commander Stern Winter
commander-stern-winter.bio: Commander Stern Winter is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-25 to 3302-04-25. Closely associated with Buckyball Racing Club.

commander-celmascant.name: Commander Celmascant
commander-celmascant.bio: Commander Celmascant is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-27 to 3301-03-27. Closely associated with Patron's Principles, Universal Cartographics, Alioth Independents. Commander Swift Arrow announced his return from the NGC 3199 Nebula, claiming to be the first to fully map the entire NGC 3199 Sector and the second explorer to visit it.

sataris.name: Sataris
sataris.bio: Sataris is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-06 to 3301-09-06. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Jameson Memorial Review, Universal Cartographics. Universal Cartographics chairwoman Cynthia Sideris read a statement praising Sataris's service.

markzx59.name: Markzx59
markzx59.bio: Markzx59 is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-09-07 to 3302-09-07. Closely associated with Buckyball Racing Club, Pilots Federation.

kerenn.name: Kerenn
kerenn.bio: Kerenn is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-07 to 3301-07-07. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Fuel Rats. Commander Fionn Mac Cumhaill was rescued by Fuel Rats Beornfrið, Kerenn, and Anuranium after mistakenly targeting a T-Tauri star with empty fuel tanks.

commander-badbjarne.name: Commander BadBjarne
commander-badbjarne.bio: Commander BadBjarne is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-20 to 3301-03-20. President Halsey honoured Federal commanders who made the greatest contributions to the Lugh war effort. Commander Nightwulf removed almost 14,000 enemy combatants.

broker-hawx.name: Broker HawX
broker-hawx.bio: Broker HawX is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11. Closely associated with Alliance. Top contributors included Broker Mrozak, Broker HawX, Tycoon Ace Rimzy, Tycoon Thalios Abraxas and Broker Del Boy.

hengist-duval.name: Hengist Duval
hengist-duval.bio: Hengist Duval is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-04-02 to 3309-09-01. Affiliated with Imperial Palace. Notable activities include: Emperor Hengist Duval was attacked by a high-ranking official during his wedding ceremony to Florence Lavigny.; Emperor Hengist Duval died en route to the Imperial Navy Medical Facility near the Imperial Palace after being stabbed during his wedding ceremony.
hengist-duval.bio_full:
Hengist Duval was the 15th Emperor of the Empire, ruling for decades before his assassination in 3301 triggered the most severe succession crisis in Imperial history. Long in poor health and comatose for extended periods, he shocked the Empire by announcing his intention to marry Florence Lavigny — a move designed to secure the Duval bloodline and produce a legitimate heir. During the wedding ceremony on Capitol, he was stabbed by Brendan Paul Darius, a high-ranking official with ties to the isolationist insurgent group Emperor's Dawn, and died en route to medical facilities.

Hengist's reign was defined by his controversial declaration that his son Harold Duval was unfit for the throne, leaving the succession ambiguous. His death revealed the existence of an illegitimate son, whose own child — Hadrian Duval — would later become the figurehead of the Nova Imperium movement. The Emperor's assassination exposed deep fractures in Imperial stability, fractures that would widen through the NMLA crisis and the eventual Lords of Restoration scandal.

eloise-winterstone.name: Eloise Winterstone
eloise-winterstone.bio: Eloise Winterstone is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-12-27 to 3305-01-25. Closely associated with Imperial Herald, Nova Imperium. Senator Eloise Winterstone argues that official recognition would secure the Duval bloodline's future.

olwyn-kendrick.name: Olwyn Kendrick
olwyn-kendrick.bio: Olwyn Kendrick is the CEO of Neomedical Industries, one of the galaxy's two largest pharmaceutical corporations. In late 3307 she spearheaded a controversial initiative to mass-produce Onionhead gamma strain as a legitimate medicine after the Interstellar Health Organisation validated its therapeutic properties.
olwyn-kendrick.bio_full:
Olwyn Kendrick serves as chief executive of Neomedical Industries, a pharmaceutical giant that provides healthcare services and equipment exclusively to Alliance and independent systems. In August 3307, Kendrick announced plans to mass-produce Onionhead gamma strain as a legal medicine after the Interstellar Health Organisation confirmed the variant's efficacy in treating psychological and musculoskeletal conditions, declaring that a crime syndicate should not monopolise a product capable of relieving millions.

The initiative provoked immediate retaliation from Archon Delaine's Kumo Crew syndicate, which declared war on Neomedical Industries' corporate partners in the Haithis system. Kendrick responded by broadcasting an urgent call for pilot support, warning that the pirate assault could collapse the entire project and waste the vital materials already delivered by contributors.

delfina-dominguez.name: Delfina Dominguez
delfina-dominguez.bio: Delfina Dominguez is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-08-25 to 3308-08-25. Closely associated with Alliance Defence Force, Sirius Corporation, Council of Admirals.

adric-claavis.name: Adric Claavis
adric-claavis.bio: Adric Claavis is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-22 to 3301-09-22. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Utopia. Adjudicator Adric Claavis announced Utopia would deliver humanitarian supplies and welcome refugees seeking new lives on Utopian worlds.

anxo-lino.name: Anxo Lino
anxo-lino.bio: Anxo Lino is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-19 to 3301-07-31. Closely associated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Justice Party. No official statement was made, but speculation centres on his close relations with local rulers King Justice II of the Justice Party and Supreme Leader Anxo Lino of BD-22 3573 Flag. Marling presented evidence that Xander received financial support from local leaders King Justice II and Supreme Leader Anxo Lino, causing a dramatic decrease in Federation popularity in the sector.

surly_badger.name: Surly_badger
surly_badger.bio: Surly_badger is a Commander mentioned in GalNet reports from the Elite Dangerous universe.

duke-sanders.name: Duke Sanders
duke-sanders.bio: Duke Sanders is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-07 to 3301-04-07. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Brightlight Training Corporation. Shadow President Hudson, accompanied by Admiral Vincent's aides, visited the Hors system to meet Duke Sanders and discuss extending Brightlight Training's Federal contracts.

jameelah-griffin.name: Jameelah Griffin
jameelah-griffin.bio: Jameelah Griffin is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-07-26 to 3308-08-16. Affiliated with Far God cult, Galactic Interfaith Commune, Federal Intelligence Agency. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the dismantling of the League of Reparation and Riri McAllister's arrest, the Church of Eternal Void being declared illegal...; The FIA apprehends further Far God cult members to determine if they communicate with Thargoids.
jameelah-griffin.bio_full:
Dr Jameelah Griffin is a spokesperson for the Galactic Interfaith Commune who has been a vocal defender of religious freedom during the Thargoid conflicts. In August 3304, she strongly opposed the Federal Intelligence Agency's arrests of Far God cult members, stating that the detentions were "motivated by fear rather than evidence" and calling for the protection of citizens' civil rights regardless of belief.

Griffin's opposition to the FIA's expanded investigation placed the Galactic Interfaith Commune in direct tension with both Federal security policy and anti-Thargoid campaigners like Juanita Bishop. Her advocacy highlighted the dangers of wartime security measures that suspended civil liberties for religious minorities, and her work became a touchstone for debates about the limits of state power during the Thargoid invasion.

sean-richards.name: Sean Richards
sean-richards.bio: Sean Richards is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-04 to 3302-03-15. Closely associated with Federal Times, Sirius Corporation, Emperor's Dawn. It alleges the deaths of Nigel Smeaton, Sean Richards, Arnold Lowe, Susan Monroe, Elaine Boyd, Emperor Hengist Duval, and the disappearances of Jasmina Halsey and Ishmael Palin are all connected.

rewision.name: Rewision
rewision.bio: Rewision is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-12-06 to 3302-12-06. Closely associated with Candy Crew Guild. The Candy Crew Guild is dominating the midpoint of the Kick The Alien Buckyball race, with Commander Nookie Mr.Smith leading followed by Commanders Raijiin and Rewision.

margot-hist.name: Margot Hist
margot-hist.bio: Margot Hist is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-11-17 to 3304-11-17. Closely associated with Dervish-Foss Literary Agency, Bonespire Publishing. His literary agent Margot Hist confirms he is in good health and working on a new science fiction novel. Hist explains that she was unaware of the concern because she was on holiday and there are no communication facilities at Skyglow Havens on the Rhea Archipelago.

yoselin-aquino.name: Yoselin Aquino
yoselin-aquino.bio: Yoselin Aquino is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-10-06 to 3309-10-06. Closely associated with Aegis.

damon-clarke.name: Damon Clarke
damon-clarke.bio: Damon Clarke is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-09-18 to 3302-03-16. Affiliated with Imperial Herald, Emperor's Dawn, Imperial Internal Security Service. Notable activities include: Princess Aisling Duval revealed that some of Chancellor Anders Blaine's advisors had connections to Emperor's Dawn, the same insurgent group linked...; Following revelations of alleged links between her office and Emperor's Dawn, Princess Aisling Duval issued a statement denying all knowledge of th...
damon-clarke.bio_full:
Damon Clarke was an Imperial industrialist and patron of Princess Aisling Duval whose shipping company, D and C Shipping Inc., became embroiled in the Emperor's Dawn scandal of late 3301. The Imperial Herald published evidence that Clarke's company had funded and organised weapon shipments to known Emperor's Dawn members three years earlier, creating a crisis for Aisling's campaign.

While no direct connection between Aisling and the insurgency was alleged, the scandal caused a dramatic fall in her popularity polls. Clarke was unavailable for comment, but his company defended its operations as legitimate shipping business. In March 3302, Clarke was found dead, bringing a grim conclusion to the investigation. His case remains one of the murkiest episodes in the succession crisis, highlighting how Imperial politics could be destabilised by the actions of wealthy backers.

elias-hampton.name: Elias Hampton
elias-hampton.bio: Elias Hampton is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-11-17 to 3303-11-24. Closely associated with Independent Leesti for Equality.

gordon-tann.name: Gordon Tann
gordon-tann.bio: Gordon Tann is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-24 to 3304-08-24. Closely associated with Far God cult, Federal Intelligence Agency, Galactic Interfaith Commune.

harold-duval.name: Harold Duval
harold-duval.bio: Harold Duval was a Prince of the Imperial Duval dynasty and father of Aisling Duval. Emperor Hengist Duval declared him unfit for the throne, after which he lived out of the public eye. In September 3306, he was assassinated by NMLA terrorists while making an unpublicised journey to visit his daughter Aisling in Cemiess.
harold-duval.bio_full: Harold Duval was a Prince of the Imperial Duval dynasty and the father of Princess Aisling Duval. Emperor Hengist Duval famously declared him unfit for the throne, after which Harold lived largely out of public view on Capitol. In September 3306, he was making an unpublicised journey to visit Aisling in Cemiess following a recent terrorist attack in that system. A single NMLA assassin infiltrated his personal transport, shooting the Prince at close range before being killed by shipboard guards. The NMLA claimed responsibility, referring to the Duval family as "imperialist parasites" and demanding that Marlinists rise up to demand a democratic republic. How the NMLA learned of his itinerary remains unknown.

commander-oriza.name: Commander Oriza
commander-oriza.bio: Commander Oriza is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-29 to 3302-03-29. Closely associated with Jeffress treasure hunt organisers. Alfred Jeffress's treasure hunt concludes with Commander Oriza claiming victory.

admiral-kirby.name: Admiral Kirby
admiral-kirby.bio: Admiral Kirby is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-12-16 to 3301-12-16. Closely associated with Emperor's Dawn, Federal Navy.

commodore-morayo-orina.name: Commodore Morayo Orina
commodore-morayo-orina.bio: Commodore Morayo Orina is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3311-06-18 to 3311-06-18. Closely associated with Thargoid, Federal Navy. A memorial beacon near the Titan Cocijo wreckage draws visitors, while Commodore Morayo Orina honours the lost at a Sol memorial service.

commander-vorian-artreides.name: Commander Vorian Artreides
commander-vorian-artreides.bio: Commander Vorian Artreides is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-20 to 3301-03-20. President Halsey honoured Federal commanders who made the greatest contributions to the Lugh war effort. Commander Nightwulf removed almost 14,000 enemy combatants.

stateira-eleshenar.name: Stateira Eleshenar
stateira-eleshenar.bio: Stateira Eleshenar is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-24 to 3302-05-27. Closely associated with Interstellar Press, Imperial Navy, Kumo Crew. Commander Stateira Eleshenar of Patreus's forces stated the aim is to free all persons held in branded slavery by the Kumo Crew.

edward-bores.name: Edward Bores
edward-bores.bio: Edward Bores is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-31 to 3302-04-07. Closely associated with Altair Purple Mob, Federal Government. The Federal 'Hand in the Head' campaign led by new 'Onionhead tzar' Edward Bores encourages citizens to surrender Onionhead for destruction. Edward Bores claims success in removing thousands of tonnes from circulation, while the Altair Purple Mob plans further research into Onionhead's purported health benefits.

jaylon-hart.name: Jaylon Hart
jaylon-hart.bio: Jaylon Hart is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-10-13 to 3302-10-13. Closely associated with Revolutionary Slink's Eye Liberals.

hadrian-duval.name: Hadrian Duval
hadrian-duval.bio: Hadrian Duval is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-01-10 to 3309-10-02. Affiliated with Nova Imperium, NMLA, Imperial Herald. Notable activities include: The Empire declares open conflict with Nova Imperium in the Paresa system, with Senator Patreus calling on Imperial auxiliaries to support Yupini L...; Nova Imperium is defeated in the Battle of Paresa by Imperial forces led by Yupini Limited, with Senator Patreus warning that the Empire will not t...
hadrian-duval.bio_full:
Hadrian Duval is the grandson of Emperor Hengist Duval and a claimant to the Imperial throne through his father, the illegitimate Prince Harold Duval. Leader of the isolationist Nova Imperium movement, Hadrian challenged Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval's authority from his stronghold in the Paresa system, advocating a return to traditional Imperial values and withdrawal from galactic entanglements. His execution of Imperator Kaeso Mordanticus on the Senate floor in 3305 marked the brutal suppression of his movement — though Hadrian himself survived.

After the Nova Imperium's military defeat and the purge of its supporters, Hadrian accepted a pardon from Arissa and was granted the title of Lord, effectively neutralising him as a political threat while preserving the Duval bloodline. His subsequent marriage to Lady Astrid Minerva-Duval and the birth of their son Hector in 3307 transformed Hadrian from rebel to family man, though questions about his true ambitions and lingering support among isolationist sympathisers continue to shadow his public rehabilitation.

zacariah-nemo.name: Zacariah Nemo
zacariah-nemo.bio: Zacariah Nemo is an engineer who specialises in kinetic weapon modifications. In December 3308, he collaborated with Liz Ryder to reveal designs for enhanced anti-xeno weaponry, improving the efficiency of AX ammunition delivery systems.
zacariah-nemo.bio_full: Zacariah Nemo is an engineer specialising in kinetic weapon modifications, known for his eccentric personality and technical brilliance. In December 3308, he collaborated with fellow engineer Liz Ryder to reveal enhanced anti-xeno weapon designs they had been developing as a private project. The collaboration focused on improving the efficiency of delivering the compound that tips AX ammunition—a substance hazardous to Thargoid vessels. Nemo and Ryder had worked on the designs for over a year, treating it as a passion project to "unwind after a long week's work." The invasion of human space by Thargoid forces made the need for these upgrades urgent, prompting the engineers to seek help from independent pilots to finish prototypes and establish manufacturing.

commander-salome.name: Commander Salomé
commander-salome.bio: A pioneering explorer active in the early 3300s, Commander Salomé was among the first participants in the historic Distant Worlds Expedition.
commander-salome.bio_full:
Commander Salomé established herself as one of the most dedicated explorers of the early 3300s, participating in expeditions that pushed the boundaries of charted space. Her most notable achievement came with the Distant Worlds Expedition, a colossal undertaking that drew hundreds of pilots to the far reaches of the galaxy. Salomé was among the first to arrive at the expedition's destination, demonstrating both navigational skill and the endurance required for multi-month journeys beyond the galactic plane.

In a transmission congratulating Dr Kaii and Commander Erimus on the expedition's success, Salomé revealed the camaraderie that defined the exploration community during this era. Unlike the competitive power struggles dominating superpower politics, the Distant Worlds Expedition represented pure collaborative achievement — pilots sharing route data, rescue coordinates and moral support across tens of thousands of light-years. Salomé's participation embodied the spirit of exploration that would later inspire even more ambitious endeavours like Distant Worlds 2 and 3.

redwizzard.name: RedWizzard
redwizzard.bio: RedWizzard is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-13 to 3301-10-29. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Canonn researcher Commander RedWizzard revealed that Unknown Artefact (UA) Morse-transmission behavior is evolving, as if triggered remotely. RedWizzard welcomed Professor Palin's return to research and invited collaboration.

noir1787.name: NOIR1787
noir1787.bio: NOIR1787 is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-12 to 3301-10-12. Closely associated with Alliance, Interstellar Press.

mia-valencourt.name: Mia Valencourt
mia-valencourt.bio: An Aegis scientist who worked at Aegis Core in the Socho system, Dr Mia Valencourt became a key witness to one of the most brazen criminal takeovers of a research facility.
mia-valencourt.bio_full:
Dr Mia Valencourt is an Aegis scientist who was stationed at Aegis Core in the Socho system when the facility was overtaken by the Socho Gold Raiders criminal faction in May 3304. A courier carrying her urgent message managed to escape the system, and her broadcast plea was picked up by the Rewired news service and relayed across the galaxy.

In her message, Valencourt revealed how the Raiders had faked a Thargoid signal to lure security forces into an ambush, allowing the criminals to seize control of the system and shut down vital anti-xeno research. Her testimony exposed both the vulnerability of critical defence infrastructure and the ruthless tactics employed by organised criminal elements during the Thargoid conflict.

commander-sam-ishum.name: Commander Sam Ishum
commander-sam-ishum.bio: Commander Sam Ishum is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-11 to 3301-03-11. Closely associated with Core Dynamics. Commander Sam Ishum braved the blockade of BD+03 2338 to deliver 86,000 tonnes of copper to Hudson Dock.

mel-brandon.name: Mel Brandon
mel-brandon.bio: Mel Brandon is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-29 to 3306-12-17.

yuri-grom.name: Yuri Grom
yuri-grom.bio: Yuri Grom is a Diplomat in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3302-10-27 to 3311-05-28. Affiliated with EG Union, Federation, Alliance. Notable activities include: Yuri Grom has announced an initiative to create a new shipyard in the CPC 20 6743 system to produce capital ships for defending human space from hu...; This week's major stories include Aegis publishing a Thargoid report based on Ram Tah's decrypted Guardian logs, revealing the two species' ancient...
yuri-grom.bio_full:
Yuri Grom is a former Federal Navy admiral who defected from the Federation to establish himself as an independent power. After a brief conflict with his former allies in the Euryale system, he led the EG Pilots to victory in the Dangerous Games of 3302 and founded the autocratic EG Union, ruling his controlled systems with absolute popular support.

In 3307, Grom entered negotiations with the Federation over the Delta Pavonis system, one of the Federation's founding worlds. When undercover Federal agents attempted to apprehend him during the conference, he escaped and declared war on the Federation. EG Union defeated Federal forces and captured the megaship Freedom's Foundation as spoils of war. Grom remains a significant independent power into the 3310s, and in 3312 his forces joined a coalition non-aggression pact in the HIP 87621 enclave alongside Imperial and Alliance representatives.

morgan-unwin.name: Morgan Unwin
morgan-unwin.bio: Morgan Unwin is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-24 to 3304-10-20. Closely associated with Mars Tribune, Federal Security Service. The Mars Tribune publishes an exposé revealing Congressman Morgan Unwin's decade-long debt to the Red Family cartel and his use of political influence to traffic drugs to hide his own addiction. Unwin is arrested by the Federal Security Service and faces expulsion from Congress.

andariel.name: Andariel
andariel.bio: Andariel is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-06 to 3301-08-03. Closely associated with Aisling's 13th Legion. Aisling Duval's supporters formed the Thirteenth Legion under Commander Andariel to combat interdiction and harassment of humanitarian supply runs. Legate Andariel of Aisling's 13th Legion officially ended the ceasefire with Winters' Wolves, citing reports of Winters' supporters undermining Aisling's control systems.

ezra-lux-kumar.name: Ezra Lux-Kumar
ezra-lux-kumar.bio: Ezra Lux-Kumar is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-05-24 to 3304-05-24. Closely associated with INRA, Pilots Federation, Federal Intelligence Agency. Ezra Lux-Kumar was found dead from nerve toxin in his home on Biggs Colony.

zander-lachance.name: Zander Lachance
zander-lachance.bio: Zander Lachance is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-10-23 to 3307-08-13. Closely associated with Neomedical Industries, Scythe of Panem, Vandermeer Corporation.

kaeso-mordanticus.name: Kaeso Mordanticus
kaeso-mordanticus.bio: Kaeso Mordanticus is a former Imperial naval admiral and the leader of Nova Imperium, an isolationist faction. A Duke from a decorated military family, he maintains influence in the Imperial Navy with Nova Imperium ships crewed by ex-naval personnel loyal to their former commander. He was executed by Senator Denton Patreus on the Senate floor in January 3305.
kaeso-mordanticus.bio_full: Kaeso Mordanticus is a former Imperial naval admiral who became the leader of Nova Imperium, a radical isolationist faction. A Duke from a long line of decorated military veterans, Mordanticus maintained contacts and influence within the Imperial Navy even after leaving service. An Imperial Internal Security Service leak confirmed that Nova Imperium ships were mostly crewed by ex-naval personnel bound by loyalty to their former commanding officer. Mordanticus's manifesto called for complete Imperial isolation from other superpowers and the installation of Hadrian Duval as Emperor. In January 3305, he was captured after the Battle of Paresa and executed by Senator Denton Patreus on the Imperial Senate floor before Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval.

sir-randolph-plaskett.name: Sir Randolph Plaskett
sir-randolph-plaskett.bio: Sir Randolph Plaskett is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-08-13 to 3307-08-13. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Alliance.

kelvin-masters.name: Kelvin Masters
kelvin-masters.bio: Kelvin Masters is a freelance journalist who contributed to the Rewired news feed, active from 3303 to 3306. He reported on Alliance expansion in the California Nebula and was an early public voice warning about Thargoid hostility following Professor Palin's identification of Unknown Ships.
kelvin-masters.bio_full:
Kelvin Masters is a freelance journalist who contributed to the Rewired news feed during the early Thargoid contact period. In 3303, he commented on the Alliance's expansion into the California Nebula, suggesting that superpower competition over barnacle sites would inevitably escalate. Masters also provided some of the earliest public commentary after Professor Ishmael Palin conclusively identified Unknown Ships as Thargoid vessels, warning that historical precedent suggested bloodshed and demanding answers about superpower contingency plans.

His reporting captured the public mood of anxiety and suspicion that characterised the first Thargoid encounters, questioning both the Federation's seizure of Palin's data and the galaxy's preparedness for alien hostility. Masters's contributions to Rewired made him a recognizable voice in the independent media landscape during one of the most consequential periods in recent galactic history.

professor-janus.name: Professor Janus
professor-janus.bio: Professor Janus is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-08 to 3302-03-08. Closely associated with Pan Galactic Mining Corp, Federal Bar Council. The case could set a precedent for galaxy-wide intellectual property rights, and legal experts including Professor Janus of the Federal Bar Council are watching closely.

emma-hallows.name: Emma Hallows
emma-hallows.bio: Emma Hallows is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-12 to 3301-02-12. When asked about his travels by Emma Hallows, the robotic barkeep responded that people should 'come buy a drink and find out for themselves.'

jackson-trent.name: Jackson Trent
jackson-trent.bio: Jackson Trent is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-12-23 to 3302-12-23. Closely associated with Emperor's Dawn, Children of Raxxla.

xdeath.name: xdeath
xdeath.bio: xdeath is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-10-31 to 3302-10-31. Independent pilot 'xdeath' discovered mysterious ruins in the Synuefe XR-H d11-102 system.

pal-vespasian.name: Pal Vespasian
pal-vespasian.bio: Pal Vespasian is a Senator in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-04-13 to 3305-01-25. Affiliated with Nova Imperium, Aegis. Notable activities include: The murder of Imperial Senator Nestor Cartesius has sparked widespread speculation about the INRA.; Weekly summary covering Dr Alfred Ulyanov's comments on abandoned Far God outposts in the Etain system, Aegis's breakthrough neutralising Thargoid ...
pal-vespasian.bio_full:
Pal Vespasian is an Imperial Senator who served during the turbulent period following the murder of Senator Nestor Cartesius in April 3304. Vespasian appealed for the Cartesius family to be given space to grieve, offering a measured response amid widespread speculation about the Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm's involvement in the assassination.

Vespasian's call for restraint contrasted with the more inflammatory reactions from other quarters, including media speculation about INRA's dark history and Commander Jameson's betrayal. His role in the Senate during this period exemplified the diplomatic challenges faced by Imperial politicians when dealing with crimes that touched on sensitive historical matters, particularly those involving the Empire's past actions against the Thargoids.

kingsley-cordova.name: Kingsley Cordova
kingsley-cordova.bio: Kingsley Cordova is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-08-24 to 3304-11-24. Affiliated with Mars Tribune, Cordova Group, Federal Security Service. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the Alliance Assembly's decision to create the Office of the Alliance President without executive powers, Sirius Corporatio...; The Mars Tribune publishes an exposé revealing Congressman Morgan Unwin's decade-long debt to the Red Family cartel and his use of political influe...
kingsley-cordova.bio_full:
Kingsley Cordova is the owner of the Mars Tribune and the Cordova Group, a Federal media conglomerate implicated in a large-scale corporate surveillance scandal in late 3304. An anonymous whistle-blower from the Achilles Corporation revealed that Cordova had blackmailed a robotics engineer into installing surveillance programs on PA912 robots belonging to well-known individuals in the Sol system.

The accumulated data was relayed to the Cordova Group for publication in the Mars Tribune. The scandal prompted Achilles Corporation to release a coreware update with a remote kill switch that deleted the spy program from all affected robots. Cordova's actions demonstrated how media corporations could leverage technology for illicit intelligence gathering, blurring the boundary between journalism and corporate espionage.

lana-sigrid.name: Lana Sigrid
lana-sigrid.bio: Lana Sigrid is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-06 to 3304-11-22. Closely associated with Mars Tribune, Cordova Group. Detective Captain Ramesh Thorne, recently reinstated and promoted by the FSS, announces arrests of Cordova, editor Lana Sigrid, and other employees for blackmail and corruption. Editor Lana Sigrid defends the story's accuracy.

andrew-bailey.name: Andrew Bailey
andrew-bailey.bio: Mayor of the Alioth Independents and administrator of Townshend Hub, Andrew Bailey led the security campaign that secured 78 Ursae Majoris for the Alliance in May 3301.
andrew-bailey.bio_full:
In May 3301, Mayor Andrew Bailey of the Alioth Independents demonstrated how local leadership could mobilise galactic resources when he launched a security campaign to secure 78 Ursae Majoris. Independent pilots answered his call in large numbers, transforming a regional stability operation into a showcase of Alliance community organising. The campaign's success reinforced Bailey's reputation as an effective administrator who understood how to leverage the pilot network for territorial consolidation.

Bailey's public statements revealed both political savvy and dry wit. When speculation arose about high-profile visitors to his domain, he welcomed the attention but noted with regret that one dignitary would not be visiting Alioth — a remark that hinted at the complex diplomatic protocols governing movement between superpower territories. As mayor of Townshend Hub, Bailey embodied the pragmatic, non-ideological governance style that distinguished Alliance local administration from the more rigid hierarchies of the Empire and Federation.

manfred-winfred.name: Manfred Winfred
