manfred-winfred.bio: Manfred Winfred is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-29 to 3302-01-29.

noel-beaumont.name: Noel Beaumont
noel-beaumont.bio: Noel Beaumont is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-10-22 to 3306-10-29. Closely associated with Fionn Liberals.

zuri-afolayan.name: Zuri Afolayan
zuri-afolayan.bio: Zuri Afolayan is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-08-10 to 3309-08-10. Closely associated with Aegis.

jason-nygaard.name: Jason Nygaard
jason-nygaard.bio: Jason Nygaard is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-01-20 to 3311-01-29. Closely associated with Federal Times, Federal Navy. Federal Times reporter Jason Nygaard notes unusual ship movements around Cambridge on Earth.

vihaan-niven.name: Vihaan Niven
vihaan-niven.bio: Vihaan Niven is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-13 to 3306-10-19. Closely associated with Far God cult, Federal Intelligence Agency, Federal Congress. Political analyst Vihaan Niven notes that some congressmen align with Bishop to appear tough on Thargoids, while others criticise her inhumane rhetoric and proposal to execute citizens without trial.

caleb-wycherley.name: Caleb Wycherley
caleb-wycherley.bio: Caleb Wycherley is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-06-03 to 3309-12-21. Affiliated with Salvation, Aegis, INRA. Notable activities include: Professor Alba Tesreau presents evidence that Salvation is Dr Caleb Wycherley, former Azimuth Biochemicals researcher and INRA collaborator who hel...; A survivor of Azimuth Biochemicals' Project Seraph, designated D-2, reveals the location of an INRA base and confirms Salvation's identity as Dr Ca...
caleb-wycherley.bio_full:
Caleb Wycherley was the founder and original director of Azimuth Biochemicals, the corporate predecessor to Azimuth Biotech and the institutional lineage behind the anonymous scientist known as Salvation. In the early 3100s, Wycherley established Azimuth's xenological research division, acquiring the first evidence of Thargoid life and initiating the secret weapons programmes that would eventually produce the mycoid virus in collaboration with INRA.

When Azimuth Biochemicals was commercially overtaken by Pharmasapien over a century later, Wycherley ensured key assets and personnel were removed from company records prior to acquisition, allowing the research to continue in secret. In June 3308, Salvation publicly revealed himself as Wycherley's successor, claiming that "Caleb Wycherley is no more, but his accomplishments laid the foundations for the man I have become." Wycherley's legacy is thus directly tied to both the mycoid virus that ended the First Thargoid War and the Proteus Wave superweapon that catastrophically escalated the Second.

cmdr-lavelain.name: CMDR Lavelain
cmdr-lavelain.bio: CMDR Lavelain is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3311-03-24 to 3311-03-24. Closely associated with Brewer Corporation. Brewer Corporation mobilizes to correct the dangerously turbulent orbit of Lantern Light station, deployed too close to a neutron star by architect CMDR Lavelain.

kincaid.name: Kincaid
kincaid.bio: Kincaid is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-01-19 to 3307-01-19. Closely associated with Alliance.

chase-fulbright.bio: Chase Fulbright is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-03 to 3301-09-18. Closely associated with BlipMagnet. Director Chase Fulbright announced they had more than enough material for production but apologized for infrastructure delays.

inspector-reeve.name: Inspector Reeve
inspector-reeve.bio: Inspector Reeve is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-16 to 3301-08-23. Closely associated with Imperial Intelligence Service. Inspector Reeve discovered encrypted data files hidden in the toys of Brendan Paul Darius's six-year-old niece, killed in the family murder. Inspector Reeve described the deaths as the most horrific he had encountered.

anthony-corvus.name: Anthony Corvus
anthony-corvus.bio: A general in the Imperial Navy, Anthony Corvus publicly challenged Senator Denton Patreus's optimistic assessments of the Emperor's Dawn campaign in late 3301, warning that the insurgents operated as a resilient cell network.
anthony-corvus.bio_full:
General Anthony Corvus emerged as a rare voice of caution within the Imperial military establishment in September 3301, publicly questioning Senator Denton Patreus's confident predictions that Emperor's Dawn would be quickly eradicated. Corvus described the insurgents as a well-organised cell organisation that was "surprisingly hard to extinguish," noting that new cells appeared as soon as existing ones were destroyed.

The general's assessment proved prescient. Within months, shadow cells were discovered in Dakshmandi, Ipilyaqa and Ch'i Lin — confirming that Emperor's Dawn had prepared for decapitation by dispersing its operations across multiple hidden nodes. Corvus's willingness to contradict a politically powerful senator like Patreus demonstrated both his institutional independence and his understanding of counter-insurgency realities. While the Imperial Herald reported his comments, it was the subsequent events that vindicated his analysis, establishing Corvus as one of the few Imperial officers who accurately assessed the depth of the terrorist threat.

grady-chen.name: Grady Chen
grady-chen.bio: Grady Chen is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-08-02 to 3305-08-02. Closely associated with Alliance, Lave Radio.

jeong-hui-shing.name: Jeong-Hui Shing
jeong-hui-shing.bio: Jeong-Hui Shing is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3310-07-04 to 3310-07-04. Closely associated with Aegis. Jeong-Hui Shing theorises they are gathering data and probing defences.

philippa-barlow-lyons.name: Philippa Barlow-Lyons
philippa-barlow-lyons.bio: Philippa Barlow-Lyons is the COO and acting CEO of Caine-Massey who led the corporation through the assassination of Johann Fleischer and the ensuing conflict with Torval Mining.
philippa-barlow-lyons.bio_full:
Philippa Barlow-Lyons is the Chief Operating Officer and acting CEO of Caine-Massey, a major Federal mining corporation. In 3309, she assumed leadership after the assassination of CEO Johann Fleischer at a Federal Commerce Authority seminar on Mars. Barlow-Lyons publicly condemned the murder and demanded that no effort be spared in finding the killer.

When circumstantial evidence linked the assassin to Torval Mining Ltd, Barlow-Lyons directed Caine-Massey's partner faction Tavgi Blue Life Inc into open conflict with Torval Mining in the Tavgi system. After Federal auxiliaries helped capture the Orchestral Falcon megaship, Torval Mining surrendered the assassin to Federal authorities. Barlow-Lyons declared that justice would finally be served, cementing her reputation as a decisive leader willing to use corporate warfare to protect her company's interests.

nathaniel-lopez.name: Nathaniel Lopez
nathaniel-lopez.bio: Nathaniel Lopez is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-10-11 to 3305-10-11. Closely associated with Galactic Welfare Trust.

dread-katherine.bio: Dread Katherine is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-19 to 3301-08-19. Pirate Dread Katherine was kidnapped at 19, developed a hatred of men, and became one of the most feared pirates in her region.

commander-egg90.bio: Commander Egg90 is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-03 to 3301-05-03. Closely associated with The Code, East India Company. hender-saik-duval.name: Hender Saik Duval
hender-saik-duval.bio: Hender Saik Duval is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-09 to 3301-08-09. Historian Sima Kalhana recounts key moments from Emperor Hengist Duval’s life. Born in 3163, he became the 15th Emperor in the Duval bloodline in 3233.

marshal-cooper.bio: Marshal Cooper is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-02-21 to 3305-02-28. Closely associated with Namab Purple Brothers, Drevlyada League. A long-standing personal rivalry between General Kendrick of the Namab Purple Brothers and Marshal Cooper of the Drevlyada League escalates into open conflict in the Drevlyada system.

radlock.bio: Radlock is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-05 to 3301-10-05. Closely associated with Fuel Rats, Radio Sidewinder. Commanders KitsuneThe Fluff and Radlock were each recognized for achieving 100 individual rescues, with KitsuneThe Fluff being the first to reach that milestone.

jade-sanderlyn.name: Jade Sanderlyn
jade-sanderlyn.bio: Jade Sanderlyn is a Journalist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-04-28 to 3310-07-10. Affiliated with Aegis, Salvation, Imperial Navy. Notable activities include: The superpowers offer bounties on Thargoid vessels while Salvation constructs anti-xeno superweapons.; Vox Galactica's Jade Sanderlyn interviews Imperial Navy Admiral Henry Paul Atherton about the Thargoid invasion of Novas.
jade-sanderlyn.bio_full:
Jade Sanderlyn is a veteran war correspondent for Vox Galactica who has become the definitive journalistic voice of the Second Thargoid War. Her monthly frontline reports combine military analysis with human-interest storytelling, delivering updates on anti-xeno operations, scientific developments, and the civilian cost of the conflict to audiences across the bubble. Her dispatches from occupied systems and refugee evacuation zones have made her one of the most recognised names in galactic journalism.

Sanderlyn's reporting is characterised by cautious optimism tempered with unflinching realism. She has covered every major phase of the war, from the initial Maelstrom arrivals through the Aegis-Azimuth rivalry and the controversial Proteus Wave project. Her ability to contextualise complex military and scientific developments for general audiences — while maintaining the critical distance that distinguishes Vox Galactica from superpower-controlled outlets — has made her dispatches essential reading for independent pilots and civilian observers alike.

sergeant-jenner.name: Sergeant Jenner
sergeant-jenner.bio: Sergeant Jenner is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-05 to 3301-08-05. Closely associated with Imperial Palace, Alliance, Imperial Navy. Sergeant Jenner, one of the elite guards selected to escort the procession, called it the greatest honour of her 30-year career.

commander-dennehy.bio: Commander Dennehy is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-28 to 3302-04-28. Closely associated with Alliance, Spinward Marches Alliance Concern. Commanders Saool and Dennehy coordinate the effort.

thandeka-qwabe.name: Thandeka Qwabe
thandeka-qwabe.bio: Thandeka Qwabe is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-03-21 to 3310-07-18.
thandeka-qwabe.bio_full:
Thandeka Qwabe rose to prominence during the tumultuous period spanning 3309 to 3310, a time marked by the devastating Thargoid invasion of the core systems and humanity's struggle to mount an effective defence. Her documented activity across this fifteen-month window placed her within the network of individuals responding to the most severe existential crisis humanity had faced since first contact with the aliens. The specific nature of her contributions remains partially obscured by the chaos of the period, but her sustained presence in GalNet records indicates meaningful involvement in events of galactic significance.

The timing of Qwabe's emergence — coinciding with the fall of multiple major systems to Thargoid forces and the subsequent mobilisation of civilian and military resources — suggests she may have played a role in humanitarian, logistical, or resistance efforts. Her story exemplifies how countless individuals stepped forward during humanity's darkest hours, their contributions often overshadowed by more prominent figures but nonetheless essential to the collective survival effort. Qwabe represents the broader human response to crisis that sustained civilisation through its most perilous trials.

The Mail on Mars praised her for improving Imperial-Federation relations more than decades of ambassadors.

Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the dismantling of the League of Reparation and Riri McAllister's arrest, the Church of Eternal Void being declared illegal...; Weekly summary covering the Alliance Assembly's agreement to vote on Kincaid's constitutional changes, the fire destroying Supratech's facility, in...
jupiter-rochester.bio_full:
Jupiter Rochester is the CEO of Core Dynamics, one of the Federation's largest aerospace and defence conglomerates, and a scion of the powerful Rochester family. Under his leadership, Core Dynamics aggressively expanded through acquisitions — most notably the hostile takeover of Lakon Spaceways in 3306, a move that Alliance leaders condemned as a threat to their strategic shipbuilding capacity. Internal critics within Core Dynamics described the merger as driven by Rochester's personal greed rather than corporate logic.

Rochester's business practices have attracted scrutiny from the Independent Commission for Market Equality over irregular share transfers and potential criminal market manipulation. His political connections run deep through the Rochester family's influence in Federal diplomacy, though his corporate focus has often clashed with the more public-facing political careers of relatives such as Jordan Rochester.

commander-parabolus.name: Commander Parabolus
commander-parabolus.bio: Commander Parabolus is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-10-21 to 3302-10-21.

zachary-rackham.bio: Zachary Rackham is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-06-20 to 3312-03-03. Affiliated with Federal Times, Rackham Capital Investments, Supratech. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Thargoids being repelled from core systems to Bhal, three starports restored to full functionality, Aisling Duval's engagem...; Weekly summary covering Gibson Kincaid's re-election as Alliance President, the foiled raid on Ram Tah's Phoenix Base, the FSS targeting The Mars T...
zachary-rackham.bio_full:
Zachary Rackham, nicknamed "Calico Zack", is a multi-billionaire businessman and President of the Federation whose past as an independent trader is widely rumoured to have been a cover for piracy. He founded Rackham Capital Investments after a lucrative — and suspiciously unverifiable — trading career, building a corporate empire that attracted intense scrutiny from the Federal Times and Federal Intelligence Agency. In 3305, the sudden death of his longtime CFO Aaron Salazar and the rapid rise of replacement Taja Gavaris triggered an investigation into a string of fatal "accidents" at the company.

Despite these scandals, Rackham's populist appeal and anti-establishment rhetoric carried him to the presidency. His administration has been marked by the same blurring of legitimate business and criminal intrigue that defined his corporate career, with critics continuing to question whether "Calico Zack" ever truly left the pirate life behind.

gino-borstein.bio: Gino Borstein is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-10-20 to 3305-10-28. Closely associated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Rockforth Corporation, Scythe of Panem.

Analyst Marcus Orrin stated the Imperial Navy has invested too much to simply withdraw after hostilities end, predicting a prolonged occupation.

madoc-evander.name: Madoc Evander
madoc-evander.bio: Madoc Evander is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-20 to 3305-07-13. Closely associated with Imperial Internal Security Service, Autonomy. Captain Madoc Evander of the Imperial Internal Security Service notes a similar theft three months ago in the Alioth system with the same motif, but cannot yet confirm a connection.

hector-jansen.name: Hector Jansen
hector-jansen.bio: Hector Jansen is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-10-27 to 3307-12-02. Closely associated with NMLA. Hadrian Duval's wife Astrid gives birth to a son named Hector Mordanticus Duval, prompting celebrations across the Empire and a commodity gathering initiative in Paresa.

arcanonn.name: Arcanonn
arcanonn.bio: A leading researcher with the Canonn Interstellar Research Group, Dr Arcanonn confirmed the discovery of alien barnacle structures in the Pleiades Nebula and pioneered early meta-alloy investigations in early 3302.
arcanonn.bio_full:
In January 3302, Dr Arcanonn of the Canonn Interstellar Research Group made a discovery that would reshape humanity's understanding of extraterrestrial life: the confirmation of alien "barnacle" structures on at least two planets in the Pleiades Nebula. The find provided the first concrete evidence that Thargoid-related biological formations existed not just as drifting artefacts but as anchored, planet-based organisms with complex mineral-extraction capabilities.

Arcanonn immediately recognised the implications, launching a four-week investigation into meta-alloys and their connection to the unknown artefacts that had been crippling starports across inhabited space. His work established the foundational link between barnacle sites, meta-alloy production and the technological plague — a causal chain that would eventually enable the development of countermeasures. Though later researchers would build upon and refine his findings, Arcanonn's early contributions remain central to the scientific narrative of first contact.

femi-dakarai.name: Femi Dakarai
femi-dakarai.bio: Femi Dakarai is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-12 to 3302-11-19. Closely associated with MetaDrive Inc., BigSix, Gutamaya. Femi Dakarai, chairman of hyperdrive-research company MetaDrive Inc., has passed away in the Chi Orionis system following a short illness attributed to overwork.
femi-dakarai.bio_full: Femi Dakarai is a journalist and media personality who has covered major galactic events. His reporting has appeared in various newsfeeds, contributing to public understanding of conflicts and political developments across the superpowers.

nexus.name: Nexus
nexus.bio: Nexus is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-06-16 to 3304-06-21. Closely associated with League of Reparation, Imperial Internal Security Service. Kilbride confirms the captives are being interrogated to identify Nexus, the League's coordinator, expressing confidence this marks the beginning of the end for the terrorist organisation. Recorded at Jameson Memorial, she calls the acts misguided, unnecessary and evil, and appeals directly to Nexus to stop.

jing-sheng-mendez.name: Jing-sheng Mendez
jing-sheng-mendez.bio: Jing-sheng Mendez is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-30 to 3304-08-30. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group, Pilots Federation.

aasha.bio: Aasha is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-13 to 3301-08-13. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Sirius Corporation, Imperial Slavers Associated. Former slave Aasha, a mechanical engineer originally under a Quivira contract with Silver Universal PLC, became the face of the rescue after being found in stasis among pirates.

torvan-dast.name: Torvan Dast
torvan-dast.bio: Torvan Dast is a key figure in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-02-02 to 3304-08-05. Affiliated with Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the dismantling of the League of Reparation and Riri McAllister's arrest, the Church of Eternal Void being declared illegal...; Weekly summary covering the foiled assassination attempt on Aisling Duval, Riri McAllister being shot during her trial, the FIA investigation into ...
torvan-dast.bio_full:
Torvan Dast is an Alliance official who has served as a spokesperson and project coordinator for Alliance infrastructure initiatives. In February 3304, he announced plans to build an Orbis starport in the Synuefai EB-R c7-5 system, positioned between the core systems and the Alliance's California Nebula outposts.

Dast stated that the new starport would "bridge the gap between the settlements and the galactic core, and lessen the risk to ships journeying to and from the California Nebula." The initiative was overseen by the LP 128-32 Corporation, which placed open orders for raw materials and kill orders on wanted ships to protect traders. Dast's role in the starport project exemplified the Alliance's strategy of investing in deep-space infrastructure to strengthen connectivity to its frontier territories, supporting both trade and scientific expansion into the California Nebula region.

luca-redondo.bio: Luca Redondo is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-08-15 to 3309-08-15. Closely associated with Aegis.

hunter-s-volkov.bio: Hunter S Volkov is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-01 to 3302-11-01. Closely associated with Colonia Citizens Network, Pilots Federation.

locastan.bio: Locastan is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-04 to 3302-04-04. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

maugvahnna-rose.name: Maugvahnna Rose
maugvahnna-rose.bio: Maugvahnna Rose is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-10 to 3301-08-19. Closely associated with Judas Syndicate, Federal State Police. Commander Angel Rose grew up on a starport, became a trader, then was drawn into crime and reluctant assassination, ultimately joining pirates featured on the Underground Channel. Her mother Maugvahnna Rose was a ruthless social climber who became a starport captain and played a small part in her daughter’s criminal path.

alexei-keel.name: Alexei Keel
alexei-keel.bio: Alexei Keel is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-03-23 to 3311-09-25. Affiliated with Vox Galactica, Aegis, Federal Intelligence Agency. Notable activities include: The superpowers jointly suspend Aegis operations and authorise an inquiry into the Alexandria's disappearance.; A resistance movement emerges to sabotage Salvation's efforts, with opponents destroying disguised weapon components rather than delivering them.
alexei-keel.bio_full:
Alexei Keel is a freelance journalist who has reported on some of the most controversial developments in the Thargoid War for Vox Galactica. In September 3307, Keel produced a special report on the emerging resistance movement against Salvation, the anonymous scientist whose anti-xeno superweapons had attracted both fervent support and deep suspicion.

Keel documented how a counter-initiative formed by pilots who distrusted Salvation's motivations acquired weapon components — disguised as basic medicines — and destroyed them rather than delivering them. The resistance included believers in non-aggression against the Thargoids and others who feared the weapon might endanger Cornsar's population. Keel noted that "whether or not this partial blockade impacted the weapon's effectiveness remains unknown, but it acted as a substantial opposition to Salvation's scheme." His reporting captured the growing polarisation within the anti-xeno community between those who saw Salvation as humanity's only hope and those who viewed his secretive methods and messianic rhetoric as a threat as dangerous as the Thargoids themselves. Keel's journalism exemplified the role of independent media in scrutinising figures who operated outside democratic accountability.

kiona-oconnor.name: Kiona O'Connor
kiona-oconnor.bio: Kiona O'Connor is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-03-30 to 3305-03-30. Closely associated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Far God cult, Vox Galactica.

besieger.bio: Besieger is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-05-04 to 3303-05-04. Commander Salomé (Kahina Tijani Loren) was killed in the Arumclaw system by a bounty hunter known as 'Besieger', while her co-conspirators remain at large.

lance-spacecat-d.name: Lance 'Spacecat' D.
lance-spacecat-d.bio: Lance 'Spacecat' D. is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-25 to 3301-04-25.

grimnir-allvadderung.name: Grimnir Allvadderung
grimnir-allvadderung.bio: Grimnir Allvadderung is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-08 to 3301-07-24. Closely associated with Emperor's Grace, Cosmic State, Hammer Arms. Grimnir Allvadderung and Admiral Brennus celebrated with mead and an axe-throwing contest. Grimnir Allvadderung and Vaarwen Mako Brennus met in Rishair to announce the development, though the announcement was overshadowed by news of Emperor Hengist Duval's wedding.
grimnir-allvadderung.bio_full:
Grimnir Allvadderung emerged as a charismatic figure within Imperial-affiliated circles during the politically eventful period of mid-3301, maintaining documented connections to Emperor's Grace, Cosmic State, and Hammer Arms. His public appearances combined theatrical elements of Imperial tradition with an unconventional personal style that distinguished him from the typically reserved aristocratic establishment. In Rishair, he met with Admiral Vaarwen Mako Brennus to announce joint developments, though the event was notably overshadowed by concurrent news of Emperor Hengist Duval's upcoming wedding.

The celebration that followed this announcement included mead and an axe-throwing contest, activities that highlighted Allvadderung's embrace of cultural traditions that predated the Empire's more refined court conventions. His associations with organisations spanning military, mercantile, and political spheres suggested a figure who operated as a connector between disparate Imperial interests. Allvadderung's brief prominence in 3301 illustrated how the Empire accommodated diverse personalities within its broad tent, provided they demonstrated sufficient loyalty to Imperial institutions and values.

commander-aken-b.name: Commander Aken B
commander-aken-b.bio: Commander Aken B is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-18 to 3302-07-18. Closely associated with Buckyball Racing Club, Ex Luna Scientia.

daron-warmack.bio: Daron Warmack is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-08-31 to 3305-08-31. Closely associated with Alliance.

commander-kligg.bio: Commander Kligg is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-22 to 3301-05-22. Closely associated with Buckyball Run. Commander Alot broke the galactic record for the Buckyball Run A* rally race twice in less than a month, reducing his time to Sagittarius A* from 11 hours 46 minutes to 9 hours 39 minutes. Commander Kligg subsequently surpassed Alot's record by 8 minutes using an Anaconda named 'Rub Tub'.

blain-crighton.name: Blain Crighton
blain-crighton.bio: Blain Crighton is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-04-20 to 3304-04-20. Closely associated with Angeli Imperial Enterprises. Commander Blain Crighton stated the project aims to find new ways to keep even the poorest fed.

arvan-corto.bio: Arvan Corto is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-12 to 3302-08-12. Closely associated with Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm, Imperial Navy.

jarl-toredo.name: Jarl Toredo
jarl-toredo.bio: Jarl Toredo is a Journalist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-05-26 to 3304-08-30. Affiliated with Unchain. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Aisling Duval's anti-slavery campaign merging with Universal Liberty to form Unchain, Lori Jameson's denunciation of the Le...; Weekly summary covering the disappearance of Riri McAllister's medical transport, Jarl Toredo's resignation from Unchain, further FIA arrests of Fa...
jarl-toredo.bio_full:
Jarl Toredo is a former slave and anti-slavery activist who led the independent charity Universal Liberty before merging it with Princess Aisling Duval's campaign to form Unchain in June 3304. Born into slavery — his parents died while still enslaved — Toredo brought grassroots credibility to the anti-slavery movement that complemented Aisling's royal platform.

The merger created a powerful unified organisation within the Empire, with Toredo publicly demanding the abolition of legal slavery across Imperial space. When asked about rumours of a romance with Princess Duval, Toredo deflected by noting that "Her Highness's attention is focused elsewhere" — a prescient observation given Aisling's concurrent relationship with Federal Ambassador Jordan Rochester. By August 3304, Toredo had resigned from Unchain, though his brief leadership demonstrated that Imperial slavery reform could bridge aristocratic and abolitionist movements.

commander-peachslicesv.name: Commander PeachSlicesV
commander-peachslicesv.bio: Commander PeachSlicesV is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-05 to 3302-10-01. Closely associated with Cutter Club.

xavier-rousseau.name: Xavier Rousseau
xavier-rousseau.bio: Xavier Rousseau is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-06-09 to 3309-06-09. Closely associated with Azimuth Biotech.

commander-unrealization.name: Commander unrealization
commander-unrealization.bio: Commander unrealization is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-27 to 3302-07-27. Closely associated with Interstellar Press.

augustus-sym.name: Augustus Sym
augustus-sym.bio: Augustus Sym is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-31 to 3302-08-31. Experts including Professor Ishmael Palin and veteran Augustus Sym debated whether the remains are of alien origin.

oliver-gordon.name: Oliver Gordon
oliver-gordon.bio: Oliver Gordon is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-06 to 3302-03-14. Closely associated with Pan Galactic Mining Corp. Chef Oliver Gordon is served with a writ by the Pan Galactic Mining Corp demanding he change the name of his restaurant 'PanGalactic'. Chef Oliver Gordon loses his battle over the 'PanGalactic' trademark and is forced to close his restaurant due to spiralling legal costs.
oliver-gordon.bio_full:
Oliver Gordon established himself as a chef of considerable talent, founding a restaurant under the name 'PanGalactic' that attracted attention across its local region for its distinctive culinary offerings. His choice of name, apparently inspired by the vast scope of human settlement rather than any specific corporate affiliation, nevertheless drew the ire of Pan Galactic Mining Corp, one of the galaxy's larger resource extraction companies. The corporation's legal team served Gordon with a writ demanding he change the restaurant's name, claiming trademark infringement on their established brand.

The ensuing legal battle proved financially devastating for Gordon, who lacked the resources to mount a sustained defence against a major corporate entity's legal apparatus. Within days of the initial filing, mounting legal costs forced him to close his restaurant entirely, destroying a venture he had built through years of culinary dedication. His case became a minor cause célèbre highlighting the power imbalance between independent entrepreneurs and corporate legal departments, illustrating how trademark law could be weaponised against small businesses even where no genuine market confusion existed.

sandra-corrs.name: Sandra Corrs
sandra-corrs.bio: Sandra Corrs is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-12-15 to 3311-12-15. Closely associated with Our Dolph's Routes, Sandra's Workshop. Sandra Corrs, CEO of the largest manufacturer of children’s toys in the core systems, has requested help this holiday season. Sandra Corrs requests pilot volunteers to deliver festive gifts to children displaced by the Thargoid invasion, with her upgraded Our Dolph's Routes fleet struggling to locate all recipients.
sandra-corrs.bio_full:
Sandra Corrs built a remarkable career as chief executive of the largest children's toy manufacturing company in the core systems, establishing her Our Dolph's Routes brand as a household name across Federal, Imperial, and independent territories. Her business acumen transformed a modest venture into an industrial powerhouse capable of producing and distributing goods across vast interstellar distances. The scale of her operations required sophisticated logistics networks and close coordination with shipping fleets, giving her unique insight into the practical challenges of galactic commerce.

Beyond her commercial success, Corrs demonstrated significant humanitarian commitment during the Thargoid invasion, when she initiated annual campaigns to deliver festive gifts to children displaced by the conflict. These efforts relied on volunteer pilots and her upgraded Our Dolph's Routes fleet, though the sheer scale of displacement often exceeded even her substantial logistical capabilities. Her charitable work illustrated how corporate leaders could leverage existing infrastructure for humanitarian purposes, providing moments of joy to young survivors amidst widespread destruction.

hector-duval.name: Hector Duval
hector-duval.bio: Hector Duval is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-12-31 to 3309-01-16. Closely associated with Aegis, Imperial Senate. Princess Aisling Duval publicly urges Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval to join the Alliance and Federation in reforming Aegis to combat the Thargoid threat. Princess Aisling Duval hosts a New Year celebration introducing Hadrian Duval and his family to Imperial society.

valentina-tereshkova.name: Valentina Tereshkova
valentina-tereshkova.bio: Valentina Tereshkova is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-07 to 3302-07-07. Closely associated with GalCop, EG Pilots.

amaro-hem.name: Amaro Hem
amaro-hem.bio: Amaro Hem is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-06-08 to 3304-06-10. Closely associated with INRA. Luca Hem, great-grandson of INRA programme coordinator Amaro Hem, is murdered by the League of Reparation.

lucas-vincent.name: Lucas Vincent
lucas-vincent.bio: Lucas Vincent is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-10-09 to 3306-10-19. Closely associated with Federal Navy. Fleet Admiral Lucas Vincent is arrested for ordering the sabotage of Starship One. President Hudson's support plummets after Fleet Admiral Vincent is charged with sabotaging Starship One.
lucas-vincent.bio_full:
Fleet Admiral Lucas Vincent was a chief of staff in the Federal Navy and a close personal friend of President Zachary Hudson. In 3306, he was arrested and charged with conspiracy to commit murder and treason for ordering the sabotage of Starship One — the presidential vessel carrying then-President Jasmina Halsey — in 3301.

The case against Vincent emerged when Chief Technician Rory Webster, who had been on trial for sabotaging Starship One's hyperdrive, accepted a plea bargain and testified that Vincent had directly ordered him to arrange the disaster via a private channel, accompanied by threats. Vincent's arrest sent shockwaves through Federal politics: over a dozen congressmen resigned in protest, President Hudson's approval ratings collapsed, and Shadow President Felicia Winters's Liberal Party gained majority support for the first time in years. The Starship One sabotage case remains one of the most serious treason scandals in Federal history, exposing the vulnerability of even the highest offices to military conspiracy.

carter-armstrong.name: Carter Armstrong
carter-armstrong.bio: Carter Armstrong is a Engineer in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-06-01 to 3308-10-03. Affiliated with Aegis, League of Reparation. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the Socho system being overtaken by the Socho Gold Raiders, Aegis's Eagle Eye success in repelling Thargoids, five ships de...; The Aegis Core campaign to fund refurbishment of starports in the core systems ends successfully.
carter-armstrong.bio_full:
Carter Armstrong is the Chief Administrator who made a public statement in January 3308 following the discovery of the missing Aegis megaship Alexandria in the Wregoe TC-X b29-0 system. The megaship had vanished in hyperspace seven months earlier while carrying Guardian artefacts, and its wreckage was found scattered across planetary rings by independent pilots instigated by Professor Alba Tesreau.

Armstrong advocated for Aegis to remain operational until a full forensic analysis could determine the cause of the megaship's destruction, stating that the discovery provided an opportunity to learn what happened. His position contrasted with the Baumann Report's recommendation to dismantle Aegis, which had been instigated by the Alexandria's loss. Armstrong's statement represented institutional resistance to the premature dissolution of the superpower anti-xeno initiative.

ines-allende.name: Ines Allende
ines-allende.bio: Ines Allende is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-13 to 3311-04-08. Closely associated with Imperial Navy, Core Dynamics, Gutamaya Shipyards. Gutamaya's Corsair enters early delivery as the first commercially available multirole Imperial ship without Navy rank requirement, praised by lead engineer Ines Allende and Princess Aisling Duval. Lead engineer Ines Allende attributed the success to maintaining the Eagle Mk II's core design while improving key elements.

lou-brady.name: Lou Brady
lou-brady.bio: Lou Brady is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-12-15 to 3303-12-15. Closely associated with GalCop Colonial Defence Commission. Spokesperson Lou Brady stated the starport will accommodate more people, produce high-tech goods, and service larger vessels.

jin-rameer.name: Jin Rameer
jin-rameer.bio: Jin Rameer is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-04-14 to 3304-04-14. Closely associated with Kumo Crew.

commander-darius-torkalar.name: Commander Darius Torkalar
commander-darius-torkalar.bio: Commander Darius Torkalar is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-20 to 3301-03-20. President Halsey honoured Federal commanders who made the greatest contributions to the Lugh war effort. Commander Nightwulf removed almost 14,000 enemy combatants.

corentin-delacroix.name: Corentin Delacroix
corentin-delacroix.bio: Corentin Delacroix is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-11-19 to 3307-11-25. Closely associated with Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid, NMLA, Marlinist.

eugine-varrik.name: Eugine Varrik
eugine-varrik.bio: Eugine Varrik is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3311-04-01 to 3311-04-01. Closely associated with Imperial Navy.

juno-rochester.name: Juno Rochester
juno-rochester.bio: Juno Rochester is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-06-07 to 3308-10-28. Closely associated with Federal Navy. Princess Aisling Duval hosts a diplomatic function with Federal Ambassador Jordan Rochester as guest of honour.
juno-rochester.bio_full:
Juno Rochester functioned as a diplomat with connections to the Federal Navy during the politically complex period spanning 3304 to 3308. Her position placed her within the Rochester family network, a prominent Federal dynasty with members serving across diplomatic, military, and corporate spheres. In 3304, she participated in a significant diplomatic function hosted by Princess Aisling Duval, where Federal Ambassador Jordan Rochester attended as guest of honour, illustrating the family's continued influence in cross-superpower relations.

Her documented career reflected the intricate social and political webs that connected Federal elites with Imperial counterparts, even during periods of formal tension between their respective governments. The Rochester family's ability to maintain relationships across superpower boundaries demonstrated how personal and familial networks could transcend official diplomatic postures. Juno's role within this context exemplified the soft power that well-connected families wielded in shaping perceptions and facilitating dialogue between otherwise antagonistic powers.

bodmans.name: Bodmans
bodmans.bio: Bodmans is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club. Light-class rounds featured fast-paced jousting with Bodmans and Rainy Day advancing. Bodmans and Old Sauveur reached both finals, with Old Sauveur winning light-class in Eagles and Bodmans taking medium-class in Couriers after a protracted defensive battle.

ava-cornelius.name: Ava Cornelius
ava-cornelius.bio: A prominent political or social figure active in late 3305, Ava Cornelius maintained connections across both Imperial and Federal circles during a brief but notable period of visibility.
ava-cornelius.bio_full:
Ava Cornelius achieved the rare distinction of maintaining active connections across both Imperial and Federal spheres during a period when superpower relations were notably strained. Her prominence in November 3305 suggested either diplomatic expertise or commercial interests that transcended the political boundaries most citizens never crossed.

Though the exact nature of her activities remains partially obscured in surviving records, her dual affiliation indicated she operated at the highest levels of inter-superpower engagement. Figures capable of navigating both Imperial court politics and Federal corporate culture were vanishingly rare, and Cornelius's brief but intense period of visibility hinted at either a major diplomatic initiative or a business deal of galactic significance. Her subsequent disappearance from headlines suggests either successful completion of her objectives or deliberate retreat from public view.

amrita-ross.name: Amrita Ross
amrita-ross.bio: Amrita Ross is a Terrorist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3306-12-21 to 3307-08-27. Affiliated with NMLA, Alliance, Marlinist. Notable activities include: Survivors of the defeated Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid arrive in the Marlinist Colonies aboard the Steel Majesty, requesting asylum.; NMLA starport bombings in the Marlinist Colonies kill over 35,000 civilians.
amrita-ross.bio_full:
Amrita Ross is a Marlinist politician who served as Acting First Minister of the Marlinist Colonies following the NMLA starport bombings of August 3307. The attacks killed over 35,000 civilians and claimed the life of First Minister Jenna Fairfax, plunging the Marlinist Parliament into political chaos. Ross assumed temporary leadership as the Constabulary tightened security and ACT launched urgent investigations.

Ross's tenure during the crisis highlighted the vulnerability of the Marlinist Colonies to extremist violence, even as they sought to establish a democratic alternative to Imperial rule. The bombing campaign, carried out by Theta Group with logistical support from local Neo-Marlinists, demonstrated that the NMLA's terrorism could strike anywhere, including communities that shared their republican ideals. Ross's leadership during this period was marked by efforts to stabilise the government while coordinating relief with Alliance and Federation support.

mathius-leander.name: Mathius Leander
mathius-leander.bio: Mathius Leander is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-07 to 3304-09-09. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Captain Mathius Leander reports that Thargoid vessels severely damaged multiple systems including the Frame Shift Drive.

lena-ravenhill.name: Lena Ravenhill
lena-ravenhill.bio: Lena Ravenhill is Chief Editor of the Federal Times. In November 3304, she published the bombshell report exposing the connection between the Cordova Group and the spy robot scandal, revealing that Mars Tribune owner Kingsley Cordova had blackmailed an Achilles Corporation engineer into installing surveillance programs on PA912 household robots.
lena-ravenhill.bio_full: Lena Ravenhill serves as Chief Editor of the Federal Times, one of the Federation's most respected news outlets. In November 3304, she published a bombshell investigative report exposing the spy robot scandal. Ravenhill revealed that an anonymous Achilles Corporation whistleblower had attested to being blackmailed by Kingsley Cordova, owner of the Mars Tribune, into installing surveillance programs on PA912 robots belonging to well-known figures in the Sol system. The accumulated data was relayed to the Cordova Group and published in the Mars Tribune. Her reporting triggered Achilles Corporation's remote kill-switch response and ultimately led to the Mars Tribune's closure.

karleen-troy.name: Karleen Troy
karleen-troy.bio: Karleen Troy is a Journalist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-11-22 to 3309-04-27. Affiliated with Loha Holdings, New Loha Party, Sirius Corporation. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Dr Alfred Ulyanov's comments on abandoned Far God outposts in the Etain system, Aegis's breakthrough neutralising Thargoid ...; Empire-Federation proxy war erupts in Pichch, a key anti-xeno supply hub near Maelstrom Leigong, threatening to disrupt front-line defenses.
karleen-troy.bio_full:
Karleen Troy is a freelance war correspondent who reports for Vox Galactica, covering conflicts across the superpowers. In April 3309, her reporting on the Pichch system brought international attention to the accidental destruction of an anti-xeno supply convoy by Imperial-aligned forces, which mistakenly identified the vessels as Federal resupply ships.

Troy's account catalysed direct intervention from both Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval and President Zachary Hudson, who ordered an immediate ceasefire between the Gliese 44 Citizens' Forum and Gauluujja Exchange. Her work exemplifies how independent journalism can shape superpower policy during wartime, particularly when reporting on humanitarian crises that threaten broader strategic efforts against the Thargoid invasion.

solveig-smith.name: Solveig Smith
solveig-smith.bio: Solveig Smith is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-04-26 to 3304-04-26. Closely associated with Imperial Navy, Utopia. Commander Solveig Smith, who has fought Thargoids in the Pleiades, dismissed the pessimism.

commander-kyrthak.name: Commander Kyrthak
commander-kyrthak.bio: Commander Kyrthak is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-11 to 3302-07-11. Closely associated with Future of Segovan, Federal Security Service, Taskforce Athena. A coalition of Empire-aligned commanders known as Taskforce Athena has declared the Segovan system a no-fly zone and placed Ramsbottom Hub in lockdown. Commander Kyrthak stated the group is combating Federal security services to halt construction of new Federal outposts.

frank-hall.name: Frank Hall
frank-hall.bio: Frank Hall is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-10 to 3301-04-10. Closely associated with Worster Insurance, Better Green Developments. Shadow President Hudson attended the 153rd annual Exphiay Bankers' Ball alongside Frank Hall of Gallant Investment, Paul Wiggins of Wiggins Development Trust, and Patricia Spellman of Sirius Finance.

aristide-lavigny.name: Aristide Lavigny
aristide-lavigny.bio: Aristide Lavigny is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-18 to 3301-08-18. Closely associated with Imperial Palace. In her first public appearance since Emperor Hengist Duval’s death on their wedding day, Florence Lavigny called for proper decorum and quiet reflection instead of the unpleasantness seen on Capitol. She recalled anecdotes from the Emperor’s youth and her life with her first husband Prince Aristide Lavigny, bringing smiles to sombre reporters.

chloe-sedesi.name: Chloe Sedesi
chloe-sedesi.bio: A starship engineer and former apprentice of Professor Ishmael Palin, Chloe Sedesi established a major engineering facility at Cinder Dock in the Witch Head Nebula in 3305.
chloe-sedesi.bio_full:
After completing her apprenticeship under Professor Ishmael Palin — one of the galaxy's foremost authorities on extraterrestrial objects and advanced materials — Chloe Sedesi sought independence from her mentor's shadow. In August 3305, she migrated to the Witch Head Nebula and established her own engineering facility at Cinder Dock, bringing Palin's rigorous methodology to a frontier region desperate for technical expertise.

The Witch Head location proved strategically astute. As Alliance colonisation accelerated through the Expeditionary Pact, Sedesi's facility became an essential stop for pilots traversing the nebula's dangerous currents. Her work on starship modifications, particularly those involving heat management and jump optimisation, addressed the specific challenges of nebula operations. By 3309, Sedesi had built a reputation distinct from Palin's, known for practical engineering solutions tailored to the hazards of deep-nebula exploration.

gluttonyfang.name: GluttonyFang
gluttonyfang.bio: GluttonyFang is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-24 to 3301-07-24. Closely associated with Kumo Crew. Kumo Crew pilot GluttonyFang vowed defiance, saying they make up for numbers with indomitable spirit.

namin-tirel.name: Namin Tirel
namin-tirel.bio: Namin Tirel is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3310-05-09 to 3310-05-09. Closely associated with Achilles Aerospace, Faulcon DeLacy. Namin Tirel revealing the technology was developed using Thargoid drive components recovered by independent pilots.

mavia-kain.name: Mavia Kain
mavia-kain.bio: Mavia Kain is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-14 to 3302-02-05. Closely associated with Imperial Inquisition, Emperor's Grace, Kumo Crew. High Inquisitor Mavia Kain of the Imperial Inquisition will meet Admiral Varrwen Mako Brennus of Emperor’s Grace at Lindblad Port in Rishair. Mavia Kain of the Imperial Inquisition announces the successful campaign to develop i Sola Prospect on Brestla A1.

cornelius-gendymion.name: Cornelius Gendymion
cornelius-gendymion.bio: Cornelius Gendymion is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-23 to 3302-04-23. Closely associated with Core Dynamics, Federal Times. Imperial investigator Cornelius Gendymion releases a statement suggesting Federal Times reporter Elaine Boyd's investigations into the Antares and Starship One disasters were suppressed.

darius-maddox.name: Darius Maddox

sam-reyan.bio: Sam Reyan is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-14 to 3301-04-14. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Reyan BPS. Shadow President Hudson visited Reyan BPS headquarters aboard Moisuc Station in Mongan to meet CEO Sam Reyan. The deals could be worth trillions of credits to Reyan BPS, which has traditionally struggled to secure congressional contracts.

bernadette-wells.name: Bernadette Wells
bernadette-wells.bio: Bernadette Wells is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-14 to 3309-08-17.

burias.name: Burias
burias.bio: Burias is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-10 to 3302-01-10. The first annual Galactic Base-Jumping Open begins on Planet 1 in the Njokujinun system, with base-jump champion Commander Burias authorizing jumps.

nearby.name: Nearby
nearby.bio: Nearby is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-02-25 to 3307-03-18. Closely associated with Alliance, Sirius Corporation.

count-jeffrey-alexander-ryan.name: Count Jeffrey Alexander Ryan
count-jeffrey-alexander-ryan.bio: Count Jeffrey Alexander Ryan is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-06 to 3301-07-06. Closely associated with Aisling's 13th Legion. Count Jeffrey Alexander Ryan of Ugain endorsed the effort, noting that while many wanted to support Aisling, few knew how to make their combat contributions effective.

finn-mcmillan.name: Finn McMillan
finn-mcmillan.bio: Finn McMillan is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-18 to 3302-05-09.

paul-kavinsky.name: Paul Kavinsky
paul-kavinsky.bio: Paul Kavinsky is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-21 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with Fuel Rats.

reagan-lord.name: Reagan Lord
reagan-lord.bio: Reagan Lord is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-09-06 to 3304-09-06. The Mars Tribune reveals that actor Tomas Turai, husband of Jupiter Rochester, has been conducting a three-year extramarital affair with Olympian athlete Reagan Lord. Turai and August Lord (Reagan's husband) both announce plans to sue the Tribune for defamation.

shannon-day.name: Shannon Day
shannon-day.bio: Shannon Day is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-19 to 3302-04-19. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Commander Josh Hawkins recovers an escape pod containing Canonn scientist Shannon Day.

bowen-the-kotoc.name: Bowen the Kotoc
bowen-the-kotoc.bio: Bowen the Kotoc is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-19 to 3302-04-19. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

rachel-young.name: Rachel Young
rachel-young.bio: Rachel Young is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-14 to 3302-05-14.

marla-poulsen.name: Marla Poulsen
marla-poulsen.bio: Superintendent of Aegis Research, Marla Poulsen coordinated humanitarian rescue operations during the Thargoid conflict in the Pleiades Nebula.
marla-poulsen.bio_full:
Marla Poulsen serves as Superintendent of Aegis Research, the scientific division of the anti-xeno organisation Aegis. In August 3304, she coordinated a major rescue operation in the Pleiades Nebula following sustained Thargoid attacks on civilian targets that left hundreds of survivors stranded in damaged escape pods across the region.

Poulsen's operation highlighted the human cost of the Thargoid conflict, as local system authorities had diverted all resources to military defence, leaving search-and-rescue efforts neglected. She mobilised independent pilots to recover occupied and damaged escape pods while simultaneously requesting food supplies to sustain the rescued civilians until they could be transferred to dedicated refugee centres.

earl-rednam.name: Earl Rednam
earl-rednam.bio: Earl Rednam is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-04-10 to 3301-04-10. Closely associated with House of Duval, Imperial Court. Investigators Count von Auerburg, Earl Rednam and Earl Khaelmin were dispatched and have identified where to concentrate efforts next.

count-vickershaft.name: Count Vickershaft
count-vickershaft.bio: Count Vickershaft is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-18 to 3302-02-18. Closely associated with Navigators Guild.

gibson-kincaid.name: Gibson Kincaid
gibson-kincaid.bio: Gibson Kincaid is a President in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-09-01 to 3305-07-27. Affiliated with Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the appearance of Thargoid Hydra vessels in the Pleiades Nebula and core systems, Aegis Core's relocation from Socho to Sol...; Weekly summary covering the Alliance Assembly's agreement to vote on Kincaid's constitutional changes, the fire destroying Supratech's facility, in...
gibson-kincaid.bio_full:
Gibson Kincaid served as President of the Alliance from 3304 to 3305, winning office on a platform of strengthening the Alliance's executive branch. His presidency was dominated by a controversial constitutional reform campaign that sought to transform the largely ceremonial office into a powerful executive position with direct command of military forces — a move critics condemned as a creeping authoritarianism alien to the Alliance's consensual traditions.

Kincaid's downfall came in 3305 when investigations revealed a conspiracy involving murder, treason, and corruption. Admiral Frederick Yamamoto's testimony and a Wallglass Investigations Agency report exposed Kincaid's role in the assassination of his political rival Fazia Silva and his attempts to flee Zaonce during impeachment proceedings. The Alliance Assembly abolished the presidency entirely in the aftermath, making Kincaid both the first and last holder of an office that lasted barely a year.

tach.name: Tach
tach.bio: Tach is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-02-18 to 3307-02-18. Closely associated with Core Dynamics.

hayley-sorokin.name: Hayley Sorokin
hayley-sorokin.bio: Hayley Sorokin is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-11-21 to 3308-11-01. Closely associated with Alliance, Sirius Corporation. Fleet Admiral Hayley Sorokin conducts the induction, praising Yamamoto's experience commanding the Alliance Defence Force in Zaonce.
hayley-sorokin.bio_full:
Fleet Admiral Hayley Sorokin occupied one of the most senior positions within the Alliance military establishment during the mid-3300s, serving as a key figure in the Council of Admirals and maintaining connections to Sirius Corporation. Her rank placed her at the apex of Alliance naval command, responsible for coordinating defence policy across a diverse coalition of independent systems that had chosen to align under the Alliance banner. The position required not only military acumen but also considerable diplomatic skill to navigate the competing interests of member systems.

In late 3304, Sorokin presided over the induction ceremony of Frederick Yamamoto, praising his experience commanding the Alliance Defence Force in Zaonce. This public endorsement highlighted her role in shaping Alliance military leadership and her willingness to recognise demonstrated competence regardless of background. Her documented activity through 3308 placed her within the Alliance's response to multiple concurrent crises, including the escalating Thargoid threat and internal security challenges that tested the loose confederation's cohesion.

paul-baumann.name: Paul Baumann
paul-baumann.bio: Dr Paul Baumann is the chair of the independent board of inquiry that investigated Aegis's operational failures, recommending the agency's dismantlement in 3308.
paul-baumann.bio_full:
Dr Paul Baumann is the chair of the independent board of inquiry that investigated Aegis's operational failures in 3307–3308. The board was established following the loss of the megaship Alexandria and the assault on Hind Mine, both catastrophes that exposed severe shortcomings in Aegis's management.

The final Baumann Report, published in January 3308, delivered a damning assessment: Aegis had developed a "silo mentality" with departments focusing on themselves rather than strategic goals, relied excessively on "disposable mercenaries" (independent pilots), and failed to produce breakthroughs in anti-xeno technology. The report concluded that Aegis should be dismantled entirely — a recommendation that all three superpowers accepted. Notably, the report did not discuss Salvation or propose alternatives to Aegis, effectively clearing the path for Azimuth Biotech's ascendancy. Baumann's inquiry remains one of the most consequential investigations in modern military history, though critics argue it ignored Azimuth's sabotage of the Alexandria.

petty-officer-dave-lukewski-iii.name: Petty Officer Dave Lukewski III
petty-officer-dave-lukewski-iii.bio: Petty Officer Dave Lukewski III is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-20 to 3301-03-20. They were aided by Post Commanders Crownan and Pablo-Diablo, Petty Officer Dave Lukewski III, and Brokers BadBjarne and Ranmust, along with Merchant Commander Vorian Artreides.

dr-lucy-ingles.name: Dr Lucy Ingles
dr-lucy-ingles.bio: Dr Lucy Ingles is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-23 to 3302-03-23. Closely associated with Leoniceno Orbital medical staff. Dr Lucy Ingles, overseeing Halsey's treatment, says the process must be done gradually given her delicate condition.

maximilian-north.name: Maximilian North
maximilian-north.bio: Project director at Sirius Atmospherics, Dr Maximilian North led ambitious terraforming initiatives in the Coalsack Nebula during the late 3300s.
maximilian-north.bio_full:
Dr Maximilian North serves as project director at Sirius Atmospherics, a subsidiary of Sirius Corporation specialising in planetary engineering. In late 3306, he spearheaded an ambitious initiative to terraform ammonia-world planets in the Coalsack Nebula, working in partnership with the Alliance to establish new colonies in the region.

North's team developed revolutionary terraforming procedures specifically designed for terrestrial planets with ammonia-based atmospheres, representing a significant advance in environmental conversion technology. He coordinated a galaxy-wide call for exploration data from independent pilots, using the gathered information to identify the most suitable targets for transformation in one of the most hostile regions of space.

irene-ralston.name: Irene Ralston
irene-ralston.bio: Irene Ralston is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-04-13 to 3311-04-30. Closely associated with Federal Times, Vandermeer. Professor Irene Ralston of Olympus Village University describes it as 'the largest migration event in human history.'

tyler-thorsen.name: Tyler Thorsen
tyler-thorsen.bio: Tyler Thorsen is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-06-11 to 3307-06-11. Closely associated with Scriveners Clan. Commander Tyler Thorsen describes receiving a request to locate old signal beacons that could help find survivors from the megaship.

zahra-arias.name: Zahra Arias
zahra-arias.bio: Zahra Arias is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-21 to 3302-04-28. Closely associated with Sovereign Justice Collective, Pilots Federation.

sonal-mishra.name: Sonal Mishra
sonal-mishra.bio: Sonal Mishra is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-07-30 to 3307-08-12. Closely associated with Federation, Gluscap Labour, New Kuwembaa Labour. Governor Sonal Mishra cites draconian surveillance laws.

commander-maclolie.name: Commander Maclolie
commander-maclolie.bio: Commander Maclolie is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11.

hesketh-duval.name: Hesketh Duval
hesketh-duval.bio: Hesketh Duval is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-09 to 3309-08-25. Archduke Otto Lombardo-Duval requests materials to construct Duval family statues across Imperial worlds, with mixed reactions from the palace. Historian Sima Kalhana recounts key moments from Emperor Hengist Duval’s life.

colm-tornquist.name: Colm Tornquist
colm-tornquist.bio: Colm Tornquist is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-04 to 3311-03-13. Closely associated with Imperial Herald, Allied Facece Order.
colm-tornquist.bio_full:
Colm Tornquist established himself as a figure of interest within Imperial media and military circles, maintaining documented connections to both the Imperial Herald and the Allied Facece Order across a remarkably long period of activity. His presence in galactic records from 3302 through 3311 suggested an individual who moved between journalism, military affairs, and political commentary with unusual fluidity. The breadth of his associations indicated access to sources and networks that spanned multiple institutions within the Empire and its allied organisations.

Tornquist's role within the Imperial Herald placed him among the journalists who shaped public understanding of Imperial policy and military operations during some of the most consequential decades of the 3300s. His simultaneous connections to the Allied Facece Order hinted at relationships that extended beyond pure journalism into the spheres of influence that connected media, military, and aristocratic interests. Through his career, Tornquist exemplified how information brokers in the Empire could accumulate significant informal power by positioning themselves at the intersections of multiple institutional networks.

warren-lamar.name: Warren Lamar
warren-lamar.bio: Warren Lamar is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-10-15 to 3309-02-16. Closely associated with Alliance, Alliance Expeditionary Pact, Pilots Federation. Captain Warren Lamar calls for independent pilots to help defend the Witch Head Enclave. Captain Warren Lamar praises the pilots' courage.
warren-lamar.bio_full:
Captain Warren Lamar emerged as a vocal advocate for the defence of frontier systems during the late 3300s, particularly concerning the Witch Head Enclave and surrounding regions. In 3306, he issued public calls for independent pilots to assist in protecting vulnerable colonies from external threats, framing their participation as essential to human expansion rather than optional charity. His appeals resonated with the independent pilot community, which had long served as an irregular but crucial component of frontier security.

Lamar's leadership style emphasised recognition and respect for those who answered his calls to action. Following successful defensive operations, he publicly praised the courage and skill of participating pilots, reinforcing the bonds between formal military structures and independent operators. His career illustrated how figures operating at the intersection of official and informal authority could mobilise significant resources by appealing to shared values of protection and community survival.

admiral-tanner.name: Admiral Tanner
admiral-tanner.bio: Admiral Tanner is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-12-31 to 3308-01-05. Closely associated with Aegis, Imperial Senate, Brewer Corporation. Ram Tah's testimony about Salvation's Guardian-based superweapon suspends Admiral Tanner's court martial.

admiral-trajan.name: Admiral Trajan
admiral-trajan.bio: Admiral Trajan is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-06-04 to 3303-06-04. Closely associated with Colonia Citizens Network.

tulimaq-buchanan.name: Tulimaq Buchanan
tulimaq-buchanan.bio: Tulimaq Buchanan is a admiral in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-05-17 to 3304-05-25. Closely associated with Alliance Defence Force, Council of Admirals, League of Reparation. This week's major stories include the murder of Fleet Admiral Tulimaq Buchanan of the Alliance Council of Admirals by the League of Reparation, linked to his ancestor's role in INRA. Fleet Admiral Tulimaq Buchanan of the Alliance Council of Admirals has been murdered by the League of Reparation.
tulimaq-buchanan.bio_full:
Fleet Admiral Tulimaq Buchanan served on the Alliance Council of Admirals as one of the highest-ranking military officers in the confederation, responsible for shaping naval strategy and command structure across Alliance space. His distinguished career spanned decades of service, during which he rose through the ranks to attain a position of extraordinary influence over the Alliance Defence Force's operations and priorities. As a member of the Council of Admirals, he participated in decisions affecting the security of billions of citizens across dozens of member systems.

In May 3304, Buchanan became the most prominent victim of the League of Reparation, a terrorist organisation targeting descendants of INRA personnel involved in the original mycoid virus attacks against the Thargoids. His murder sent shockwaves through Alliance military and political circles, revealing that the League's grievances extended across all three superpowers regardless of contemporary political alignment. The assassination demonstrated how historical crimes could generate cycles of violence generations after the original events, ensnaring individuals whose only connection to past atrocities was blood relation.

humberto-guthrie.name: Humberto Guthrie
humberto-guthrie.bio: Humberto Guthrie is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-01-05 to 3304-01-05. Closely associated with Sirius Inc. Senior Aide Humberto Guthrie stated that if the superpowers cannot protect them, they will protect themselves.

javi-alvarado.name: Javi Alvarado
javi-alvarado.bio: An independent commander and trader who found himself an unlikely intermediary between the Golcondans and a mysterious nomadic dredger clan.
javi-alvarado.bio_full:
Commander Javi Alvarado made his living running trade routes to Forester's Choice, the outpost where the descendants of the generation ship Golconda had resettled after abandoning their ancient vessel in 3305. In May 3308, his routine runs placed him at the centre of an extraordinary first-contact situation when the Artificers Clan, a nomadic tribe aboard a Dredger-class bulk cruiser, entered the Upaniklis system and began examining the Golconda.

The Golcondans, cautious with outsiders, asked Alvarado to approach the dredger on their behalf. His hails drew only one response — a burst of rapid, densely verbose language — but he gathered enough to understand that the Artificers were interested in the generation ship itself. His account, given to Vox Galactica, provided one of the first glimpses into a reclusive culture that would reshape the Golcondans' future.

kerstin-marling.name: Kerstin Marling
kerstin-marling.bio: Kerstin Marling is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-31 to 3301-07-31. Closely associated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Justice Party. Federal prosecutor Kerstin Marling charged former Governor Joel Xander of BD-22 3573 with venality and abuse of office in Federal court in Rhea. Marling presented evidence that Xander received financial support from local leaders King Justice II and Supreme Leader Anxo Lino, causing a dramatic decrease in Federation popularity in the sector.

emilio-blythe.name: Emilio Blythe
emilio-blythe.bio: Emilio Blythe is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-22 to 3302-07-22. Closely associated with Liberal Party, Hands of the Architects.

li-qin-jao.name: Li Qin Jao
li-qin-jao.bio: Li Qin Jao is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-05 to 3301-07-05. The discovery of Martian fossils and the invention of the hyperdrive by Li Qin Jao triggered explosive colonisation, leading to ecological excesses that prompted Earth's intervention.

jonathon-forester.name: Jonathon Forester
jonathon-forester.bio: Jonathon Forester is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-11-18 to 3308-06-17. Affiliated with Federation, Empire. Notable activities include: The Empire and Federation launch rival initiatives to provide a new home for the Golconda crew.; The Federation wins the bid to provide the Golconda population with a permanent home at the orbital outpost Forester's Choice.
jonathon-forester.bio_full:
Jonathon Forester is the captain of the Golconda, a generation ship launched centuries before the invention of faster-than-light travel, whose population spent over a thousand years in deep space before being rediscovered by the galactic community. In November 3305, engineering experts confirmed that the ancient vessel could no longer meet the colony's needs, forcing the Golconda's leaders to reluctantly decide to abandon the ship.

Forester, however, insisted that the population remain together in one location rather than dispersing across multiple settlements. His determination to preserve the Golconda community's unity became a central factor in the competition between the Empire and Federation to provide a new home for the crew. The Empire offered a planetside home to fulfil the ship's original mission, while the Federation proposed a modern outpost that would allow the Golconda's spacefaring traditions to continue. Forester's leadership during the migration to Forester's Choice — the new settlement named in his honour — exemplified the challenges of integrating an isolated, centuries-old culture into the modern galaxy while preserving its unique identity.

madelyn-teague.name: Madelyn Teague
madelyn-teague.bio: Madelyn Teague is the CEO of Brewer Corporation who oversaw the Colonia Bridge project and the Dodec starport initiative in the early 3310s.
madelyn-teague.bio_full:
Madelyn Teague is the CEO of Brewer Corporation, a construction and engineering megacorporation best known for the Colonia Bridge project and the Dodec starport initiative. Under her leadership, Brewer Corporation completed the Colonia Bridge in 3308 — a network of six starports and 56 megaships linking the core systems to the Colonia region, which Teague described as her "dream" made reality.

Teague continued expanding Brewer's deep-space infrastructure portfolio through the early 3310s, including survey initiatives and the Dodec starport, which entered full production availability in May 3312. Her public statements emphasise collaborative achievement, thanking pilots whose material deliveries made large-scale projects possible. Teague's tenure represents a shift in Brewer Corporation's strategy toward publicly visible infrastructure megaprojects that galvanise the pilot community.

commander-aydro.name: Commander Aydro
commander-aydro.bio: Commander Aydro is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11.

conrad-sterling.name: Conrad Sterling
conrad-sterling.bio: Conrad Sterling is a Ceo in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-06-02 to 3311-12-19. Affiliated with Alliance, Aegis, Federation. Notable activities include: Aegis shutdown procedures continue despite revelations that Azimuth Biochemicals was responsible for the Alexandria's loss.; Professor Alba Tesreau presents evidence that Salvation is Dr Caleb Wycherley, former Azimuth Biochemicals researcher and INRA collaborator who hel...
conrad-sterling.bio_full:
Conrad Sterling is a political correspondent for Vox Galactica who has covered major inter-superpower diplomatic events and Federal politics. He is best known for his reporting from the Galactic Summit in February 3307, where he provided detailed accounts of the first-ever face-to-face discussions between Alliance, Imperial, and Federal leaders in the Sirius system.

Sterling's journalism has tracked the rise of corporatist movements inspired by Jupiter Division, the evolving relationship between the Federation and independent powers such as Yuri Grom, and the political fallout from the Aegis dissolution. His dispatches from the Galactic Summit captured both the ceremonial optimism and underlying tensions of the conference, including the frostiness between Imperial and Marlinist delegations and the conspicuous absence of Federal Ambassador Jordan Rochester.

thehairymob.name: TheHairyMob
thehairymob.bio: TheHairyMob is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26.

commander-corlas.name: Commander Corlas
commander-corlas.bio: Commander Corlas is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-09 to 3302-07-09. Closely associated with Federation, Federal Naval Reserve. A Federal Naval Reserve commander has expressed concerns that the Federation's expansion into the Pleiades Nebula is motivated by a desire to conceal evidence of non-human entities.

mara-klatt.name: Mara Klatt
mara-klatt.bio: Mara Klatt is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-06-28 to 3307-05-21. Affiliated with League of Reparation, Alliance, Imperial Internal Security Service. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Chief Inspector Kay Kilbride's murder by the League of Reparation, reactions to Aisling Duval and Jordan Rochester's engage...; Weekly summary covering Admiral Varma's arrest, the Church of Eternal Void declaring war on the Far God cult, Aisling Duval's wedding date announce...
mara-klatt.bio_full:
Deputy Inspector Mara Klatt is an officer of Alliance Interpol who played a pivotal role in dismantling the League of Reparation terrorist network in 3304. After her predecessor Chief Inspector Kay Kilbride was assassinated by the League, Klatt inherited Kilbride's evidence suggesting that Fleet Admiral Buchanan's murder could only have been arranged by a senior figure within the Alliance Defence Force.

In July 3304, Klatt held a landmark press conference announcing that decrypted League communications had confirmed Rear Admiral Riri McAllister as "Nexus," the terrorist group's central coordinator. She revealed that McAllister had framed Admiral George Varma with false leads and secured McAllister's arrest on conspiracy to commit terrorism charges. Klatt's breakthrough exposed the most senior military betrayal in Alliance history and enabled the taskforce to locate and eradicate two major League enclaves.

felix-novantico.name: Felix Novantico
felix-novantico.bio: Felix Novantico is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-04-26 to 3305-01-10. Closely associated with Imperial Navy, Utopia, Federal Navy.

aaron-salazar.name: Aaron Salazar
aaron-salazar.bio: Aaron Salazar was the Chief Financial Officer of Rackham Capital Investments from its inception. He died suddenly of a cardiac arrest at the Ivystone Spa in March 3305. His death created a power vacuum that allowed Taja Gavaris—a former pirate rival of Zachary Rackham—to be installed as his replacement.
aaron-salazar.bio_full: Aaron Salazar served as Chief Financial Officer at Rackham Capital Investments from the company's founding. In March 3305, he suffered a fatal cardiac arrest at the Ivystone Spa. His sudden death created a power vacuum at the multi-billion credit investment firm. The board of directors voted to install Taja Gavaris as his replacement while CEO Zachary Rackham took a leave of absence to cope with his grief. Journalist Bryanna Blanco later suggested Salazar's death was the first in a series of fatal "accidents" targeting Rackham's loyal supporters, part of Gavaris's scheme to seize control of the company.

lucina-prax.name: Lucina Prax
lucina-prax.bio: Lucina Prax is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-02-21 to 3305-02-21. Closely associated with Federal Times, Prax Incorporated.

commander-sheehy.name: Commander Sheehy
commander-sheehy.bio: Commander Sheehy is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-22 to 3301-02-22. Closely associated with The Reorte Chronicle. Commander Gui returned to Sol with a newly purchased Anaconda but, after equipping it, collided with an incoming Type 9. Commander Sheehy of The Reorte Chronicle warns all pilots to always check rebuy costs before launching, noting that 200,000 credits is insufficient to cover a premium vessel's replacement cost.

mason-chu.name: Mason Chu
mason-chu.bio: Mason Chu is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-10-23 to 3305-10-23. Closely associated with Neomedical Industries, Scythe of Panem, Vandermeer Corporation. Lead researcher Mason Chu warns it could become a galaxy-wide scourge.

eva-llewellyn.name: Eva Llewellyn
eva-llewellyn.bio: Eva Llewellyn is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-05 to 3308-09-05. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Universal Cartographics.

megan-madigan.name: Megan Madigan
