megan-madigan.bio: Megan Madigan is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-07-27 to 3305-07-27. Closely associated with Alliance.

ricardo-bentonio.name: Ricardo Bentonio
ricardo-bentonio.bio: Ricardo Bentonio is a Pirate in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-08-14 to 3303-01-28. Affiliated with Federal Navy, Kruger 60 Free. Notable activities include: Conspiracy theorist Ricardo Bentonio claims on his programme 'Behind the Curtain' that Thargoids are exerting direct influence over human society.; Conspiracy theorist Ricardo Bentonio claimed on his show The Hidden World that President Halsey was kidnapped by aliens when Starship One disappeared.
ricardo-bentonio.bio_full:
Ricardo Bentonio is a conspiracy theorist and host of the investigative show "The Hidden World" who has promoted fringe theories about alien influence over human society. In August 3301, he claimed on his programme that President Jasmina Halsey had been kidnapped by aliens when Starship One disappeared, dismissing the official report findings.

Bentonio's theories gained enough traction that Federal Navy officials were forced to refuse comment on his allegations, while some congressmen openly mocked him. In early 3303, he resurfaced with claims that Thargoids were exerting direct influence over human society and walking among the population. While widely dismissed as a "loon" by mainstream politicians, Bentonio's show attracted a dedicated following among those suspicious of official narratives, making him a persistent if marginal figure in galactic media.

commander-erimus.name: Commander Erimus
commander-erimus.bio: Commander Erimus is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-04-08 to 3302-04-08. A transmission from Commander Salomé congratulates Dr Kaii and Commander Erimus on the Distant Worlds Expedition's colossal achievement.

commander-raiko.name: Commander Raiko
commander-raiko.bio: Commander Raiko is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-11 to 3302-08-11. Closely associated with Buckyball Racing Club.

ronan-roscoe.name: Ronan Roscoe
ronan-roscoe.bio: Ronan Roscoe is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-08-24 to 3307-08-24. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Vandermeer Corporation, Interstellar Health Organisation.

kay-volantyne.name: Kay Volantyne
kay-volantyne.bio: Kay Volantyne is a Pirate in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-04-30 to 3308-06-01. Affiliated with Kumo Crew. Notable activities include: Five new Kumo Crew starports become fully operational across the galaxy.; A Blue Viper Club dredger enters the Pegasi Sector PN-T c3-14 system and takes position near Kumo City.
kay-volantyne.bio_full:
Kay Volantyne is an Arch-Corsair of the Kumo Council who has represented the Kumo Crew's interests in the galaxy's highest-stakes gambling circles. In 3307, she was identified as a regular participant in Jokers' Deck — an exclusive casino for the super-rich organised by multi-billionaire Lexi October. Volantyne was observed at the roue mortelle tables competing against Zachary Rackham, alongside fellow Kumo Council member Trask.

Her presence in these elite social circles illustrates the complex status of the Kumo Crew under Archon Delaine's leadership: simultaneously a pirate confederation preying on shipping lanes and a political entity whose representatives mingle with senators, ambassadors, and corporate titans. Volantyne's activities suggest that the Kumo Council has evolved beyond simple piracy into a sophisticated power broker that uses wealth and social access to protect its territorial and commercial interests.

commander-tavok.name: Commander Tavok
commander-tavok.bio: Commander Tavok is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11.

henson-duval.name: Henson Duval
henson-duval.bio: Henson Duval is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-12 to 3301-07-19. Closely associated with Federation. Marlin Duval led an expedition from Earth to Achenar in the mid-23rd century, seeking escape from rigid governments. After her death in a speeder crash, brother Henson Duval seized power and established imperial succession.

imperator-mordanticus.name: Imperator Mordanticus
imperator-mordanticus.bio: The charismatic leader of Nova Imperium, an isolationist movement that challenged the Empire's collaborationist policies and nearly succeeded in installing a new monarch.
imperator-mordanticus.bio_full:
Imperator Mordanticus emerged from relative obscurity in late 3304 to lead Nova Imperium, an isolationist faction that captured the imagination of citizens fearful of Thargoid invasion and Imperial decline. His proposal to install a new Emperor found backing from several senators, including Pal Vespasian, who arranged for Mordanticus to address the Senate and declared that the citizenry looked to the Throne for salvation "and she offers them none."

Mordanticus's boldest claim — that Hadrian was the grandson of Emperor Hengist Duval, born from a brief affair with a slave — provided the ideological foundation for Nova Imperium's challenge to Arissa Lavigny-Duval's legitimacy. The movement's rapid ascent demonstrated how effectively Mordanticus channelled Imperial anxieties into political action, though his eventual fate would be determined by the same power structures he sought to overturn.

snax.name: Snax
snax.bio: Snax is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-15 to 3302-01-15. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

sura-oyekan.name: Sura Oyekan
sura-oyekan.bio: Sura Oyekan is a youthful but popular ICE-caster who attended Zachary Rackham's presidential fundraiser in May 3309. She was among the celebrity endorsements organised by Rackham's campaign manager Anya Blackriver.
sura-oyekan.bio_full: Sura Oyekan is a popular ICE-caster—an immersive content entertainer—known for her youthful appeal and wide audience across Federal space. In May 3309, she attended Zachary Rackham's lavish presidential fundraiser at Fort Rackham on Taylor Colony, lending her celebrity endorsement to the independent candidate's campaign. Her presence was part of a carefully orchestrated event organised by campaign manager Anya Blackriver, which also included media barons Elias Metaxas and Neive McFarlane, and business magnate Randolph Plaskett. Oyekan's involvement demonstrated Rackham's strategy of using popular culture figures to build momentum outside traditional political channels.

christopher-kailson.name: Christopher Kailson
christopher-kailson.bio: Christopher Kailson is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-09 to 3301-03-09. Closely associated with Banki Gold Gang, Gold Advanced Partners, Federal Navy. Governor Christopher Kailson of Gold Advanced Partners issued a plea for commanders to supply Banki's needs to ease suffering.

misaki-sanders.name: Misaki Sanders
misaki-sanders.bio: Security Chief at Fort Dixon in the Vega system, Misaki Sanders led one of the most puzzling criminal investigations of the 3300s.
misaki-sanders.bio_full:
Misaki Sanders served as Security Chief at Fort Dixon starport in the Vega system during one of the station's most extraordinary criminal cases. In April 3305, she led the investigation into the theft of Commander Bjorn Lennox's Diamondback Explorer from a sealed hangar bay, a crime that appeared impossible given the station's security protocols.

Sanders' team eventually identified starship technician Gan Romero as the culprit, but the case only grew stranger. Her analysts recovered fragments of Romero's encrypted dream journal, in which he described "an area of space, not black but radiant" and being called by "voices that didn't come from anything with a body." While medical experts proposed a dissociative disorder, the case fuelled speculation about telepathic contact with alien intelligences.

garrett-kline.name: Garrett Kline
garrett-kline.bio: Garrett Kline is the CEO of Tilbery Construction, a company based in the Eotienses system. In June 3305, his company purchased 4,000 Imperial slaves for a water treatment facility project, drawing protests from anti-slavery charity Unchain over the company's inexperience and the risks of mass transport.
garrett-kline.bio_full: Garrett Kline is the CEO of Tilbery Construction, a young company based in the Eotienses system. In June 3305, Kline arranged the purchase of four thousand Imperial slaves to serve as workforce for a new water treatment facility on Eotienses A 3, serving the city of Port Isabelle. He defended the decision by explaining that the company had not yet acquired the personnel required to meet the project's ambitious deadline. The anti-slavery charity Unchain lodged a formal protest, expressing concern about the lack of information regarding Tilbery Construction and noting that Kline appeared to have no experience managing such projects. The incident was later revealed to be connected to Autonomy's mass emancipation operation.

sam-norris.name: Sam Norris
sam-norris.bio: Sam Norris is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-16 to 3301-10-16. Technician Sam Norris at Coats Hub reported that Gurragchaa Gateway appeared to be suffering worse conditions, though stable comms could not be established to confirm the extent.

socha-korbemile.name: Socha Korbemile
socha-korbemile.bio: Socha Korbemile is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-08 to 3302-04-19. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group. The investigation identifies Socha Korbemile as a leak and explores links to Varati-based groups and Dr Huros, a militant alien-life advocate. Her pilot log reveals her ship was sabotaged by former Canonn member Socha Korbemile.
socha-korbemile.bio_full:
Socha Korbemile began her documented involvement with the Canonn Interstellar Research Group as a member of one of the galaxy's most prominent independent scientific communities, participating in investigations that pushed the boundaries of human knowledge about alien phenomena and anomalous stellar objects. Her initial contributions appeared consistent with the organisation's ethos of collaborative discovery and open information sharing. However, subsequent investigations revealed a more complex relationship between Korbemile and external interests seeking to exploit Canonn's research for purposes that diverged from the group's scientific mission.

By early 3302, evidence emerged identifying Korbemile as an internal leak who had provided sensitive information to Varati-based groups connected to Dr Huros, a militant advocate for alien life forms. Her activities culminated in the sabotage of another pilot's vessel, an act that betrayed both professional trust and the safety norms governing independent scientific expeditions. Korbemile's case became a cautionary tale within research communities about the vulnerability of open organisations to infiltration by actors with agendas that conflicted with institutional values.

varrwen-mako-brennus.name: Varrwen Mako Brennus
varrwen-mako-brennus.bio: Admiral Varrwen Mako Brennus is a senior Imperial Navy officer and the leader of Emperor's Grace, an influential Imperial faction. In mid-3301 he ordered all members of Emperor's Grace to support Senator Denton Patreus after Patreus defended the organisation against false treason charges, and later blocked anti-slavery activists from operating in his headquarters system of Rishair.
varrwen-mako-brennus.bio_full:
Varrwen Mako Brennus serves as an admiral in the Imperial Navy and commands Emperor's Grace, a powerful faction loyal to the Imperial throne. In June 3301, he issued a personal order directing all Emperor's Grace members to support Senator Denton Patreus, rewarding the senator's earlier defence of the organisation against unfounded treason accusations before the Imperial Senate.

Beyond political alliances, Brennus demonstrated a hardline approach to maintaining order in his systems. In July 3301, when anti-slavery activists affiliated with Aisling Duval attempted to disrupt the slave trade in Rishair, Brennus intervened directly; after diplomatic mediation failed, he arranged for Senator Patreus to establish the system as a military preparation site under Operation BBH, legally suspending protest rights and expelling the activists.

jahena-yar-savor.name: Jahena Yar Savor
jahena-yar-savor.bio: Jahena Yar Savor is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-23 to 3302-07-23. Closely associated with GR 316 Silver Universal Group, Neits Jet Life Ltd, New Galactic Cooperative of Worlds.

denton-patreus.name: Denton Patreus
denton-patreus.bio: Denton Patreus is an Imperial Senator and powerful military figure commanding a private fleet of Majestic-class Interdictors. He rose to prominence during the 3301 succession crisis, when his aide Brendan Paul Darius assassinated Emperor Hengist Duval. Though Patreus denied involvement, he restored his standing by leading a ruthless campaign against Emperor's Dawn. A conservative hardliner, he has courted Princess Aisling Duval and led operations against the Kumo Crew in the Pegasi Sector.
denton-patreus.bio_full:
Denton Patreus commands one of the largest private military forces in the Empire from his power base in the Eotienses system. When Emperor Hengist Duval was assassinated in August 3301 by Brendan Paul Darius — a member of Patreus's entourage — the Senator denied involvement and was never charged. The association temporarily devastated his standing, with rivals calling for his expulsion from the Senate.

Patreus recovered by declaring total war on Emperor's Dawn, the insurgent group responsible for the assassination. Offering generous rewards to independent pilots, he personally directed operations that destroyed Emperor's Dawn bases across multiple systems. By early 3302, he had effectively eradicated the organisation and rehabilitated his reputation.

His political philosophy combines militarism with pragmatic conservatism. During the succession crisis, he suggested the throne should pass by popular support rather than bloodline — widely interpreted as a bid for power. His courtship of Princess Aisling Duval has fuelled speculation about a Patreus-Duval partnership that could produce a strong contender for the throne. Beyond politics, he has led campaigns against the Kumo Crew and consistently advocates aggressive responses to both external threats and internal dissent.

redmond-ohara.name: Redmond O'Hara
redmond-ohara.bio: Redmond O'Hara is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-12-07 to 3307-12-07. Closely associated with Far God cult, NMLA.

comandante-corrigendum.name: Comandante Corrigendum
comandante-corrigendum.bio: Comandante Corrigendum is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-02-06 to 3302-02-06.

exil.name: Exil
exil.bio: Exil is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-27 to 3301-07-27. Closely associated with Dukes of Mikunn.

lorcan-scordato.name: Lorcan Scordato
lorcan-scordato.bio: Lorcan Scordato is an Imperial Senator who served as a key diplomat during the Neo-Marlinist crisis of 3307. He negotiated a conditional amnesty for the Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid, securing intelligence that advanced the Affiliated Counter-Terrorism unit's investigation into the NMLA.
lorcan-scordato.bio_full:
Lorcan Scordato is an Imperial Senator who played a key diplomatic role in resolving the Neo-Marlinist crisis of 3307. In April 3307, he negotiated a conditional amnesty for the Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid, securing an agreement where Landgrave Arastin Delacroix and his inner circle would cooperate with the Affiliated Counter-Terrorism unit to reveal NMLA leadership identities in exchange for life imprisonment.

Scordato's diplomatic efforts provided ACT with crucial intelligence on the NMLA, though the information also led to the false allegation that Hadrian Duval was the terrorist mastermind. Chancellor Anders Blaine approved Scordato's proposal as "precisely the sort of creative solution the Emperor requires." His work demonstrated how political negotiation could achieve results that military force alone could not, even as the NMLA threat continued to challenge Imperial security.

delvin-hoorgan.name: Delvin Hoorgan
delvin-hoorgan.bio: Delvin Hoorgan is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-01 to 3302-07-01. Closely associated with Sirius Corporation. Artist Delvin Hoorgan created the sculpture using debris from the ship and light-bending meta-materials.

rusticolus.name: Rusticolus
rusticolus.bio: Rusticolus is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-21 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with Fuel Rats.

ainsley-niven.name: Ainsley Niven
ainsley-niven.bio: Ainsley Niven is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-11-24 to 3311-05-16. Closely associated with Alliance, Sirius Corporation. Councilor Nakato Kaine's motion, seconded by Councilor Ainsley Niven of Reorte, passed by a slim majority despite Prime Minister Edmund Mahon's opposition.

scorpio-devorrow.name: Scorpio DeVorrow
scorpio-devorrow.bio: Scorpio DeVorrow is a Ceo in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-08-17 to 3312-03-03. Affiliated with Supratech, Herculean Machines, Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering the appearance of Thargoid Hydra vessels in the Pleiades Nebula and core systems, Aegis Core's relocation from Socho to Sol...; Weekly summary covering the Alliance Assembly's agreement to vote on Kincaid's constitutional changes, the fire destroying Supratech's facility, in...
scorpio-devorrow.bio_full:
Scorpio DeVorrow is the CEO of Supratech, a computer technology company that engaged in a fierce rivalry with Herculean Machines during 3304 over competing personal computer designs. DeVorrow's company developed the Torc, a holographic-interface computer that malfunctioned catastrophically during the Rackham Ultratech Expo, causing nausea among users and ceding market advantage to Herculean Machines' Duradrive.

In September 3304, Supratech suffered a devastating blow when its main manufacturing complex was destroyed by fire. DeVorrow publicly expressed incredulity that the facility's fire-suppression system, security cameras, internal alarms, and thermal sensors had all failed simultaneously, strongly implying sabotage. The blaze ruined dozens of prototype Torc units and cast serious doubt on whether Supratech could recover its competitive position.

ceska-zbrojovka.name: Ceska Zbrojovka
ceska-zbrojovka.bio: Ceska Zbrojovka is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-10-05. Closely associated with Fuel Rats, Radio Sidewinder.

cadoc.name: Cadoc
cadoc.bio: Cadoc is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-24 to 3301-07-29. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Lavigny's Legion.

chukwuma-grant.name: Chukwuma Grant
chukwuma-grant.bio: Chukwuma Grant is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-04-20 to 3304-04-22. Closely associated with Alliance, Federation. Independent journalist Chukwuma Grant published a profile of former Federal President Jasmina Halsey, now a peace activist and advisor to Alliance Prime Minister Edmund Mahon.

lucius-lavigny.name: Lucius Lavigny
lucius-lavigny.bio: Lucius Lavigny is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-07-21 to 3309-08-18. Closely associated with Lavigny's Legion. Lady Florence Lavigny's recovery prompts calls for Imperial Family unity, with speculation that she could heal rifts between Arissa, Aisling, and Hadrian Duval.

polly-french.name: Polly French
polly-french.bio: Polly French is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-10-27 to 3308-10-27. Closely associated with Federal Congress.

karina-washington.name: Karina Washington
karina-washington.bio: Karina Washington is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-24 to 3304-08-24. Closely associated with Mars Tribune, Federal Security Service, Federal Congress.

commander-barham.name: Commander Barham
commander-barham.bio: Commander Barham is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-01 to 3301-03-01. Closely associated with Imperial Slavers Association. Commander Barham of the ISA stated the centre will demonstrate how to bring unregulated workforce up to Imperial standards.

logan-khol.name: Logan Khol
logan-khol.bio: Logan Khol is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-08-31 to 3302-08-31.

milandu-okoro.name: Milandu Okoro
milandu-okoro.bio: Milandu Okoro is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-09-12 to 3306-10-09. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Federal Attorney's Office.

henry-paul-atherton.name: Henry Paul Atherton
henry-paul-atherton.bio: An Imperial Navy admiral tasked with defending the Novas system during the devastating Thargoid invasions of 3308.
henry-paul-atherton.bio_full:
Admiral Henry Paul Atherton of the Imperial Navy was thrust into the spotlight in April 3308, when Thargoid fleets invaded the superpowers' core systems simultaneously. Atherton was selected to coordinate the defence of Novas, an Imperial system facing overwhelming numbers of hostile vessels and caustic enzyme attacks that had already killed hundreds of thousands.

The challenge was compounded by Aegis's recent dissolution, which left Frontline Solutions operating the disbanded organisation's fleet on a temporary volunteer basis. Atherton's candid interviews with Vox Galactica's Jade Sanderlyn aboard the INV Succession offered rare insight into the desperation of superpower military commanders, who found themselves liaising with the controversial figure Salvation for access to experimental anti-xeno weaponry even as billions of lives hung in the balance.

neive-mcfarlane.name: Neive McFarlane
neive-mcfarlane.bio: Neive McFarlane is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-05-19 to 3309-11-06. Closely associated with Federal Times.
neive-mcfarlane.bio_full:
Neive McFarlane served as a senior figure within the Federal Times during the critical period spanning 3308 to 3309, when the Federation confronted both the escalating Thargoid invasion and significant internal political challenges. Her position within one of the Federation's most prominent news outlets gave her influence over how Federal citizens understood the crises reshaping their society. The Federal Times' editorial stance during her documented tenure balanced support for official government narratives with periodic investigative reporting that held power to account.

McFarlane's documented activity across seventeen months suggested a figure who maintained steady presence within the organisation during one of the most demanding periods in its history. As the Thargoid threat intensified and Federal political leadership faced criticism for its handling of the crisis, the role of established media institutions like the Federal Times became increasingly significant in shaping public morale and policy debates. McFarlane's career illustrated how media professionals served as essential intermediaries between government institutions and the populations they governed during existential crises.

ace-rimzy.name: Ace Rimzy
ace-rimzy.bio: Ace Rimzy is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club.

johann-fleischer.name: Johann Fleischer
johann-fleischer.bio: The recently appointed chief executive of Caine-Massey, whose assassination on Mars in 3309 triggered a corporate war and accusations of Imperial involvement.
johann-fleischer.bio_full:
Johann Fleischer had barely settled into his role as chief executive of the mining corporation Caine-Massey when he was gunned down at a Federal Commerce Authority seminar at the Olympus Village Conference Centre on Mars in March 3309. Long-range plasma fire killed him instantly in front of an audience of Federal business leaders, and the shooter melted away undetected.

The weapon recovered at the scene — a professionally modified Manticore Executioner marksman rifle — was linked to undercover Imperial agents, along with advanced ECM equipment used to disrupt security systems. Caine-Massey publicly accused Senator Zemina Torval of ordering the hit, turning Fleischer's murder into a flashpoint for corporate-political warfare that would engulf the Tavgi system in open conflict.

jalen-locke.name: Jalen Locke
jalen-locke.bio: An executive agent of the Federal Intelligence Agency, Jalen Locke became the public face of one of the most puzzling disappearances of the 3300s.
jalen-locke.bio_full:
Jalen Locke serves as an executive agent with the Federal Intelligence Agency, a role that placed him at the centre of a baffling mystery in June 3309. The Dedicant, a megaship carrying thousands of Far God cultists under FIA escort, vanished after an unscheduled hyperspace jump from Popontia, and Locke was tasked with explaining the loss to a alarmed public.

His initial theory — that the cultists had overpowered armed FIA agents and stolen the vessel — was immediately challenged by experts on the Order of the Far God, who noted the cultists' fatalistic nature made such combat unlikely. Locke's handling of the incident drew criticism for its assumptions, and the Dedicant's fate remained unresolved, with speculation ranging from third-party intervention to secret hijacking by the megaship's original owners.

seo-jin-ae.name: Seo Jin-ae
seo-jin-ae.bio: Seo Jin-ae is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3308-10-04 to 3311-06-03. Affiliated with Aegis, Salvation, Azimuth. Notable activities include: The sole survivor of the notorious Project Seraph experiments has reportedly appeared at the Aegis symposium, startling the live audience.; Azimuth Biotech has publicly offered assistance to Subject D-2, the Project Seraph survivor who gate-crashed the recent Aegis symposium.
seo-jin-ae.bio_full:
Seo Jin-ae is the sole survivor of Project Seraph, a clandestine Azimuth Biochemicals programme that implanted human test subjects with Thargoid-derived neural interfaces to establish communication with the alien hive mind. Her survival came at an extraordinary cost: the experiments left her with a permanent, involuntary connection to the Thargoid collective consciousness, enabling her to perceive alien intentions and emotional states — a capability that has made her both invaluable and deeply vulnerable.

Rescued by Aegis and later the Far God cult, Seo has become a pivotal figure in humanity's efforts to understand Thargoid behaviour. Her public statements at Aegis symposia provided unprecedented insights into Thargoid psychology, while her meetings with Far God representatives — whom she described with weary frustration as expecting "divine commandments" — demonstrated both her unique access and the burden of being treated as a prophet rather than a scientist. The cult's veneration of her as "the Preceptor" underscores the blurred line between her scientific utility and religious fetishisation.

hank-stone.name: Hank Stone
hank-stone.bio: Hank Stone is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-16 to 3301-02-25. A metal rush has begun in LAWD 26 after the discovery of a pristine mining site by the late prospector Hank Stone. Raw gold from Stone's discovery was found aboard his abandoned Sidewinder at Crook's Hub in Toolfa.

zoe-okeke.name: Zoe Okeke
zoe-okeke.bio: Zoe Okeke is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-12-10 to 3307-12-10. Closely associated with FIA, Vox Galactica.

mandelbaum.name: Mandelbaum
mandelbaum.bio: Mandelbaum is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-06-30 to 3303-06-30. Closely associated with Adle's Armada, LHS 3447 Dynamic and Co, Pilots Federation.

edwin-espinosa.name: Edwin Espinosa
edwin-espinosa.bio: Edwin Espinosa is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3309-03-21 to 3309-03-28.

meera-callanach.name: Meera Callanach
meera-callanach.bio: Meera Callanach is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-25 to 3304-08-26. Closely associated with Alliance, Lakon Spaceways. Meera Callanach explains engineers removed some internal hardware to accommodate the bay, making it marginally slower than its siblings but compensating with fighter deployment capability.

irfan-karim.name: Irfan Karim
irfan-karim.bio: A business reporter for The Alliance Tribune, Irfan Karim provided sharp analysis of the corporate struggles surrounding Lakon Spaceways and the Alliance shipbuilding sector.
irfan-karim.bio_full:
Irfan Karim built his reputation covering the intersection of corporate politics and aerospace manufacturing for The Alliance Tribune. In December 3306, he was among the first to analyse Lakon Spaceways' surprise rejection of Core Dynamics' acquisition bid, drawing on insider sources to reveal that the company was in "far greater difficulty than financial statements would suggest."

His reporting exposed tensions within Lakon's shareholder base, noting that some investors were pressuring the board to accept the Federal takeover while others accused chairperson Naomi Landseer of over-reliance on Alliance contracts. Karim's coverage helped frame the takeover battle not merely as a business dispute but as a proxy struggle between Federal and Alliance industrial interests.

bai-zheng.name: Bai Zheng
bai-zheng.bio: Bai Zheng is a Federal Congressman who has been critical of the Proactive Detection Bureau surveillance programme. In July 3307, he remarked that the PDB was 'incapable of locating the NMLA, but fantastic at finding enemies among our own people that didn't previously exist'.
bai-zheng.bio_full: Bai Zheng is a Federal Congressman known for his outspoken criticism of executive overreach. In July 3307, he delivered a memorable condemnation of the Proactive Detection Bureau after it was revealed that intercepted communications were being used to prevent factions from leaving the Federation. Zheng's remark that the PDB was "incapable of locating the NMLA, but fantastic at finding enemies among our own people that didn't previously exist" captured the frustration of civil liberties advocates who argued the surveillance network had been redirected from counter-terrorism to domestic political control. His statement highlighted growing dissent within Congress over Hudson's security policies.

barclay-uxor.name: Barclay Uxor
barclay-uxor.bio: Barclay Uxor is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-06-09 to 3304-06-10. Closely associated with Garden City security. Artist Barclay Uxor condemns the theft.

sara-kulkarni.name: Sara Kulkarni
sara-kulkarni.bio: Sara Kulkarni is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-11 to 3304-08-16. Closely associated with MacArthur Mining Ltd. Security Chief Sara Kulkarni declares a regional state of emergency. Security Chief Sara Kulkarni reports sensor drones detected it surfacing in the Blue Peaks mountain range, where it was homing in on mineral ores.
sara-kulkarni.bio_full:
Sara Kulkarni served as Security Chief for MacArthur Mining Ltd during the mid-3300s, responsible for protecting corporate assets and personnel across multiple extraction sites and facilities. Her position demanded expertise in threat assessment, emergency response coordination, and the management of private security forces operating in environments where official law enforcement might be hours or days away. In August 3304, she demonstrated the weight of her responsibilities by declaring a regional state of emergency in response to an unprecedented threat to mining operations.

The crisis centred on sensor drone detection of an anomalous entity surfacing in the Blue Peaks mountain range, where it began homing in on mineral ore deposits. Kulkarni's rapid escalation to emergency status reflected both the potential scale of the threat and the limited information available about the phenomenon. Her handling of the incident illustrated how corporate security leaders in frontier industries regularly confronted situations that exceeded standard operational protocols, requiring decisive action based on incomplete intelligence.

michael-darkmoor.name: Michael Darkmoor
michael-darkmoor.bio: Michael Darkmoor is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-03-14 to 3305-03-14. Closely associated with Deep Space Surveys, Rock Rats.

equin0x.name: Equin0x
equin0x.bio: Equin0x is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-14 to 3301-07-14. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Alliance, Nova Fleet. Commander Equin0x described how superpowers exploit frontier populations for cheap labour in near-slavery conditions.

eamonn-ui-laoghaire.name: Éamonn Uí Laoghaire
eamonn-ui-laoghaire.bio: Éamonn Uí Laoghaire is a diplomat in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-10 to 3301-03-13. Closely associated with Crimson State Group, Alliance, Federation. In response, Éamonn Uí Laoghaire offered generous payouts to independent pilots supporting Lugh at Balandin Gateway. Ambassador Éamonn Uí Laoghaire declared Lugh a sovereign state and invoked ancient prophecy from the 'Leabhar Gabhála Lugh' that the Sons of Conn would aid Lugh in its time of need.
eamonn-ui-laoghaire.bio_full:
Éamonn Uí Laoghaire was the ambassador and public face of the Crimson State Group, leading the independence movement in the Lugh system in 3301. He championed Lugh's bid for sovereignty from the Federation, securing a 91% local approval rating for secession and seeking diplomatic recognition from the Alliance on Alioth.

Uí Laoghaire became a symbol of defiance against Federal domination, invoking the ancient prophecy of the 'Leabhar Gabhála Lugh' — that the Sons of Conn would come to Lugh's aid in its darkest hour — and offering generous payouts to independent pilots who would fight for the Crimson State Group. When President Jasmina Halsey declared war and Federal forces stormed Seega Port, the rebellion was crushed and Uí Laoghaire's dream of an independent Lugh died with it. His legacy endures as a martyr for colonial self-determination, and the Lugh independence war remains one of the most notorious conflicts of Halsey's presidency.

magen-wolfe.name: Magen Wolfe
magen-wolfe.bio: Magen Wolfe is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-12-30 to 3303-12-30. Closely associated with Colonia Council.

domaq.name: Domaq
domaq.bio: Domaq is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-21 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with Fuel Rats. Domaq provided initial refuelling while a relay operation involving multiple ships and roughly 540 limpet drones transferred fuel. Anuranium and Domaq located a stranded commander 2,800 light years above the galactic plane near Sagittarius A* despite limited nearby stars.

dr-miriam-fletcher.name: Dr Miriam Fletcher
dr-miriam-fletcher.bio: Dr Miriam Fletcher is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-17 to 3301-02-17. Closely associated with Furbaide CDC. Dr Miriam Fletcher, head of the Furbaide CDC, requested that anyone shipping basic medicines divert to Effinger Port to donate supplies needed to stop the Blight's spread.

captain-danvers.name: Captain Danvers
captain-danvers.bio: Captain Danvers is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-23 to 3302-06-23. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Independents of Daramo, Federal Navy.

missingsea.name: MissingSea
missingsea.bio: MissingSea is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-12-09 to 3302-12-09. Closely associated with Universal Cartographics, Deep Recon X.

reema-falco.name: Reema Falco
reema-falco.bio: Reema Falco is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-09 to 3304-08-09. Closely associated with Unchain, Imperial Herald.

erin-grey.name: Erin Grey
erin-grey.bio: Erin Grey is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-06-09 to 3308-06-09.

lisbeth-moore.name: Lisbeth Moore
lisbeth-moore.bio: Lisbeth Moore is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-14 to 3302-05-14.

arnold-lowe.name: Arnold Lowe
arnold-lowe.bio: Arnold Lowe is a journalist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-11 to 3302-03-15. Closely associated with Federal Times. It alleges the deaths of Nigel Smeaton, Sean Richards, Arnold Lowe, Susan Monroe, Elaine Boyd, Emperor Hengist Duval, and the disappearances of Jasmina Halsey and Ishmael Palin are all connected. Federal Times reporter Elaine Boyd pressed authorities on whether one victim was Arnold Lowe, a senior investigator in the Starship One disappearance, but received no comment.

lady-astrid.name: Lady Astrid
lady-astrid.bio: Lady Astrid is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-12-29 to 3307-12-31. Closely associated with NMLA, Aegis.

dale-torrance.name: Dale Torrance
dale-torrance.bio: Dale Torrance is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-06 to 3301-07-06. Closely associated with Pangborn Dock.

commander-gui.name: Commander Gui
commander-gui.bio: Commander Gui is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-22 to 3301-02-22. Closely associated with The Reorte Chronicle. Commander Gui returned to Sol with a newly purchased Anaconda but, after equipping it, collided with an incoming Type 9. Commander Sheehy of The Reorte Chronicle warns all pilots to always check rebuy costs before launching, noting that 200,000 credits is insufficient to cover a premium vessel's replacement cost.

kinsley-larson.name: Kinsley Larson
kinsley-larson.bio: Kinsley Larson is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-05-26 to 3302-05-26. Closely associated with Federal Times, Distant Worlds Expedition.

rochelle-karim.name: Rochelle Karim
rochelle-karim.bio: Rochelle Karim is a key figure in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3305-02-08 to 3305-04-11. Affiliated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Children of Tothos. Notable activities include: The FIA confirms that a portable 300-megaton nuclear warhead codenamed the Lucifer Device has been stolen from the attacked research outpost, repre...; A Federal Navy vessel discovers an unregistered research outpost with all occupants murdered, where advanced nuclear research was being conducted a...
rochelle-karim.bio_full:
Rochelle Karim is a Senior Agent of the Federal Intelligence Agency who led operations against the Children of Tothos cult in early 3305. In February 3305, she investigated the attack on a secret Federal research outpost where a prototype nuclear weapon had been stolen. Karim later went deep undercover within the cult, posing as a Tothos worshipper to infiltrate their ranks.

In April 3305, Karim's unit prevented the cult from detonating the stolen nuclear weapon at Archambault Terminal. As cult leader Barnabas Cole prepared to activate the device, Karim — still posing as a follower — shot him dead, while other FIA operatives arrested the acolytes and secured the control deck. Her operation demonstrated the effectiveness of deep-cover infiltration in preventing mass-casualty terrorism and showcased the FIA's willingness to use lethal force when necessary to protect civilian populations.

yaro-kenyatta.name: Yaro Kenyatta
yaro-kenyatta.bio: Yaro Kenyatta is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-11-04 to 3308-11-04. Closely associated with Universal Cartographics, Canonn.

naomi-landseer.name: Naomi Landseer
naomi-landseer.bio: Naomi Landseer is the chairperson of Lakon Spaceways who oversaw development of the Type-8 Transporter with SCO frame shift drive compatibility, and later voiced the company's public support for Colonia's tenth-anniversary celebrations.
naomi-landseer.bio_full: Naomi Landseer is the chairperson of Lakon Spaceways, a major Alliance ship manufacturer known for its utilitarian and cargo-focused vessel designs. She assumed leadership during a pivotal period for the company, overseeing the development of the Type-8 Transporter — a medium-class freighter designed to accommodate the stresses of the new SCO frame shift drive. Landseer revealed that the Type-8 was moved back to the theoretical stage to properly integrate SCO technology, resulting in what became the largest medium-class freighter frame in production. Her tenure at Lakon exemplifies the Alliance industrial sector's focus on practical engineering over prestige, prioritising cargo capacity and operational efficiency. In 3312, she publicly praised Colonia as "a beacon of human achievement in deep space" while pledging Lakon's support for the settlement's tenth-anniversary celebrations.

jenna-fairfax.name: Jenna Fairfax
jenna-fairfax.bio: Jenna Fairfax is a Terrorist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3306-10-16 to 3307-12-16. Affiliated with NMLA, Marlinist, Marlinist Colonies. Notable activities include: The Marlinist Parliament has refuted widespread allegations of supporting or concealing members of the NMLA paramilitary group.; Survivors of the defeated Neo-Marlinist Order of Mudhrid arrive in the Marlinist Colonies aboard the Steel Majesty, requesting asylum.
jenna-fairfax.bio_full:
Dr Jenna Fairfax is a prominent leader within the Marlinist community and a key figure in the political structures that emerged from the Marlinist refugee crisis. As the Marlinist Parliament's spokesperson, she has consistently sought to distance mainstream Marlinism from the terrorist tactics of the Neo-Marlinist Liberation Army (NMLA), cooperating with both Federal and Imperial authorities to identify extremists hiding among refugee populations.

Fairfax's political position reflects the impossible tightrope Marlinist leaders must walk: condemning terrorism without abandoning the democratic principles that define Marlinism, and building new colonial governments while navigating superpower suspicion. Her public statement denouncing NMLA members discovered among refugees — "These killers do not represent the principles of Marlinism, and we are happy to cooperate in expelling them" — exemplifies the pragmatic accommodation required of a political movement born from persecution and struggling for legitimacy.

eugene-cooper.name: Eugene Cooper
eugene-cooper.bio: Eugene Cooper is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-30 to 3301-05-30. The last such mid-term transition occurred in 3264 when Antonia Madison ousted Eugene Cooper.

siobhan-vogel.name: Siobhan Vogel
siobhan-vogel.bio: Siobhan Vogel is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-08-18 to 3304-08-18. Closely associated with Far God cult, Federal Intelligence Agency. Professor Siobhan Vogel of the Interstellar Association of Universities files a formal complaint, calling the arrest a dangerous precedent.

skylar-anderson.name: Skylar Anderson
skylar-anderson.bio: Skylar Anderson is an Imperial Navy Vice Admiral who served as the Empire's military liaison to Aegis during the Thargoid Titan War.
skylar-anderson.bio_full:
Vice Admiral Skylar Anderson is an Imperial Navy officer who served as the Empire's military liaison to Aegis during the Thargoid Titan War. In 3309, she was selected by Princess Aisling Duval as part of the Imperial delegation to a reformed Aegis, alongside Senator Caspian Leopold and xenological specialist Ivano Colombera.

Anderson provided strategic oversight for the ammonia world survey, noting that the data would be used to deploy concealed sensor buoys in systems containing ammonia worlds — alerting Aegis to Thargoid vessels or Maelstrom manifestations and providing advance warning for evacuations or pre-emptive strikes. Her military perspective emphasised the tactical value of exploration data in a war where Thargoid incursions could appear without warning. Anderson's appointment to the Aegis liaison role represented the Empire's cautious re-engagement with tri-superpower anti-xeno cooperation after Emperor Arissa's isolationist turn.

cope.name: Cope
cope.bio: Cope is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-28 to 3301-09-18. Closely associated with Cemiess Empire Party, Imperial Internal Security Service, Emperor's Dawn. Agent Cope authorized the Cemiess Empire Party to reimburse pilots delivering reliable exploration data to Mackenzie Relay in the Cemiess system, as part of efforts to neutralize the insurgent threat.

shelby-ortega.name: Shelby Ortega
shelby-ortega.bio: Shelby Ortega is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-01-10 to 3303-08-25. Closely associated with 9th Legion, Lavigny's Legion, The Chapterhouse of Inquisition. Governor Shelby Ortega urges caution, noting the vessels can disable ship systems at will.

chloe-anders.name: Chloe Anders
chloe-anders.bio: Chloe Anders is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-01-31 to 3302-01-31. Chloe Anders of the Christian Dock surveillance team reported the vessel circled the station at close range before departing abruptly, leading to speculation that it was searching for something.

constantia-torval.name: Constantia Torval
constantia-torval.bio: Constantia Torval is a Senator in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-08-16 to 3310-01-11. Affiliated with Mastopolos Mining, Torval Mining Ltd, Torval-Mastopolos Mining. Notable activities include: Historian Sima Kalhana concludes her 3307 review, covering the Yuri Grom honey trap, Torval family rift, Colonia Bridge, NMLA's final stand, and Sa...; Torval-Mastopolos Mining and Wreaken Construction both establish headquarters in the LTT 198 system, escalating their long-standing corporate rivalry.
constantia-torval.bio_full:
Constantia Torval is the operations director of Torval-Mastopolos Mining and daughter of Senator Zemina Torval. In early 3308, she announced a bid by Torval Mining to acquire a mining contract from the Caine-Massey corporation in the Dulos system, stating that the company sought to reach a broader customer base beyond the Empire.

Following the boardroom coup that removed Zemina Torval from Mastopolos Mining in late 3307, Constantia's subsidiary was elected as the controlling authority of LTT 198, with permits available via the Pride of Bitterwood megaship. Constantia's leadership of Torval-Mastopolos Mining represented the Torval family's strategic pivot from direct corporate control of Mastopolos to building an independent mining empire through subsidiary operations, continuing her mother's legacy of combining political office with industrial expansion.

anders-blaine.name: Anders Blaine
anders-blaine.bio: Anders Blaine is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-06-20 to 3310-01-11. Affiliated with Imperial Senate, Imperial Palace. Notable activities include: Emperor Hengist Duval died en route to the Imperial Navy Medical Facility near the Imperial Palace after being stabbed during his wedding ceremony.; Princess Aisling Duval revealed that some of Chancellor Anders Blaine's advisors had connections to Emperor's Dawn, the same insurgent group linked...
anders-blaine.bio_full:
Chancellor Anders Blaine is the highest-ranking official in the Imperial government after the Emperor, serving as head of the Imperial Senate and principal advisor to the throne. A consummate political survivor, Blaine has navigated multiple succession crises, assassination attempts, and ideological purges while maintaining his position at the apex of Imperial power. His endorsement of Arissa Lavigny-Duval's claim to the throne in 3301 was decisive in securing her election as Empress.

Blaine's reputation suffered in 3301 when Princess Aisling Duval revealed that some of his advisors had connections to Emperor's Dawn, the insurgent group responsible for Hengist Duval's assassination. Though Blaine himself was never directly implicated, the scandal exposed the dangerous proximity of his circle to anti-establishment extremists. In the decades since, he has worked to rebuild his image as a steady hand guiding the Empire through the NMLA crisis and the Thargoid war — a symbol of Imperial continuity in turbulent times.

klatt.name: Klatt
klatt.bio: Klatt is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-12-07 to 3307-12-07. Closely associated with Far God cult.

commander-kitiara.name: Commander Kitiara
commander-kitiara.bio: Commander Kitiara is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-02-13 to 3301-02-13. Commander Kitiara is handling last-minute entrants.

ellie-blossum.name: Ellie Blossum
ellie-blossum.bio: Ellie Blossum is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-25 to 3301-05-25. Closely associated with Faveol family, Shadow Navy, Crimson Fortune Company. Crimson Fortune Company CEO Ellie Blossum denounced claims that Commander Wolzan and the Shadow Navy were terrorists.

denzile-dex.name: Denzile Dex
denzile-dex.bio: Denzile Dex is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-07-12 to 3301-07-12. Closely associated with Imperial Senate. Leaked technical documents linked new Imperial modules to research by discredited Professor Denzile Dex, raising safety concerns.

ernest-harris.name: Ernest Harris
ernest-harris.bio: Ernest Harris is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3306-11-05 to 3306-11-12. Closely associated with L.Y.S Corp, LTT 1935 Confederacy, Imperial Internal Security Service.

synaptic.name: Synaptic
synaptic.bio: Synaptic is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with XYZ Fight Club.

first-apostle.name: First Apostle
first-apostle.bio: First Apostle is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-15 to 3308-10-06. Closely associated with True Chapters, Vox Galactica.
first-apostle.bio_full: The First Apostle is the highest-ranking leader of the True Chapters, a sect of the Far God cult that interprets the Thargoids as divine harbingers of apocalypse. In 3308, the First Apostle claimed that the mysterious 'Thargoid roar' detected during the Battle of HIP 22460 was 'the voice of the Far God calling to the faithful,' asserting that the manifestation had begun. The First Apostle's rhetoric exemplifies how the Far God cult transforms military defeats into theological affirmations, framing humanity's destruction as a sacred transition rather than a catastrophe.

don-zhao.name: Don Zhao
don-zhao.bio: Don Zhao is a ceo in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-10-05 to 3304-10-05. Closely associated with Kuiper Mining Inc., Achilles Corporation, Federal Security Service. Two owners are identified: Don Zhao, CEO of Kuiper Mining Inc., and Anya Blackriver, a public-relations consultant.

han-zen.name: Han Zen
han-zen.bio: Han Zen is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-09-02 to 3302-09-02. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

john-jameson.name: John Jameson
john-jameson.bio: John Jameson is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3303-12-14 to 3304-07-29. Affiliated with INRA, League of Reparation. Notable activities include: Following the discovery of further INRA outposts, Emperor Arissa Lavigny-Duval and Alliance Prime Minister Edmund Mahon have denounced the now-defu...; The murder of Imperial Senator Nestor Cartesius has sparked widespread speculation about the INRA.
john-jameson.bio_full:
Commander John Jameson was a legendary pilot of the 3100s who became a tragic symbol of the Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm's moral bankruptcy. In the First Thargoid War, Jameson volunteered for a mission to deploy the mycoid virus — a biological weapon designed to cripple the Thargoid fleet. Unbeknownst to him, the INRA had sabotaged his ship to ensure he would not survive to reveal the truth, making him both the weapon's deliverer and its final victim.

The discovery of Jameson's ship and logs in 3304 revealed the full extent of the INRA's betrayal, sparking widespread outrage and directly motivating the League of Reparation's terrorist campaign against INRA descendants. Jameson's fate transformed him from a forgotten war hero into a martyr whose sacrifice exposed the darkest chapters of human-xeno warfare. His story remains a cautionary tale about how military institutions sacrifice individual integrity for strategic advantage.

mira-tiverion.name: Mira Tiverion
mira-tiverion.bio: Mira Tiverion is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-07-06 to 3304-07-15. Closely associated with Didiomanja Emperor's Grace, Emperor's Grace. The Didiomanja Emperor's Grace completes the Tiverion Academy, a flight school for Imperial naval cadets, and hosts an inaugural banquet. A monument to Admiral Mira Tiverion, the organisation's founding member, will be erected at the site.

faisal-sacranie.name: Faisal Sacranie
faisal-sacranie.bio: Faisal Sacranie is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-07-14 to 3308-07-21. Closely associated with Federal Intelligence Agency, Federal Times.

oskar-kincaid.name: Oskar Kincaid
oskar-kincaid.bio: Oskar Kincaid is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-04-28 to 3304-04-28. Closely associated with INRA, Alliance. Dr Oskar Kincaid, an Alliance historian, examined the INRA’s history of biochemical warfare against Thargoids and rumours of experimentation.

bitnick.name: BitNick
bitnick.bio: BitNick is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3311-12-16 to 3311-12-16. Closely associated with Zorgon Peterson. Zorgon Peterson confirmed the Caspian Explorer exceeded all internal projections during two-week field trials, with CMDR BitNick contributing the most exobiological data.

tal-wozniak.name: Tal Woźniak
tal-wozniak.bio: Tal Woźniak is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-05-18 to 3304-05-25. Closely associated with United Carnoeck for Equality, Alliance Defence Force. Security Chief Tal Woźniak thanked participants and stated that recovered data will help track down the pirate group responsible.
tal-wozniak.bio_full:
Tal Woźniak served as Security Chief for United Carnoeck for Equality, an organisation operating within Alliance space during the mid-3300s. In this capacity, he coordinated defensive operations against pirate groups threatening local trade routes and civilian installations. His role placed him at the intersection of local security concerns and the broader Alliance Defence Force's strategic priorities, requiring him to balance community autonomy with interstellar military cooperation.

During a notable operation in mid-3304, Woźniak oversaw a campaign to recover stolen data from pirate forces. Following its successful conclusion, he publicly thanked participating pilots and confirmed that the recovered intelligence would enable authorities to track down the responsible criminal group. His leadership demonstrated how security officials in Alliance systems relied on independent pilots to supplement formal law enforcement capabilities, a recurring pattern throughout Alliance frontier governance.

kay-kilbride.name: Kay Kilbride
kay-kilbride.bio: Kay Kilbride is a Commander in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-05-17 to 3304-07-28. Affiliated with League of Reparation, Alliance Interpol, INRA. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Aisling Duval's anti-slavery campaign merging with Universal Liberty to form Unchain, Lori Jameson's denunciation of the Le...; Weekly summary covering Thargoids being repelled from core systems to Bhal, three starports restored to full functionality, Aisling Duval's engagem...
kay-kilbride.bio_full:
Kay Kilbride is a Chief Inspector with Alliance Interpol who led the multi-agency taskforce investigating the League of Reparation in 3304. When independent journalist Flint "Firemaker" Lafosse published theories linking the League to unsolved homicides dating back several years, Kilbride publicly cautioned against "baseless conjecture" that spread confusion while investigators pursued more concrete leads.

Kilbride's measured approach to the League investigation reflected Alliance Interpol's emphasis on evidence-based counter-terrorism during a period when the League was targeting INRA descendants across all three superpowers. Her leadership of the unified taskforce — which included cooperation with Imperial and Federal agencies — demonstrated that even amid superpower rivalry, law enforcement could coordinate against threats that transcended political boundaries.

flint-lafosse.name: Flint Lafosse
flint-lafosse.bio: Flint Lafosse is a Journalist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-06-15 to 3309-09-05. Affiliated with Rewired, The Rewired. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Aisling Duval's anti-slavery campaign merging with Universal Liberty to form Unchain, Lori Jameson's denunciation of the Le...; Independent journalist Flint 'Firemaker' Lafosse publishes classified ACT information allegedly from Neo-Marlinist survivors claiming that Hadrian ...
flint-lafosse.bio_full:
Flint "Firemaker" Lafosse is an independent journalist who publishes through the Rewired newsfeed, known for his unconventional investigative methods and willingness to pursue theories dismissed by official sources. In June 3304, he published a groundbreaking report suggesting that the League of Reparation had been active for years before publicly claiming responsibility for its attacks, linking unsolved homicides and mysterious shipwrecks to victims with INRA connections.

Lafosse's theory was initially dismissed by Alliance Interpol Chief Inspector Kay Kilbride as baseless conjecture, but his research identified four confirmed INRA-connected victims killed by nerve agents between one and five years prior to the League's emergence. His work raised alarming questions about how long the terrorist organisation had operated in secrecy and whether dozens or hundreds of deaths had gone unrecognised as politically motivated killings. Lafosse remains a controversial figure in galactic journalism, respected by conspiracy researchers and criticised by establishment media alike.

sima-kalhana.name: Sima Kalhana
sima-kalhana.bio: Sima Kalhana is a Emperor in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3301-07-05 to 3309-01-03. Affiliated with Alliance, Federation, Sirius Corporation. Notable activities include: Historian Sima Kalhana covers the Empire's founding.; Historian Sima Kalhana covers the first Federation-Achenar war (2323-2325).
sima-kalhana.bio_full:
Sima Kalhana is a renowned historian and author whose GalNet series on defining moments in human history became one of the most widely read educational programmes of the early 3300s. Beginning in July 3301, her articles covered the founding of the Federation, the birth of the Empire, the first Federation-Achenar war, the rise of Sirius Corporation, and the history of the Thargoids and generation ships. Her work is credited with bringing foundational galactic history to a mass audience during a period of renewed interstellar tension.

Kalhana's writing is characterised by rigorous archival research and a narrative style that connects ancient events to contemporary politics. She returned to prominence in late 3307 with a multi-part retrospective of that turbulent year, analysing the NMLA crisis, the Galactic Summit, and the fall of Aegis. Her histories remain standard reference points for understanding the deep roots of superpower rivalry and corporate power in human civilisation.

kazien-vantris.name: Kazien Vantris
kazien-vantris.bio: Kazien Vantris is a senator in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-12 to 3301-07-21. Closely associated with Imperial Herald. Imperial Herald chief editor Kazien Vantris noted that denying everything is the first rule of vying for power, suggesting Loren is keeping her options open.

orange.name: Orange!
orange.bio: Orange! is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-09-02 to 3308-09-02. Closely associated with Universal Cartographics, Independent Explorers Association.

rory-webster.name: Rory Webster
rory-webster.bio: Rory Webster is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3306-09-18 to 3307-01-25. Affiliated with Federal Navy, Federal Times. Notable activities include: Fleet Admiral Lucas Vincent is arrested for ordering the sabotage of Starship One.; Chief Technician Rory Webster of the Federal Navy Engineering Corps is arrested for sabotaging Starship One.
rory-webster.bio_full:
Rory Webster is a former Chief Technician in the Federal Navy who became the central figure in the Starship One sabotage case — one of the most significant criminal trials in Federal history. In October 3306, Webster was charged with mass murder and treason for ordering his engineering team to sabotage Starship One's hyperdrive systems, causing the presidential vessel's destruction in 3301 with hundreds aboard.

During his trial, Webster changed his plea to guilty and claimed he had acted on "orders from the top" — a confession that halted proceedings while the Federal Intelligence Agency took his testimony. In October 3306, he provided evidence that Fleet Admiral Lucas Vincent had directly commanded him to arrange for Starship One to suffer the same fate as the Highliner Antares, with the orders allegedly delivered on a private channel accompanied by threats. Webster received a lenient 20-year sentence in acknowledgment that he performed criminal acts under duress. His testimony exposed high-level conspiracy within the Federal Navy's upper ranks and sent shockwaves through Federation politics, threatening to implicate figures close to President Hudson himself.

kitsunethe-fluff.name: KitsuneThe Fluff
kitsunethe-fluff.bio: KitsuneThe Fluff is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-10-05 to 3301-10-05. Closely associated with Fuel Rats, Radio Sidewinder. Commanders KitsuneThe Fluff and Radlock were each recognized for achieving 100 individual rescues, with KitsuneThe Fluff being the first to reach that milestone.

commander-duck-of-death.name: Commander Duck of Death
commander-duck-of-death.bio: Commander Duck of Death is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-26 to 3302-11-26. Closely associated with Pilots Federation, Elite Travel Writers' Cooperative.

civility-marks.name: Civility Marks
civility-marks.bio: Civility Marks is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3303-11-17 to 3303-11-17. Closely associated with Alliance, Spinward Marches Alliance Concern.

neo-marlinist.name: Neo-Marlinist
neo-marlinist.bio: Neo-Marlinist is a terrorist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-03-11 to 3307-03-19. Closely associated with NMLA, Alliance, Marlinist. Private investigators Erik Gunnarson and Francesca Wolfe review The Neo-Marlinist Liberation Army.

nisha-devi.name: Nisha Devi
nisha-devi.bio: Nisha Devi is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3307-08-24 to 3307-08-24. Closely associated with Kumo Crew, Vandermeer Corporation, Interstellar Health Organisation.

wace.name: Wace
wace.bio: Wace is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-09-02 to 3302-09-02. Closely associated with Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

commander-lokquine.name: Commander Lokquine
commander-lokquine.bio: Commander Lokquine is a engineer in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-03-19 to 3301-03-19. Closely associated with Core Dynamics, Hudson Dock's Shipyard Union.

john-stabler.name: John Stabler
john-stabler.bio: John Stabler is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-03 to 3302-03-03. Closely associated with Lave Radio Network, Cherbones Mining Authority.

driggers.name: Driggers
driggers.bio: Driggers is a pirate in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-25 to 3301-08-25. Closely associated with Stratis Information Group, Kumo Crew, Interstellar Press.

owen-mckenna.name: Owen McKenna
owen-mckenna.bio: Owen McKenna is the CEO of Core Dynamics, appointed after Jupiter Rochester's imprisonment for treason and mass murder in March 3307. He led the campaign to purge Rochester loyalists and defeat the breakaway Jupiter Division, then steered the company back toward its military manufacturing roots. In 3312, McKenna announced the full production and general shipyard availability of the Kestrel fighter, hailing it as the small combat ship of choice for pilots across the core systems.
owen-mckenna.bio_full:
Owen McKenna is the CEO of Core Dynamics who took over after Jupiter Rochester's imprisonment for treason and mass murder in March 3307. McKenna vowed to purge the company of all his predecessor's loyalists and destroy Jupiter Division, the breakaway faction that Rochester had created to pursue corporatist ideals.

Under McKenna's leadership, Core Dynamics battled Jupiter Division in the Ts'ao Tach system and eventually triumphed in June 3307. McKenna also oversaw the company's acquisition of Vodel in 3305, which led to the development of the Scorpion SRV. His tenure represented a return to Core Dynamics' traditional military manufacturing focus after Rochester's failed attempt to transform the Federation into a corporatocracy. In June 3312, McKenna announced that the Kestrel fighter had moved from limited release to full production and was now available at shipyards across the core systems.

patience-middleton.name: Patience Middleton
patience-middleton.bio: Patience Middleton is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3307-05-07 to 3307-11-18. Affiliated with Taurus Mining Ventures, Aegis, Pilots Federation. Notable activities include: The mysterious figure 'Salvation' sends a message to pilots who discovered the Hesperus, authorising Taurus Mining Ventures to pay for logs and pro...; Pilots discover the Proteus, an Anaconda from the Hesperus, at a historical battlefield on Trapezium Sector YU-X c1-2 1a.
patience-middleton.bio_full:
Patience Middleton is a representative of Taurus Mining Ventures, the commercial partner of the mysterious anti-xeno scientist known as Salvation. In May 3307, she announced that Salvation had authorised payments of two million credits or ten units of void opals for pilots who delivered logs from the Hesperus megaship to the Hind Mine asteroid base in the T Tauri system.

Middleton's role as a corporate intermediary allowed Salvation to maintain anonymity while recruiting pilots for his operations. She relayed Salvation's message that his scientific breakthroughs would "literally save all of humanity," and confirmed that further work would be offered to intrepid agents. Her position at Taurus Mining Ventures exemplified how Salvation used legitimate corporate structures to mask his Azimuth Biochemicals background and acquire resources for his Guardian-derived superweapon research.

luca-hem.name: Luca Hem
luca-hem.bio: Luca Hem is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3304-06-08 to 3304-06-10. Closely associated with INRA. Luca Hem, great-grandson of INRA programme coordinator Amaro Hem, is murdered by the League of Reparation.

captain-gc-richards.name: Captain G.C. Richards
captain-gc-richards.bio: Captain G.C. Richards is a president in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-03-10 to 3302-03-17. Closely associated with Federal Navy, Beta Hydri Corporation.

katrien-rook.name: Katrien Rook
katrien-rook.bio: Katrien Rook is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-12-06 to 3306-06-09. Affiliated with Vitadyne Labs, Interstellar Health Organisation, Utopia. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Juanita Bishop's call to ban the Far God book, new asteroid-mining equipment from the Industrial Mining Guild, Princess Ais...; Weekly summary covering Isolde Rochester's appointment as Shadow Vice President, Imperial senators demanding Hadrian Duval's recognition with Chanc...
katrien-rook.bio_full:
Professor Katrien Rook is a leading scientist at Vitadyne Labs who announced a breakthrough in nanomedicine development in December 3304. Her team's pharmaceuticals use nanoscale materials to repair cell damage on a molecular level, with claimed capabilities including accelerated healing of injuries, cure of diseases and infections, and extension of human lifespan by 30 to 50 years through slowed cellular senescence.

The announcement triggered immediate controversy when Simguru Pranav Antal accused Vitadyne of appropriating salvaged Utopian technology. The Interstellar Health Organisation reviewed the data, and in January 3305 Vitadyne admitted the nanomeds were of Utopian origin. The dispute highlighted tensions between corporate research institutions and communal societies over intellectual property, with the IHO ultimately ruling in Vitadyne's favour despite Utopia's objections.

sothy-ferrell.name: Sothy Ferrell
sothy-ferrell.bio: Sothy Ferrell is a emperor in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-08-26 to 3301-08-26. Closely associated with Emperor's Dawn, Interstellar Press.

marcus-mercer.name: Marcus Mercer
marcus-mercer.bio: Marcus Mercer is a pilot in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-08-15 to 3308-08-15. Closely associated with Pilots Federation.

nestor-cartesius.name: Nestor Cartesius
nestor-cartesius.bio: Nestor Cartesius is a Senator in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3303-10-19 to 3304-08-11. Affiliated with Imperial Internal Security Service, INRA. Notable activities include: The murder of Imperial Senator Nestor Cartesius has sparked widespread speculation about the INRA.; Further abandoned INRA outposts have been discovered, revealing that the mycoid fungus was an unplanned by-product of research and was tested on li...
nestor-cartesius.bio_full:
Nestor Cartesius is an Imperial senator who became a target of the League of Reparation, the terrorist organisation that hunted descendants of INRA personnel. In July 3304, the tri-superpower taskforce investigating the League confirmed that Senator Cartesius was among the high-profile individuals targeted by the group, which left "For Jameson" messages at attack sites.

The League's campaign against Cartesius and others was designed to generate exposure and spread terror to families with an INRA connection. Following the decryption of the League's communications network, taskforce officers arrested or eliminated every member of the organisation, with Cartesius surviving the threat. The League's dismantling closed a dark chapter of INRA-related terrorism, though questions lingered about the true motivations of its architect, Riri McAllister.

george-varma.name: George Varma
george-varma.bio: George Varma is a Admiral in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-05-25 to 3308-11-01. Affiliated with League of Reparation, Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Admiral Varma's arrest, the Church of Eternal Void declaring war on the Far God cult, Aisling Duval's wedding date announce...; Weekly summary covering Riri McAllister being unmasked as Nexus and framing Admiral Varma, the hunt for League strongholds in Zibal and Ienpalang, ...
george-varma.bio_full:
Admiral George Varma was a member of the Alliance Council of Admirals who was arrested in July 3304 for his alleged role as "Nexus," the coordinator of the League of Reparation terrorist organisation. Captain Niamh Seutonia and Senior Agent Tanya Ramirez confronted Varma during a meeting of admiralty staff at Donaldson starport in Alioth, placing him under arrest despite protests.

The tri-superpower taskforce investigating the League of Reparation had evidence that Varma was secretly redirecting cargo shipments from the Alliance Defence Force to terrorist cells, providing them with military-issue weapons, equipment and encryption. The arrest created diplomatic ripples, with Federal and Imperial ambassadors summoned before the Alliance Assembly. Council member Jed Trager called the arrest an "egregious transgression," though Prime Minister Edmund Mahon stated that the body of evidence against Varma was considerable. His case exposed the vulnerability of Alliance military institutions to infiltration and the challenges of coordinating counter-terrorism across superpower boundaries.

jordan-rochester.name: Jordan Rochester
jordan-rochester.bio: Jordan Rochester is a Diplomat in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-05-26 to 3306-11-20. Affiliated with Imperial Palace, Alliance. Notable activities include: Weekly summary covering Thargoids being repelled from core systems to Bhal, three starports restored to full functionality, Aisling Duval's engagem...; Weekly summary covering Chief Inspector Kay Kilbride's murder by the League of Reparation, reactions to Aisling Duval and Jordan Rochester's engage...
jordan-rochester.bio_full:
Jordan Rochester is a Federal diplomat and member of the influential Rochester family, best known for his engagement to Princess Aisling Duval — a union that briefly promised to bridge the superpower divide before being cancelled amid rising tensions. As Federal Ambassador, Rochester represented the Federation in critical negotiations with the Empire, most notably during the Marlinist refugee crisis of 3306, when he accused the Empire of conducting a "totalitarian purge" of democratic believers.

Rochester's diplomatic career epitomised the complex intersection of family influence and public service. While his engagement to Aisling Duval generated headlines and political speculation, his professional focus remained on defending Federal interests against Imperial pressure. His sharp rhetoric during the Marlinist crisis contributed to the suspension of official superpower communications, demonstrating both his principled stand on human rights and the risks of inflammatory diplomacy at times of heightened tension.

aoishe-quaid.name: Aoishe Quaid
aoishe-quaid.bio: Aoishe Quaid is a scientist in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-09-20 to 3301-09-20. The Federal research programme studying anomalous extraterrestrial objects was abruptly terminated by Fort Harrison station governor Aoishe Quaid only one week after its inauguration. Sources suggested Quaid was pressured into the decision despite her enthusiasm for the project.

ivan-johansen.name: Ivan Johansen
ivan-johansen.bio: Ivan Johansen is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3305-11-08 to 3305-11-14. Closely associated with Upaniklis Vision Incorporated, Interstellar Health Organisation.

commander-felix-macedonica.name: Commander Felix Macedonica
commander-felix-macedonica.bio: Commander Felix Macedonica is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-26 to 3302-11-26. Closely associated with Institute for Galactic Exploration and Research. Commander Chiggy Vonrictofen conducted a dramatic rescue of Commander Felix Macedonica, who was stranded 65,000 light years from home without sufficient germanium to synthesise an FSD injection. Chiggy traveled to Colonia, fitted a mining laser, and crossed 30,000 light years to reach Felix within 48 hours.

bill-turner.name: Bill Turner
bill-turner.bio: Bill Turner is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3308-06-16 to 3308-06-16. Closely associated with Alliance, Sirius Corporation.

baron-kosmetas.name: Baron Kosmetas
baron-kosmetas.bio: Baron Kosmetas is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3301-05-16 to 3301-05-16. Closely associated with Eotienses Citizens' Forum. Top contributors honoured include Viscount Plo Koon, Baron Coiling Dragon, Earl Prawnetto, Earl Morton and Baron Kosmetas.

cora-shaw.name: Cora Shaw
cora-shaw.bio: Cora Shaw is a Scientist in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3302-04-15 to 3304-10-27. Affiliated with Palin Institute, Aegis, Cordova Group. Notable activities include: This article recounts the history of Thargoid contact from the discovery of Unknown Artefacts in 3301 through to recent attacks and the creation of...; Reports of further unprovoked Thargoid attacks in the Pleiades have reached the core systems, targeting Imperial and civilian ships in HIP 17225, H...
cora-shaw.bio_full:
Professor Cora Shaw is a scientist and the successor to Ishmael Palin as director of the Palin Institute. In April 3302, Palin announced his retirement from active research, citing "dark forces" opposing his ideals, and transferred directorship to Shaw, whom he described as his closest ally for many years.

Under Shaw's leadership, the Palin Institute continued its research into Unknown Artefacts and meta-alloys, maintaining its position as a leading authority on Thargoid-related phenomena. Shaw also collaborated with Aegis during the early Thargoid conflicts, contributing to the scientific understanding of the alien threat. Her stewardship of the Institute preserved Palin's legacy while adapting to the rapidly evolving Thargoid crisis that would dominate galactic affairs for the following decades.

commander-lewis.name: Commander Lewis
commander-lewis.bio: Commander Lewis is a commander in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-11-05 to 3302-11-05. Amateur explorer Commander Lewis has returned to human-inhabited space after becoming stranded in a damaged Asp Scout approximately 65,000 light years from civilisation.

commander-furrycat.name: Commander furrycat
commander-furrycat.bio: Commander furrycat is a prominent figure in the Elite Dangerous universe, active from 3302-06-10 to 3302-06-10. Closely associated with Elite Racers, Buckyball Racing Club.

lewis-chapman.name: Lewis Chapman
lewis-chapman.bio: Chief executive of Starship Enterprises Corporation, Dr Lewis Chapman pursued ambitious projects ranging from wildlife reserves to mining operations across the galaxy.
lewis-chapman.bio_full:
Dr Lewis Chapman heads the Starship Enterprises Corporation, a company with unusually diverse interests. In late 3302, he announced a plan to transform the LP 339-7 system into a tourist destination by establishing a wildlife reserve on LP 339-7 4 A, populated with cloned Earth animals genetically tailored to their new environment. The project required everything from progenitor cells to atmospheric processors, drawing hundreds of pilots into the effort.

Chapman's corporate ambitions extended beyond tourism. By mid-3305, Starship Enterprises was launching major mining campaigns, demonstrating the company's evolution from speculative habitat design to resource extraction. Throughout, Chapman maintained a pattern of coupling ambitious construction goals with open commodity orders and security contracts for independent pilots.

caspian-leopold.name: Caspian Leopold
caspian-leopold.bio: Caspian Leopold is a Senator in Elite Dangerous lore, active from 3304-05-26 to 3309-11-14. Affiliated with Aegis, Alliance. Notable activities include: Senator Caspian Leopold launches an initiative to construct a rehabilitation centre for civilians affected by heightened military action in the cor...; Weekly summary covering Aisling Duval's anti-slavery campaign merging with Universal Liberty to form Unchain, Lori Jameson's denunciation of the Le...
caspian-leopold.bio_full:
Caspian Leopold is an Imperial Senator known for his considerable wealth, oratorical skill, and political influence within the Empire.
