The group is conducting a deep planetary survey of Merope and urges pilots with planetary landing suites to search for large barnacles across the Pleiades.

prisms-shades.name: Prism's Shades
prisms-shades.bio: Prism's Shades is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-22 to 3301-05-22. Developed or used by Aisling Duval. Aisling Duval attended the opening of 'Prism's Shades', a multi-sensory art installation on Emerald in Cemiess that uses experimental light and sound projection to stimulate empathic responses.

imperial-interdictor-lucius.name: Imperial Interdictor Lucius
imperial-interdictor-lucius.bio: Imperial Interdictor Lucius is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-04-02 to 3301-04-02. Developed or used by Kahina Tijani Loren, Sol Herald.

farragut-battle-cruiser.name: Farragut Battle Cruiser
farragut-battle-cruiser.bio: The Farragut-class Battle Cruiser is the primary capital ship of the Federal Navy. Massive and heavily armed, these vessels serve as flagships for Federal fleets and are capable of deploying fighter squadrons. They represent the pinnacle of Federal military engineering.
farragut-battle-cruiser.bio_full: The Farragut-class Battle Cruiser is the Federal Navy's primary capital ship and the largest vessel in its fleet. These massive warships serve as fleet flagships, capable of deploying squadrons of F63 Condor fighters and unleashing devastating broadsides. Their presence in a system signals serious Federal military commitment. Farraguts have been deployed in major conflicts including the fight against Thargoid forces and various system liberation campaigns. Despite their firepower, they have proven vulnerable to concentrated Thargoid attack, with several lost during the Titan War.

faulcon-delacy-anaconda.name: Faulcon DeLacy Anaconda
faulcon-delacy-anaconda.bio: Faulcon DeLacy Anaconda is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-04-23 to 3301-05-22. Developed or used by Buckyball Run, Léonard Chamberlain, Mirana Ortilano. At time of broadcast, Commander Anuranium held the record in a Faulcon DeLacy Anaconda. His first record was set in a Lakon Spaceways Asp named 'Big Bird'; his current record was achieved in a Faulcon DeLacy Anaconda named 'Rhonda'.

thargoid-titan-wreckage.name: Thargoid Titan wreckage
thargoid-titan-wreckage.bio: Thargoid Titan wreckage is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-10-16 to 3310-10-16. Developed or used by Shamus Madigan, Achilles Aerospace, Aegis.

rescue-ship-cornwallis.name: Rescue Ship Cornwallis
rescue-ship-cornwallis.bio: Rescue Ship Cornwallis is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

mk-ii-cargo-rack.name: Mk II cargo rack
mk-ii-cargo-rack.bio: Mk II cargo rack is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-10-30 to 3311-10-30. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson. Zorgon Peterson confirmed the Panther Clipper has entered full production and is now available at core system shipyards, with over 1,200 tonnes cargo capacity and Mk II cargo rack compatibility.

asp.name: Asp
asp.bio: Asp is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-03-18 to 3301-03-18. Developed or used by Virgil Kyle. Due to jump distances, the system is only reachable by Asps and Anacondas fitted for near-maximum jump ranges.

asp-explorer.name: Asp Explorer
asp-explorer.bio: Asp Explorer is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-01 to 3302-07-01. Developed or used by Federal Auxiliary Navy, Admiral Maxton Price. A Federal Auxiliary Navy captain flying an Asp Explorer was shot down by Federal vessels above Merope 2 A near a barnacle site. Pilots are gathering in Maia, with many flying Asp Explorers fitted for long-range trade.

emergency-power-cells.name: Emergency power cells
emergency-power-cells.bio: Emergency power cells is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-22 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Pilots Federation.

sco-frame-shift-drive.name: SCO frame shift drive
sco-frame-shift-drive.bio: SCO Frame Shift Drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-07-30 to 3310-07-30. Developed or used by Lakon Spaceways, Faulcon DeLacy, Devin Kaneda. Lakon Spaceways chairperson Naomi Landseer reveals the Type-8 was moved back to the theoretical stage to accommodate SCO drive stresses, resulting in the largest medium-class freighter frame. Lakon Spaceways releases the Type-8, a medium-class freighter optimised for SCO frame shift drive travel, boasting larger cargo capacity and greater resilience than competitors.

allied-solace.name: Allied Solace
allied-solace.bio: Allied Solace is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359.

caustic-enzyme.name: Caustic enzyme
caustic-enzyme.bio: Caustic enzyme is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-05-24 to 3307-05-24. Developed or used by Sirius Inc, Pilots Federation, Engineers.

corsair.name: Corsair
corsair.bio: The Corsair is a medium-sized multirole ship manufactured by Gutamaya Shipyards, introduced in April 3311 as the first commercially available Imperial vessel that required no Navy rank qualification for purchase. Princess Aisling Duval publicly endorsed the ship at its Capitol launch event, signalling a shift in Imperial industrial policy toward broader pilot markets.
corsair.bio_full:
In April 3311, Gutamaya Shipyards broke with decades of tradition by releasing the Corsair — the first commercially available multirole Imperial vessel that required no Navy rank qualification for purchase. Lead engineer Ines Allende declared the ship a 'significant milestone,' combining Gutamaya's characteristic elegant design with balanced hardpoint configuration, substantial cargo capacity, powerful thrusters, and four utility slots. The vessel's medium-size classification made it viable for trading with outposts inaccessible to larger Imperial ships, opening the manufacturer's market beyond military and aristocratic clientele.

Princess Aisling Duval's presence at the Capitol launch event provided the celebrity endorsement that Gutamaya clearly sought, with the Princess announcing she would add a Corsair to her personal fleet and praising the ship as proof of 'the Empire's commitment to innovation.' The release marked a subtle but significant shift in Imperial industrial policy: for the first time, one of the Empire's premier shipbuilders acknowledged that prestige and military exclusivity might be less profitable than selling versatile vessels to the broader pilot market.

electronic-countermeasure.name: electronic countermeasure
electronic-countermeasure.bio: electronic countermeasure is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-08-12 to 3302-08-12. Developed or used by Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm, Arvan Corto, Sima Kalhana.

proteus-anaconda.name: Proteus Anaconda
proteus-anaconda.bio: Proteus Anaconda is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-06-18 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Patience Middleton. Pilots discover the Proteus, an Anaconda from the Hesperus, at a historical battlefield on Trapezium Sector YU-X c1-2 1a. Salvation claims exclusive rights to the Proteus battlefield site.

onionhead-lucan-strain.name: Onionhead Lucan strain
onionhead-lucan-strain.bio: Onionhead Lucan strain is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-12 to 3307-07-12. Developed or used by Scythe of Panem, Vox Galactica, Kumo Crew.

utility-slots.name: utility slots
utility-slots.bio: utility slots is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-04-08 to 3311-04-08. Developed or used by Ines Allende, Imperial Navy.

adamastor-derelict-megaship.name: Adamastor derelict megaship
adamastor-derelict-megaship.bio: Adamastor derelict megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-08 to 3307-04-19. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Pharmasapien. A dormant communications beacon aboard the 200-year-old ghost ship Adamastor in the Chukchan system suddenly activates, receiving and rebroadcasting an encrypted interstellar signal. Independent pilots report receiving anonymous instructions from a figure calling himself "Salvation," who provides a decryption key for the Adamastor's mysterious signal.

osmium.name: osmium
osmium.bio: osmium is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-28 to 3302-07-28. Developed or used by 80 DD-D 774-CE-2. The 80 DD-D 774-CE-2 faction launches a campaign to establish a planetary outpost in Eol Prou RS-T d3-94 to support trade and exploration around Jaques Station, requesting mined osmium deliveries.

imperial-clipper.name: Imperial Clipper
imperial-clipper.bio: The Imperial Clipper is a prestigious vessel manufactured by Gutamaya for the Empire. It is available only to pilots who have achieved the rank of Baron or higher in the Imperial Navy. Known for its elegant design and impressive speed, the Clipper is a symbol of Imperial luxury and status.
imperial-clipper.bio_full: The Imperial Clipper is a prestigious medium-sized vessel manufactured by Gutamaya exclusively for the Empire. Available only to pilots who have achieved the rank of Baron or higher in the Imperial Navy, the Clipper combines elegant aesthetics with impressive speed and cargo capacity. Its sleek, curved design has made it an iconic symbol of Imperial luxury and status. While its manoeuvrability and firepower are balanced by relatively weak shields for its size, the Clipper remains a popular choice for traders, couriers, and pilots who value both performance and prestige.

auto-fabricators.name: Auto fabricators
auto-fabricators.bio: Auto fabricators is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-22 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Pilots Federation.

rescue-ship-kisseih.name: Rescue Ship Kisseih
rescue-ship-kisseih.bio: Rescue Ship Kisseih is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

taipan-ax1.name: Taipan AX1
taipan-ax1.bio: Taipan AX1 is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-11-11 to 3303-11-11. Developed or used by Barr Winters, Aegis, Faulcon DeLacy. Faulcon DeLacy has teamed up with Aegis to produce the Taipan AX1, a new anti-Thargoid variant of its popular fighter.

cobra-class-vessel.name: Cobra-class Vessel
cobra-class-vessel.bio: Cobra-class Vessel is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-02-24 to 3303-02-24. An unidentified Cobra-class vessel was involved, and investigations are ongoing.

synthetic-reagent.name: Synthetic reagent
synthetic-reagent.bio: Synthetic reagent is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-06-17 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Sinclair Faraldo.

advanced-discovery-scanner.name: advanced discovery scanner
advanced-discovery-scanner.bio: advanced discovery scanner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-19 to 3302-07-19. Developed or used by Commander Rizal72, Canonn Interstellar Research Group.

vr-streams.name: VR-Streams
vr-streams.bio: VR-Streams is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-16 to 3301-05-16. Developed or used by Utopixx Entertainment, Reynhardt IntelliSys. The company attributed losses partly to development of new VR-Streams including the latest CQC franchise instalment.

trailblazer-megaship.name: Trailblazer megaship
trailblazer-megaship.bio: Trailblazer megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-08-21 to 3311-11-11. Developed or used by Mark Rennik, Brewer Corporation. Brewer Corporation announced the Trailblazer megaship fleet would be withdrawn beginning November 11th, declaring independent colonies self-sufficient after a year of logistical support.
trailblazer-megaship.bio_full:
The Trailblazer megaship represents Brewer Corporation's innovative approach to supporting independent colonisation, designed as a mobile infrastructure platform that could establish temporary footholds in uninhabited systems. These vessels carried the equipment, supplies, and technical expertise necessary to sustain colonists during the critical early phases of settlement, bridging the gap between initial arrival and the completion of permanent installations. Their deployment marked a significant shift in how frontier expansion was organised, reducing dependence on slow, expensive construction campaigns by bringing essential services directly to nascent colonies.

In late 3311, Brewer Corporation announced that the Trailblazer fleet would begin withdrawal on November 11th, declaring that supported independent colonies had achieved self-sufficiency after a year of logistical assistance. Chief Operating Officer Mark Rennik framed the withdrawal as evidence of the programme's success rather than its conclusion. This milestone demonstrated that the megaship-based support model could achieve its intended purpose, enabling colonies to transition from dependent outposts to autonomous settlements capable of sustaining themselves without continuous external support.

memorial-beacon.name: memorial beacon
memorial-beacon.bio: memorial beacon is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-06-18 to 3311-06-18. Developed or used by Thargoid, Federal Navy, CMDR StellarCartographer. A memorial beacon near the Titan Cocijo wreckage draws visitors, while Commodore Morayo Orina honours the lost at a Sol memorial service.

mk-ii-modules.name: Mk II modules
mk-ii-modules.bio: Mk II modules is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3312-03-23 to 3312-03-23. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson.

trailblazer-echo-megaship.name: Trailblazer Echo megaship
trailblazer-echo-megaship.bio: Trailblazer Echo megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-01-30 to 3311-01-30. Developed or used by Universal Cartographics, Madelyn Teague, Brewer Corporation.

spaceflight-one.name: Spaceflight One
spaceflight-one.bio: Spaceflight One is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-26 to 3301-05-27. Developed or used by Jasmina Halsey, Federal Navy, Felicia Winters. Secretary of State Felicia Winters assumed the role of Acting President after contact was lost with Spaceflight One carrying President Halsey and Vice President Naylor. Despite extensive searches along Spaceflight One's secured route, no trace was found.

cobra-mk-v.name: Cobra Mk V
cobra-mk-v.bio: Cobra Mk V is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-04-24 to 3311-04-24. Developed or used by Taron Raines, Faulcon DeLacy. Faulcon DeLacy's Cobra Mk V enters full production, offering improved handling, modularity, and SCO drive compatibility.

point-defence-module.name: Point Defence module
point-defence-module.bio: Point Defence module is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-07-17 to 3311-07-17. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson.

exceptional-scrambled-emission-data.name: Exceptional scrambled emission data
exceptional-scrambled-emission-data.bio: Exceptional scrambled emission data is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-29 to 3307-05-06. Developed or used by Zachary Hudson, Pilots Federation. Hudson seeks data to expand surveillance capabilities while Winters aims to develop privacy-protection technology. President Hudson's data delivery campaign outperforms Shadow President Winters' competing privacy-protection initiative.

rescue-ship-seacole.name: Rescue Ship Seacole
rescue-ship-seacole.bio: Rescue Ship Seacole is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

fns-nevermore.name: FNS Nevermore
fns-nevermore.bio: FNS Nevermore is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-03-11 to 3301-03-19. Developed or used by Core Dynamics, Federal Navy. Core Dynamics and the Federal Navy announced the FNS Nevermore, a Farragut-Class Battlecruiser. President Halsey's declaration of war diverted the FNS Nevermore from its planned attack on Polahukuna to the offensive against Lugh.
fns-nevermore.bio_full:
The FNS Nevermore stands as a Farragut-class Battlecruiser, one of the most powerful vessels in the Federal Navy's inventory, constructed through a collaboration between Core Dynamics and Federal military engineers. These massive capital ships serve as fleet command centres, mobile shipyards, and overwhelming combat platforms capable of projecting Federal power across entire sectors. The Nevermore's commissioning represented a significant investment in Federal naval capability during a period of intensifying superpower competition.

In March 3301, the Nevermore became embroiled in the rapidly escalating conflict surrounding the Lugh system when President Jasmina Halsey's declaration of war diverted the vessel from its planned offensive against Polahukuna. This last-minute redirection illustrated the chaotic nature of Federal military decision-making during the crisis, as strategic priorities shifted in response to political developments. The Nevermore's diversion highlighted how even the most powerful naval assets could be subject to abrupt reallocations driven by executive orders rather than operational planning.

vulture.name: Vulture
vulture.bio: Vulture is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-10-13 to 3301-10-13. Developed or used by Canonn Interstellar Research Group, RedWizzard. Commander Mike Juliett Kilo made the breakthrough by feeding a pre-recorded AEO signal into an antique scanner display, revealing a Vulture schematic matching his own ship at the time.

gilya-signature-weapons.name: Gilya signature weapons
gilya-signature-weapons.bio: Gilya signature weapons is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-06-30 to 3302-07-07. Developed or used by EG Pilots, Interstellar Communist Union, Trinity Avon. The first heat of the Rise to Power competition required pilots to deliver Gilya signature weapons to Gohar Station in the Jaradharre system.

mycoid-virus.name: mycoid virus
mycoid-virus.bio: mycoid virus is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-08-12 to 3302-08-12. Developed or used by Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm, Arvan Corto, Sima Kalhana. Historian Sima Kalhana reviewed the history of Thargoid encounters, from the first reported interdictions in 3125 to the INRA's alleged development of the mycoid virus.

guardian-orb.name: Guardian orb
guardian-orb.bio: Guardian orb is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-22 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation. Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launch rival Guardian artefact collection campaigns in PMD2009 48. Aegis launches an appeal for Guardian artefacts to support a new anti-xeno research programme.
guardian-orb.bio_full:
Guardian orbs constitute a distinctive category of artefacts recovered from sites associated with the ancient Guardian civilisation, which attained remarkable technological sophistication before its mysterious disappearance millions of years ago. These spherical objects, typically found alongside other Guardian relics such as totems, caskets, and tablets, represent some of the most visually striking remnants of a species that developed parallel to humanity but reached interstellar capability long before Earthly civilisations emerged. Archaeological analysis suggests the orbs may have served ceremonial, computational, or energy-storage functions, though their precise purpose remains subject to ongoing research.

During mid-3307, Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launched competing collection campaigns focused on Guardian artefacts, including orbs, from archaeological sites in the PMD2009 48 system. Aegis specifically sought these objects to support its anti-xeno research programme, hoping that understanding Guardian technology would yield insights applicable to the Thargoid threat. The rival collection efforts highlighted both the scientific value of Guardian materials and the intense competition among human organisations to unlock their secrets, as conventional approaches to the alien conflict proved increasingly inadequate.

faulcon-delacey-viper-mk-iv.name: Faulcon DeLacey Viper Mk IV
faulcon-delacey-viper-mk-iv.bio: Faulcon DeLacey Viper Mk IV is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-01-04 to 3302-01-04. Developed or used by Diamond Frogs, Pilots Federation, Doot. Event organizers also offered new Pilots Federation members a Faulcon DeLacey Viper Mk IV and cash rewards up to 100 million credits for top contributors.

black-operations-megaships.name: black operations megaships
black-operations-megaships.bio: black operations megaships is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-07-03 to 3311-07-03. Developed or used by Jerome Archer, Li Yong-Rui, Empire.

asp-scout.name: Asp Scout
asp-scout.bio: Asp Scout is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-11-05 to 3302-11-05. Developed or used by Commander Lewis, Shanaeri Rynale. Amateur explorer Commander Lewis has returned to human-inhabited space after becoming stranded in a damaged Asp Scout approximately 65,000 light years from civilisation.

type-6.name: Type-6
type-6.bio: Type-6 is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-04-25 to 3301-04-25. Developed or used by Lance 'Spacecat' D.. He survived thanks to quick reflexes, an auto field maintenance unit and his Type-6 transporter, now nicknamed the 'Sundiver'.

orbis-starport.name: Orbis starport
orbis-starport.bio: Orbis starport is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-15 to 3307-04-30. Developed or used by Kumo Crew, Pilots Federation. The Kumo Crew syndicate launches a campaign to construct up to five new Orbis starports in uninhabited systems near key trading regions. The Kumo Crew's starport construction campaign concludes successfully.
orbis-starport.bio_full:
The Orbis starport represents one of the most recognisable and ambitious station designs in human space, characterised by its distinctive rotating wheel structure that generates artificial gravity for occupants. These massive installations serve as major trade hubs, shipyards, and population centres, capable of supporting millions of residents and handling the largest vessels in civilian service. Their construction requires extraordinary material investment and engineering expertise, making each Orbis a significant statement of economic and industrial capability.

In 3307, the Kumo Crew syndicate launched an audacious campaign to construct up to five new Orbis starports in uninhabited systems near key trading regions, aiming to establish permanent criminal infrastructure on a scale previously unmatched. The campaign concluded successfully, demonstrating that even the most complex station designs could be deployed by non-state actors given sufficient resources and logistical support. This development alarmed authorities across all superpowers, as it established that major criminal organisations could project power through fixed installations rather than relying solely on mobile fleets.

auto-field-maintenance-unit.name: auto field maintenance unit
auto-field-maintenance-unit.bio: auto field maintenance unit is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-04-25 to 3301-04-25. Developed or used by Lance 'Spacecat' D.. He survived thanks to quick reflexes, an auto field maintenance unit and his Type-6 transporter, now nicknamed the 'Sundiver'.

nemesis-protocol.name: Nemesis protocol
nemesis-protocol.bio: Nemesis protocol is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-12-21 to 3309-12-21. Developed or used by Azimuth, Utopia, Caleb Wycherley. Seo Jin-ae returns from Utopia after discussing Salvation's Nemesis Failsafe with Pranav Antal, with both agreeing to keep their conclusions confidential.

nanites.name: nanites
nanites.bio: nanites is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-02-15 to 3310-02-15. Developed or used by Ishmael Palin.

supercruise-overcharge-frame-shift-drive.name: Supercruise Overcharge Frame Shift Drive
supercruise-overcharge-frame-shift-drive.bio: Supercruise Overcharge Frame Shift Drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-05-09 to 3310-05-09. Developed or used by Achilles Aerospace, Faulcon DeLacy, Namin Tirel. Achilles Aerospace releases the full range of Supercruise Overcharge drives and upgrades, with Dr. Namin Tirel revealing the technology was developed using Thargoid drive components recovered by independent pilots.

f63-condor.name: F63 Condor
f63-condor.bio: F63 Condor is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-12-06 to 3301-12-06. Developed or used by Gutamaya Shipyards, Pascal Roux, Imperial Herald.

shutdown-field-neutraliser.name: shutdown field neutraliser
shutdown-field-neutraliser.bio: shutdown-field neutraliser is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-13 to 3303-10-20. Developed or used by Aegis, Khun Independent Governance. Materials delivered by pilots will be used to test and mass-produce a shutdown-field neutraliser developed by engineer Elvira Martuuk to counter Thargoid immobilising fields.

unknown-probes.name: Unknown Probes
unknown-probes.bio: Unknown Probes are alien objects related to Unknown Artefacts. When scanned with an advanced discovery scanner, they emit an electro-magnetic pulse that temporarily incapacitates the scanning ship, followed by a burst of sound containing an encrypted image of interstellar bodies.
unknown-probes.bio_full: Unknown Probes are alien objects closely related to Unknown Artefacts, representing another facet of Thargoid reconnaissance technology. When scanned with an advanced discovery scanner, a probe emits an electro-magnetic pulse that temporarily incapacitates the scanning vessel. This is followed by a burst of sound similar to the "chittering" produced by Unknown Artefacts. Canonn Interstellar Research Group scientist Commander Rizal72 discovered that these sound recordings contain an encrypted image interpreted as a depiction of interstellar bodies. The exact meaning of the image and the probes' ultimate purpose remain unclear, though their similarity to Unknown Artefacts suggests they serve a complementary scouting function in Thargoid intelligence gathering.

rescue-ship-hutner.name: Rescue Ship Hutner
rescue-ship-hutner.bio: Rescue Ship Hutner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

suite-module.name: Suite Module
suite-module.bio: Suite Module is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-02-20 to 3311-02-20. Developed or used by Brewer Corporation, Mark Rennik. Brewer Corporation launched a campaign to supply new Trailblazer megaships for independent colonisation support, with COO Mark Rennik outlining beacon and suite module technology.

mk-ii-exploration-modules.name: Mk II exploration modules
mk-ii-exploration-modules.bio: Mk II exploration modules is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-12-02 to 3311-12-16. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson.

evacuation-shelters.name: evacuation shelters
evacuation-shelters.bio: Evacuation Shelters is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-12-21 to 3301-12-21. Developed or used by Ishmael Palin, Canonn Interstellar Research Group. Professor Ishmael Palin announces that his appeal for evacuation shelters to establish a research outpost on Maia b1ba was successful, and the new base should be operational within a week.

liquid-oxygen.name: Liquid oxygen
liquid-oxygen.bio: Liquid oxygen is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-08 to 3307-07-15. Developed or used by Archon Delaine, Kumo Crew, Blue Viper Club.

cortical-implant.name: Cortical implant
cortical-implant.bio: cortical implant is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3308-06-10 to 3311-06-03. Developed or used by Aegis, Alba Tesreau, Seo Jin-ae.

mk-ii-plasma-shock-accelerator.name: Mk II Plasma Shock Accelerator
mk-ii-plasma-shock-accelerator.bio: Mk II Plasma Shock Accelerator is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3312-02-24 to 3312-03-12. Developed or used by Core Dynamics, Owen McKenna. Three Mk II large hardpoints with Plasma Shock Accelerator compatibility.

machinery.name: Machinery
machinery.bio: Machinery is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11. Developed or used by Broker Mrozak, Broker Del Boy, Alliance. The Green Party of Diso's rejuvenation project for Birmingham succeeded spectacularly when 5,187 commanders delivered over 15 million tonnes of machinery in just 65 hours.

generation-ship.name: Generation ship
generation-ship.bio: generation ship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-08-19 to 3302-08-19. Developed or used by Sima Kalhana, Erik Gunnarson. Historian Sima Kalhana discussed the history of generation ships, noting that approximately 70,000 are still traversing the galaxy.

project-seraph.name: Project Seraph
project-seraph.bio: Project Seraph is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-10-18 to 3311-06-03. Developed or used by Aegis, Seo Jin-ae, Alba Tesreau. Seo, the sole survivor of Project Seraph's 197 test subjects, reveals her intent to find and shut down Salvation, whom she believes exists beyond physical death in HIP 22460.
project-seraph.bio_full:
Project Seraph stands as one of the most disturbing chapters in Aegis's history, a classified research programme that subjected nearly two hundred human test subjects to experimental procedures intended to develop anti-Thargoid capabilities. The project represented the darker side of wartime scientific urgency, where ethical boundaries were crossed in pursuit of perceived survival imperatives. Only one subject survived the trials: Seo Jin-ae, whose experiences would transform her into one of the most determined adversaries of the programme's architect, Salvation.

In late 3310, Seo revealed the full scope of Project Seraph's atrocities and declared her intent to find and shut down Salvation, whom she believed had transcended physical death to persist as a consciousness within the HIP 22460 system. Her revelations, supported by Aegis figures including Alba Tesreau, exposed how the organisation had permitted or actively supported research that treated human beings as disposable experimental material. Project Seraph thus became a symbol of the moral corruption that could emerge when fear of an external threat justified any means of response, leaving lasting scars on both survivors and the institutions that had enabled such practices.

toxandji-virocide.name: Toxandji Virocide
toxandji-virocide.bio: Toxandji Virocide is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-11-10 to 3302-11-10. Developed or used by Revolution Incorporated.

energy-grid-assemblies.name: energy grid assemblies
energy-grid-assemblies.bio: energy grid assemblies is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-21 to 3302-07-28. Developed or used by Jaques.

synthetic-molecules.name: Synthetic molecules
synthetic-molecules.bio: Synthetic molecules is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-20 to 3307-07-20. Developed or used by Kumo Crew, Blue Viper Club, Interstellar Health Organisation. The report finds the gamma strain uses genetically modified synthetic molecules that reduce hallucinogenic intensity while enabling mass production and longer storage life.

supercharged-frame-shift-drive.name: Supercharged Frame Shift Drive
supercharged-frame-shift-drive.bio: Supercharged Frame Shift Drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3312-02-24 to 3312-04-28. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson, Core Dynamics. Supercharged FSD is a first for a small craft. Designed for extreme deep-space exploration with extended jump range and supercharged FSD.
supercharged-frame-shift-drive.bio_full:
The Supercharged Frame Shift Drive represents a major leap in deep-space propulsion technology, developed through collaboration between Zorgon Peterson and Core Dynamics to address the persistent challenge of traversing vast interstellar distances efficiently. Unlike standard FSD units that operated within established safety parameters, the supercharged variant could temporarily push beyond conventional limits, generating extended jump ranges that opened previously inaccessible regions to small craft. This capability transformed the economics of exploration by allowing vessels that would normally require fleet carrier support to operate independently in the deep frontier.

Introduced in early 3312, the technology was specifically designed for extreme deep-space exploration missions where conventional range limitations would prove prohibitive. Its deployment on appropriately engineered hulls enabled independent pilots to push the boundaries of the galactic map with unprecedented speed and autonomy. The supercharged FSD exemplified how advances in frame shift technology continued to expand humanity's effective sphere of influence, making regions that had required weeks of travel accessible in days.

unclassified-relics.name: Unclassified relics
unclassified-relics.bio: Unclassified relics is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-01-18 to 3310-01-25. Developed or used by Aegis, Alba Tesreau. Aegis launches an initiative to collect Guardian relics and Unclassified relics for Ram Tah's classified anti-Titan research, with Tesreau expressing encouragement after witnessing laboratory tests.

supercruise-overcharge.name: Supercruise Overcharge
supercruise-overcharge.bio: Supercruise Overcharge is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-05-03 to 3310-05-07. Developed or used by Stent Jackson, Sirius Corporation, Achilles Aerospace.

meta-alloys.name: meta-alloys
meta-alloys.bio: meta-alloys is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3302-01-08 to 3303-10-12. Key developments: Dr Arcanonn of the Canonn Interstellar Research Group confirmed the discovery of alien 'barnacle' structures on at least two planets in the Pleiade...; Following the discovery of alien barnacles in the Pleiades Nebula, technical personnel at Obsidian Orbital conducted an eleventh-hour experiment us...
meta-alloys.bio_full:
Meta-alloys are a unique material produced by alien barnacle structures discovered in the Pleiades Nebula in 3302. These organic-metallic composites possess remarkable properties: they can repair Thargoid-induced station malfunctions, protect ship sensors from alien interference, and serve as a catalyst for advanced human technology. Professor Ishmael Palin's research established meta-alloys as humanity's first commercially viable alien product, transforming them from scientific curiosity into a strategically critical resource.

The discovery triggered an immediate superpower scramble for control of barnacle sites, with Federation, Empire, and Alliance forces all deploying to secure extraction rights. Meta-alloys proved dangerously disruptive — Thargoid vessels actively defended barnacle sites, and the rush to harvest brought independent pilots into direct conflict with alien defences. Though subsequent technological developments reduced humanity's dependence on meta-alloys, they remain a symbol of both the promise and peril of exploiting alien biology.

engineered-detailed-surface-scanner-v1.name: Engineered Detailed Surface Scanner V1
engineered-detailed-surface-scanner-v1.bio: Engineered Detailed Surface Scanner V1 is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-06-15 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Sirius Corporation, Sirius Atmospherics, Pilots Federation. Sirius Corporation requests commodities to mass-produce the Engineered Detailed Surface Scanner V1, previously a limited reward from Sirius Atmospherics' terraforming programme. Marketing director Sinclair Faraldo announces the module will have twice the probe coverage of standard scanners.
engineered-detailed-surface-scanner-v1.bio_full:
The Engineered Detailed Surface Scanner V1 represents a significant advancement in planetary survey technology, originally developed as a limited reward from Sirius Atmospherics' terraforming programme before Sirius Corporation pursued mass production to meet broader market demand. The module's key innovation was its expanded probe coverage, delivering twice the survey efficiency of standard scanners and dramatically reducing the time required to map planetary surfaces for resource identification, geological features, and biological signatures. This capability proved invaluable for explorers, miners, and researchers who depended on accurate surface data to plan operations.

In mid-3307, Sirius Corporation launched a commodities appeal to support the transition from limited production to mass manufacture, with Marketing Director Sinclair Faraldo publicly confirming that the module would soon be available through human technology brokers. The decision to commercialise what had been an exclusive terraforming incentive reflected both the module's proven utility and the economic opportunity presented by the expanding exploration and mining sectors. The Engineered DSS V1 demonstrated how technologies initially developed for specific industrial applications could find wider markets when their broader utility became apparent.

building-fabricators.name: building fabricators
building-fabricators.bio: building fabricators is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-28 to 3302-07-28. Developed or used by Future of Segovan.

wells-class-carrier.name: Wells-class Carrier
wells-class-carrier.bio: The Wells-class Carrier is a mobile fleet carrier design used by the Federation. These massive vessels can travel between star systems and serve as mobile bases for squadrons of smaller ships.
wells-class-carrier.bio_full: The Wells-class Carrier is a massive mobile fleet carrier design operated by the Federation. These vessels are capable of travelling between star systems and serve as mobile bases for squadrons of fighters and smaller ships. Unlike stationary installations, Wells-class carriers can reposition to support operations across vast distances, making them invaluable for extended military campaigns. Their deployment has been particularly significant in anti-xeno operations, where the ability to establish forward operating bases in threatened systems provides a tactical advantage against Thargoid forces.

mk-ii-mining-multi-limpet-controller.name: Mk II Mining Multi-Limpet Controller
mk-ii-mining-multi-limpet-controller.bio: Mk II Mining Multi-Limpet Controller is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-09-29 to 3311-10-13. Developed or used by Lakon Spaceways, Alioth Independents. Lakon Spaceways declared the Type-11 Prospector mining trials a success after pilots reported unprecedented fragment yields, and announced a permanent 8% boost to the Squadron mining perk.

anti-xeno-weaponry.name: Anti-xeno weaponry
anti-xeno-weaponry.bio: Anti-xeno weaponry is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-22 to 3307-04-29. Developed or used by Pilots Federation. Aegis launches an appeal for Guardian artefacts to support a new anti-xeno research programme. Aegis's anti-xeno research programme successfully collects mass deliveries of Guardian artefacts.

tritium.name: Tritium
tritium.bio: Tritium is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3307-05-21 to 3307-07-27. Used by Pilots Federation, Alliance. Key developments: The Alexandria megaship jumps from Delphi to HIP 16538, triggering a Thargoid attack.; The superpowers jointly suspend Aegis operations and authorise an inquiry into the Alexandria's disappearance.
tritium.bio_full:
Tritium is a radioactive isotope of hydrogen that serves as the primary fuel for fleet carriers, the massive mobile starports introduced by Brewer Corporation in the late 3300s. The isotope's properties make it ideal for powering the long-range jump drives that allow fleet carriers to traverse vast distances across the galaxy.

In September 3306, Brewer Corporation partnered with Kavanagh Spaceframes Ltd and Steel Castle Inc to upgrade refinery outposts into full starports specifically to improve fleet carrier refuelling access, after customers raised concerns that large ships such as Anacondas, Corvettes, and Clippers could not dock with refinery outposts to take on Tritium fuel. The construction initiative expanded refuelling infrastructure across ten systems, with new Orbis and Coriolis stations operational by October 3306. Tritium mining and transport became a major economic activity, with Torval-Mastopolos Mining and other extraction companies running large-scale campaigns to supply the growing demand from fleet carrier owners.

full-spectrum-system-scanner.name: Full Spectrum System Scanner
full-spectrum-system-scanner.bio: Full Spectrum System Scanner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3308-09-05 to 3308-09-30. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Universal Cartographics, Eva Llewellyn. Independent explorers report an unexplained reddish-orange flare near Barnard's Loop that produces strange FSS scanner feedback, with no official scientific explanation yet.
full-spectrum-system-scanner.bio_full:
The Full Spectrum System Scanner represents a revolutionary advancement in deep-space exploration technology, developed through collaboration between the Pilots Federation and Universal Cartographics. Unlike previous generations of system scanners that detected only the most prominent stellar bodies, the FSS generates detailed frequency analyses capable of identifying planets, rings, resource concentrations, and anomalous signals across entire star systems from a single vantage point. This capability transformed exploration from a painstaking planet-by-planet process into a systematic survey methodology accessible to independent pilots.

In late 3308, explorers using the FSS reported an unexplained reddish-orange flare near Barnard's Loop that produced strange scanner feedback with no official scientific explanation. Researcher Eva Llewellyn was among those investigating the phenomenon, which generated significant interest within the exploration community. The incident demonstrated both the scanner's sensitivity to previously unobservable phenomena and the ongoing capacity of the galaxy to surprise even its most experienced observers, reinforcing the value of distributing advanced survey technology across the independent pilot network.

sco-enabled-frame-shift-drives.name: SCO enabled frame shift drives
sco-enabled-frame-shift-drives.bio: SCO enabled frame shift drives is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-04-24 to 3311-04-24. Developed or used by Taron Raines, Faulcon DeLacy.

diso-ma-corn.name: Diso Ma Corn
diso-ma-corn.bio: Diso Ma Corn is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-11 to 3301-05-11. Developed or used by Broker Mrozak, Broker Del Boy, Alliance. The Green Party of Diso's rejuvenation project for Birmingham succeeded spectacularly when 5,187 commanders delivered over 15 million tonnes of machinery in just 65 hours. An increased supply of Diso Ma Corn has been released to markets aboard Shifnalport to stimulate the Old World sector economy.

suspended-animation.name: Suspended animation
suspended-animation.bio: Suspended animation is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-19 to 3307-07-19. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Federal Intelligence Agency, Erik Gunnarson.

starflight-one.name: Starflight One
starflight-one.bio: Starflight One is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-26 to 3301-05-26. Developed or used by Maisy Stevenson, Saga Republic Party, Jasmina Halsey. Maisy Stevenson, leader of the Saga Republic Party, stated that Starflight One failed to arrive 38 hours prior and that Mars claimed the President took a last-minute detour.

tantalum.name: tantalum
tantalum.bio: tantalum is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-21 to 3302-07-28. Developed or used by Jaques.

void-temple.name: Void-temple
void-temple.bio: Void-temple is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-19 to 3307-07-19. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Federal Intelligence Agency, Erik Gunnarson.

testament-megaship.name: Testament megaship
testament-megaship.bio: Testament megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-22 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Pilots Federation. The Pleiades Concordat requests deliveries to support the Far God cult in outfitting missionary megaships. The Testament will spread the faith while the Perdition and Sacrosanct will carry worshippers on a pilgrimage into deep space.

hardpoint-configuration.name: hardpoint configuration
hardpoint-configuration.bio: hardpoint configuration is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-04-08 to 3311-04-08. Developed or used by Ines Allende, Imperial Navy.

thargoid-pulse-neutraliser.name: Thargoid Pulse Neutraliser
thargoid-pulse-neutraliser.bio: Thargoid pulse neutraliser is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-12-29 to 3309-12-29. Developed or used by Aegis, Jade Sanderlyn. Jade Sanderlyn's year-end reflection on the Thargoid war, covering the Maelstrom arrivals, Titan revelations, technological breakthroughs, spire site victories, and the liberation of abductees. An urgent call to all pilots to participate in the final assault on Titan Leigong, the second Thargoid mothership.

adamastor-megaship.name: Adamastor megaship
adamastor-megaship.bio: Adamastor megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-27 to 3307-06-18. Developed or used by Azimuth Biochemicals. Pilots report new contact from 'Salvation' near the Hesperus and Adamastor. Commander Tyler Thorsen describes receiving a request to locate old signal beacons that could help find survivors from the megaship.
adamastor-megaship.bio_full:
The Adamastor was a research megaship owned by Azimuth Biochemicals that vanished in 3111 after what may have been humanity's first recorded encounter with the Thargoids. The vessel reappeared in 3306 when it entered the Chukchan system on autopilot after nearly 200 years of sublight travel, with no sign of its crew.

Investigations revealed that the Adamastor had collected survivors from a planetary survey team in the Musca Dark Region PJ-P b6-1 system who had encountered Thargoid artefacts. The derelict's return triggered a chain of events that would reshape the anti-xeno war: a dormant communications beacon aboard the ship received a mysterious signal from the anonymous figure known as Salvation, leading to the discovery of the Hesperus and ultimately the Proteus research facility. The Adamastor's journey from 3111 to 3306 stands as one of the most remarkable ghost ship stories in galactic history.

guardian-nanite-torpedo.name: Guardian nanite torpedo
guardian-nanite-torpedo.bio: Guardian nanite torpedo is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-02-15 to 3310-10-25. Developed or used by Aegis, Aden Tanner.

mk-ii-sco-enabled-frame-shift-drive.name: Mk II SCO-enabled frame shift drive
mk-ii-sco-enabled-frame-shift-drive.bio: Mk II SCO-enabled frame shift drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-12-02 to 3311-12-16. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson.

communications-beacon.name: Communications beacon
communications-beacon.bio: Communications beacons are devices used to transmit signals across space. In the context of the Hesperus mystery, beacons deployed by the megaship nearly 200 years ago were used by pilots to track down the Proteus and locate the Guardian-Thargoid battlefield.
communications-beacon.bio_full: Communications beacons are signal transmission devices used for navigation, distress calls, and data relay across space. In the Hesperus mystery, beacons deployed by the megaship nearly 200 years ago proved critical to solving the case. Pilots tracked down a series of these ancient beacons following instructions provided by the anonymous Salvation, which led them to the Proteus Anaconda at a Guardian-Thargoid battlefield on Trapezium Sector YU-X c1-2 1a. The beacons' ability to survive for two centuries and still transmit usable data demonstrated remarkable engineering, though their original purpose—whether navigational markers or deliberate clues—remains debated.

hafnium-178.name: Hafnium 178
hafnium-178.bio: Hafnium 178 is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-07 to 3301-05-07. Developed or used by Canonn, Dr. Arcanonn, Federation. Despite tests including exposure to Hafnium 178, the object defies analysis.

prospector-limpet.name: prospector limpet
prospector-limpet.bio: prospector limpet is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3304-12-20 to 3304-12-20. Developed or used by Industrial Mining Guild. Existing tools like scanners and prospector limpets have also been upgraded.

deep-space-probes.name: deep-space probes
deep-space-probes.bio: deep-space probes is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-10-07 to 3302-10-07. Developed or used by Sirius Corporation, Mars High Astrocartography.

caustic-sink-launcher.name: Caustic Sink Launcher
caustic-sink-launcher.bio: Caustic Sink Launcher is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3310-02-29 to 3310-12-12. Used by Aegis. Key developments: An urgent call to all pilots to participate in the assault on Titan Taranis, with Aegis removing material requirements for Thargoid Pulse Neutralis...; An urgent call to all pilots to participate in the final assault on Titan Leigong, the second Thargoid mothership.
caustic-sink-launcher.bio_full:
The Caustic Sink Launcher is an Aegis-developed ship module designed to protect vessels operating within the caustic environments of Thargoid Maelstrom clouds. In February 3309, Aegis launched an initiative to fast-track mass production of the module, with Professor Alba Tesreau announcing that Admiral Aden Tanner had personally tested the prototype.

The module works by channelling the electrochemical reactions within Maelstrom clouds into semi-liquid anodes for ejection, keeping ship hulls intact for considerably longer than unprotected vessels. Production required advanced catalysers, heatsink interlinks, palladium, and caustic tissue samples obtained from generators inside the Maelstroms — materials crowdsourced from independent pilots. Director Ivano Colombera of the Imperial Science Academy noted that the caustic sink launcher would allow more data on the Maelstroms to be gathered, furthering understanding of Thargoid capabilities. The module became one of three key technologies for the Titan assault campaign, alongside the Thargoid Pulse Neutraliser and the Guardian Nanite Torpedo Pylon, and represented Aegis's renewed operational model of collaborative, transparent research directly integrated with the galactic community.

srv.name: SRV
srv.bio: SRV is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3302-06-18 to 3303-06-04. Used by Buckyball Racing Club, Commander Corrigendum, Jeremy Grant. Key developments: The Candy Crew Guild is dominating the midpoint of the Kick The Alien Buckyball race, with Commander Nookie Mr.; Unknown Ships have been observed interacting with barnacles in the Pleiades Sector OI-T c3-7 system, extracting matter with energy beams and causin...
srv.bio_full:
The Surface Reconnaissance Vehicle (SRV) is a planetary rover used for surface exploration, combat and troop support. In December 3307, Vodel officially released the Scorpion, the first new mass-production SRV model in many years, designed specifically for combat operations. The Scorpion's development was accelerated by Vodel's acquisition by Core Dynamics in 3305, which provided significant financial resources to Vodel's engineering teams.

The Scorpion features a two-crew cabin with additional protection, a plasma surge repeater and the proprietary Aculeus missile launcher for engaging shielded and armoured targets. Its raw power provides exceptional torque for handling harsh terrain and steep climbs. The SRV family represents a key technology for planetary operations, with the Scorpion marking a significant advancement in surface combat capabilities for both independent operatives and military forces.

trakmark-tyres.name: TrakMark tyres
trakmark-tyres.bio: TrakMark tyres is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-08-25 to 3302-08-25. Developed or used by Buckyball Racing Club, Alec Turner. The Buckyball Racing Club announced the Total Recall 2 race in the Cernobog system to demonstrate the durability of TrakMark SRV tyres.

polymers.name: Polymers
polymers.bio: Polymers is a technology in Elite Dangerous, mentioned from 3307-04-15 to 3307-06-25. Used by Pilots Federation. Key developments: The Kumo Crew syndicate launches a campaign to construct up to five new Orbis starports in uninhabited systems near key trading regions.; The Kumo Crew's starport construction campaign concludes successfully.
polymers.bio_full:
Polymers are synthetic materials widely used in construction, manufacturing, and shipbuilding across the galaxy. In November 3305, polymers were among the commodities requested by both the Empire and Federation as part of their competing initiatives to provide a new home for the crew of the Golconda generation ship. The materials were delivered to megaships in the Upaniklis system to support the construction of either a planetary settlement or a modern outpost.

The material's versatility makes it essential for everything from habitat sealing to equipment fabrication. The Golconda resettlement effort — which saw millions of tonnes of polymers, CMM composites, titanium, beryllium, and thallium contributed by independent pilots — demonstrated how polymer supply chains could be mobilised for humanitarian purposes. Polymers have also featured in numerous other construction campaigns, including the Kumo Crew's starport building initiative in 3307, where they were used alongside ceramic composites for orbital infrastructure.

guardian-relic.name: Guardian relic
guardian-relic.bio: Guardian relic is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-22 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation. Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launch rival Guardian artefact collection campaigns in PMD2009 48. Aegis launches an appeal for Guardian artefacts to support a new anti-xeno research programme.
guardian-relic.bio_full:
Guardian relics comprise a broad category of objects recovered from archaeological sites left by the ancient Guardian civilisation, which achieved remarkable technological and cultural sophistication before its mysterious disappearance millions of years ago. These artefacts, which include orbs, urns, totems, caskets, and tablets, vary widely in form and apparent function, offering tantalising glimpses into a species that developed interstellar capability long before humanity. Their study has driven major research programmes across scientific, military, and corporate institutions seeking to understand both Guardian history and the practical applications of their technology.

During mid-3307, Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launched competing campaigns to collect Guardian relics from sites in the PMD2009 48 system. Aegis specifically sought these objects to support a new anti-xeno research programme aimed at developing countermeasures against Thargoid aggression. The rival collection efforts highlighted both the scientific value of Guardian materials and the intense competition among human organisations to unlock their secrets, as conventional approaches to the alien threat proved increasingly inadequate and the pressure for breakthrough solutions mounted.

beluga-luxury-liner.name: Beluga luxury liner
beluga-luxury-liner.bio: Beluga luxury liner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-11-26 to 3302-11-26. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Commander Duck of Death, Elite Travel Writers' Cooperative.

type-10-defender.name: Type-10 Defender
type-10-defender.bio: Type-10 Defender is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-12-17 to 3303-12-22. Developed or used by Lakon Spaceways, Alliance. The Alliance has commissioned Lakon Spaceways to produce the Type-10 Defender, a comprehensive revision of the Type-9 Heavy, in response to recent Thargoid attacks in the Pleiades. Lakon Spaceways has announced that the Type-10 Defender is now available to the public.

gutamaya-discovery-scanner.name: Gutamaya discovery scanner
gutamaya-discovery-scanner.bio: Gutamaya discovery scanner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-17 to 3301-05-17. Developed or used by Cuthrick Delaney, Kahina Tijani Loren, Dr. Walden. Her ship has received significant modifications including a state-of-the-art fuel scoop and a custom Gutamaya discovery scanner.

lakon-type-6e.name: Lakon Type-6E
lakon-type-6e.bio: Lakon Type-6E is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-11-26 to 3302-11-26. Developed or used by Institute for Galactic Exploration and Research, Commander Mad Billy.

sacrosanct-megaship.name: Sacrosanct megaship
sacrosanct-megaship.bio: Sacrosanct megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-22 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Pilots Federation. The Pleiades Concordat requests deliveries to support the Far God cult in outfitting missionary megaships. The Testament will spread the faith while the Perdition and Sacrosanct will carry worshippers on a pilgrimage into deep space.

water-purifiers.name: Water purifiers
water-purifiers.bio: Water Purifiers is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-08 to 3301-05-08. Developed or used by Kavanagh Spaceframes Ltd. The party placed orders for 15 million tonnes of machinery including Atmospheric Processors, Crop Harvesters, Power Generators and Water Purifiers.

system-colonisation-module.name: System Colonisation Module
system-colonisation-module.bio: System Colonisation Module is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-02-26 to 3311-02-26. Developed or used by Madelyn Teague, Brewer Corporation.

cobra-mk-iii.name: Cobra Mk III
cobra-mk-iii.bio: The Cobra Mk III is a classic multipurpose spacecraft manufactured by Faulcon DeLacy, renowned for its versatility and enduring popularity among independent pilots. An antique Cobra Mk III interred at the Tionisla Orbital Graveyard in 3302 became the subject of a mysterious encrypted transmission that attracted inter-superpower intelligence interest.
cobra-mk-iii.bio_full:
The Cobra Mk III has remained one of the most widely flown ships in the galaxy for decades, prized by traders, explorers, and combat pilots alike for its balanced performance characteristics and extensive customisation options. Its iconic status has made it a staple of independent operations across all three superpowers, and it continues to serve as a reliable workhorse for commanders of all experience levels.

In August 3302, an antique Cobra Mk III with the unusual hull registry "Cor meum et animam" was interred at the Tionisla Orbital Graveyard, where its onboard beacon briefly transmitted the repeating sequence "OTSEAFOTSEAF" before failing. Amateur groups later partially decrypted the signal, revealing a string of numbers of unknown significance, while Alliance, Empire, and Federation intelligence services investigated the message. The incident added to the catalogue of unexplained deep-space anomalies that continue to intrigue the galactic community.

cmm-composites.name: CMM composites
cmm-composites.bio: CMM composites are a high-grade construction material essential for building large-scale spacecraft and military vessels, most prominently used in Imperial Majestic-class Interdictors. They have also been requested for Aegis anti-Thargoid development initiatives, establishing them as a critical dual-use resource in both conventional and xeno-defence shipbuilding.
cmm-composites.bio_full:
CMM composites are a high-grade construction material essential for building large-scale spacecraft and military vessels, most prominently used in the construction of Imperial Majestic-class Interdictors. In July 3302, Lavigny's Legion launched a campaign to build three new Interdictors for the Imperial fleet, placing open orders for thallium, thermal cooling units, and CMM composites at Marker Depot in the Carthage system. Scores of independent pilots responded, delivering the materials needed to expand the Empire's capital ship force.

The material's strategic importance extended beyond Imperial shipbuilding. In September 3303, Aegis listed CMM composites among the resources required for its second anti-Thargoid development initiative, alongside tantalum and Thargoid tissue samples. This dual use — supporting both conventional military expansion and experimental xeno-defence research — established CMM composites as a critical industrial resource whose availability could determine the pace of humanity's military preparedness.

sco-drive.name: SCO drive
sco-drive.bio: SCO drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-05-09 to 3310-06-20. Developed or used by Achilles Aerospace, Faulcon DeLacy, Namin Tirel. Achilles Aerospace releases the full range of Supercruise Overcharge drives and upgrades, with Dr. Namin Tirel revealing the technology was developed using Thargoid drive components recovered by independent pilots.

titan-cocijo.name: Titan Cocijo
titan-cocijo.bio: Titan Cocijo is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-05 to 3311-06-18. Developed or used by Aegis, Federal Navy. The wreckage of Titan Cocijo above Earth became a popular destination for pilots seeking trophies, knowledge, and memorials, with Federal authorities struggling to enforce visitor limits. A memorial beacon near the Titan Cocijo wreckage draws visitors, while Commodore Morayo Orina honours the lost at a Sol memorial service.
titan-cocijo.bio_full:
Titan Cocijo was one of the massive Thargoid bio-mechanical vessels that spearheaded the alien invasion of the 3310s, serving as both a mobile base of operations and a weapon of unprecedented destructive capability. These Titans represented the apex of Thargoid engineering, combining organic growth patterns with integrated technology to create self-sustaining warships capable of deploying vast numbers of smaller craft. Their appearance above human worlds marked the most severe escalation in the centuries-long conflict between humanity and the Thargoids.

Following its destruction, the wreckage of Titan Cocijo settled into orbit above Earth, becoming an unintended monument to both the devastation of the invasion and humanity's eventual capacity to resist it. Federal authorities struggled to enforce visitor limits as pilots flocked to the site seeking trophies, scientific knowledge, and personal memorials. Commodore Morayo Orina later presided over a formal memorial service at a beacon near the wreckage, honouring those lost in the battles that brought the Titan down and acknowledging the complex emotions the site evoked for a species that had faced extinction.

mk-ii-class-passenger-cabins.name: Mk II Class Passenger Cabins
mk-ii-class-passenger-cabins.bio: Mk II Class Passenger Cabins is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3312-04-28 to 3312-04-28. Developed or used by Zorgon Peterson. Zorgon Peterson releases the Lynx Highliner, a dedicated passenger vessel with record capacity, defensive hardpoints, and supercharged FSD.

imperial-courier.name: Imperial Courier
imperial-courier.bio: Imperial Courier is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-08-06 to 3301-08-06. Developed or used by Gutamaya Shipyards, Imperial Navy. Gutamaya Shipyards has reinstated default rank-related restrictions on the Imperial Clipper and Imperial Courier following the Emperor's assassination. Last month, the restrictions were temporarily lifted allowing any pilot with active Imperial Navy rank to purchase the vessels.

pulse-wave-xeno-scanner.name: pulse wave xeno scanner
pulse-wave-xeno-scanner.bio: pulse wave xeno scanner is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-10-05 to 3309-12-29. Developed or used by Aegis, Aden Tanner.
pulse-wave-xeno-scanner.bio_full:
The pulse wave xeno scanner represents a specialised detection technology developed by Aegis to identify and analyse Thargoid biological and technological signatures within operational environments. Unlike general-purpose scanners designed for stellar cartography or mineral prospecting, this device emits calibrated energy pulses that interact with Thargoid materials to reveal structural weaknesses, organic vulnerabilities, and technological subsystems. Its development required reverse-engineering principles from recovered alien artefacts combined with conventional sensor engineering expertise.

Aegis deployed these scanners during the intensifying conflict of late 3309, with Admiral Aden Tanner overseeing their integration into anti-xeno operations. The technology proved essential for pilots engaging Thargoid vessels and installations, providing tactical intelligence that conventional scanning equipment could not generate. The pulse wave xeno scanner exemplified how humanity's military-technological response to the Thargoid threat evolved through adaptive innovation, transforming captured alien knowledge into practical tools that independent pilots could deploy against a technologically superior adversary.

ammonia-atmosphere.name: Ammonia atmosphere
ammonia-atmosphere.bio: Ammonia atmosphere is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-19 to 3307-07-19. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Federal Intelligence Agency.

knowledge-core.name: Knowledge Core
knowledge-core.bio: Knowledge Core is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-09 to 3307-07-09. Developed or used by Scriveners Clan, Pilots Federation.

pulsar-fsd-boost.name: Pulsar-FSD boost
pulsar-fsd-boost.bio: Pulsar-FSD boost is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-10-21 to 3302-10-21. Developed or used by Commander Parabolus.

capital-ships.name: capital ships
capital-ships.bio: capital ships is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-28 to 3303-10-28. Developed or used by Aden Tanner, Aegis.

guardian-totem.name: Guardian totem
guardian-totem.bio: Guardian totem is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-22 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation. Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launch rival Guardian artefact collection campaigns in PMD2009 48. Aegis launches an appeal for Guardian artefacts to support a new anti-xeno research programme.
guardian-totem.bio_full:
Guardian totems constitute a category of artefacts left behind by the ancient Guardian civilisation, which thrived millions of years before human spaceflight before mysteriously vanishing. These objects, along with other Guardian relics, represent some of the most significant archaeological discoveries in human history, offering tantalising glimpses into a species that achieved technological sophistication comparable to or exceeding contemporary human capabilities. Their recovery and study have driven major research programmes across multiple scientific and military institutions.

During mid-3307, Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launched competing campaigns to collect Guardian artefacts, including totems, from sites in the PMD2009 48 system. Aegis specifically sought these objects to support a new anti-xeno research programme aimed at developing weapons and defensive technologies capable of countering Thargoid aggression. The rival collection efforts highlighted both the scientific value of Guardian technology and the strategic urgency of unlocking its secrets, as humanity confronted an alien adversary that conventional weaponry struggled to defeat.

guardian-tablet.name: Guardian tablet
guardian-tablet.bio: Guardian tablet is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-22 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation. Aegis and Taurus Mining Ventures launch rival Guardian artefact collection campaigns in PMD2009 48. Aegis launches an appeal for Guardian artefacts to support a new anti-xeno research programme.

abrasion-blaster.name: abrasion blaster
abrasion-blaster.bio: abrasion blaster is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3304-12-20 to 3304-12-20. Developed or used by Industrial Mining Guild. New tools include abrasion blasters for surface deposits, sub-surface displacement missiles for deeper deposits, and seismic charges for cracking rare asteroids open.

palladium.name: palladium
palladium.bio: palladium is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-11-04 to 3301-11-04. Developed or used by Explorers' Association.

supercruise-overcharge-capable-frame-shi.name: Supercruise Overcharge capable Frame Shift Drive
supercruise-overcharge-capable-frame-shi.bio: Supercruise Overcharge capable Frame Shift Drive is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-06-20 to 3310-06-20. Developed or used by Engineers. Achilles Aerospace's Alioth facility producing SCO frame shift drives is attacked by unidentified saboteurs posing as engineers, with no survivors and no impact on manufacturing.

mycoid-fungus.name: mycoid fungus
mycoid-fungus.bio: mycoid fungus is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-10-19 to 3303-10-19. Developed or used by Intergalactic Naval Reserve Arm, Nestor Cartesius. Further abandoned INRA outposts have been discovered, revealing that the mycoid fungus was an unplanned by-product of research and was tested on living Thargoid specimens.

rescue-ship-bertschinger.name: Rescue Ship Bertschinger
rescue-ship-bertschinger.bio: Rescue Ship Bertschinger is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3310-12-06 to 3310-12-06. Developed or used by Wolf 359. Seven of eight rescue megaships deployed near Sol are destroyed by Thargoid forces within minutes of arrival, leaving only Rescue Ship Hutner and Rescue Ship Cornwallis to continue evacuation efforts.

large-mining-hardpoint.name: Large Mining Hardpoint
large-mining-hardpoint.bio: Large Mining Hardpoint is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-09-29 to 3311-10-13. Developed or used by Lakon Spaceways, Alioth Independents. Lakon Spaceways declared the Type-11 Prospector mining trials a success after pilots reported unprecedented fragment yields, and announced a permanent 8% boost to the Squadron mining perk.

kestrel.name: Kestrel
kestrel.bio: The Kestrel is a dedicated small combat fighter developed by Core Dynamics under CEO Owen McKenna. Unveiled in February 3312 as a limited-release successor to the Eagle Mk II, it features three Mk II large hardpoints, Size 5 thrusters, supercharged Frame Shift Drive capability, and compatibility with the Mk II Plasma Shock Accelerator. Following successful field trials, the Kestrel received full distribution approval in June 3312 and entered standard shipyard inventories across the core systems.
kestrel.bio_full: The Kestrel is a dedicated small combat fighter developed by Core Dynamics under CEO Owen McKenna. Unveiled in February 3312 as a limited-release successor to the Eagle Mk II, it features three Mk II large hardpoints, Size 5 thrusters, supercharged Frame Shift Drive capability, and compatibility with the Mk II Plasma Shock Accelerator. Following successful field trials, the Kestrel received full distribution approval in June 3312 and entered standard shipyard inventories across the core systems.

weapons.name: weapons
weapons.bio: weapons is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3303-01-11 to 3303-01-11. Developed or used by Independent engineers.

signal-beacon.name: Signal beacon
signal-beacon.bio: Signal beacons are devices that emit electromagnetic signals for detection and location. In the Hesperus mystery, Salvation directed pilots to track ancient signal beacons deployed by the megaship, which ultimately led to the discovery of the Proteus at a Guardian-Thargoid battlefield.
signal-beacon.bio_full: Signal beacons are electromagnetic transmission devices used to mark locations, relay information, or guide navigation. In the context of the Hesperus mystery, ancient signal beacons deployed by the megaship nearly 200 years ago became the key to unlocking the case. The anonymous figure Salvation provided instructions that allowed pilots to track these beacons across systems, following a trail that ultimately led to the discovery of the Proteus Anaconda at a Guardian-Thargoid battlefield. The beacons demonstrated remarkable longevity, continuing to transmit after two centuries of exposure to space, and their sequential deployment suggested a deliberate effort to document the Hesperus's final voyage.

onionhead-beta-strain.name: Onionhead beta strain
onionhead-beta-strain.bio: Onionhead beta strain is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-12 to 3307-07-12. Developed or used by Scythe of Panem, Vox Galactica, Kumo Crew.

perdition-megaship.name: Perdition megaship
perdition-megaship.bio: Perdition megaship is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-22 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Pleiades Concordat, Pilots Federation. The Pleiades Concordat requests deliveries to support the Far God cult in outfitting missionary megaships. The Testament will spread the faith while the Perdition and Sacrosanct will carry worshippers on a pilgrimage into deep space.

lakon-spaceways-asp.name: Lakon Spaceways Asp
lakon-spaceways-asp.bio: Lakon Spaceways Asp is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3301-05-22 to 3301-05-22. Developed or used by Commander Alot, Buckyball Run, Commander Kligg. His first record was set in a Lakon Spaceways Asp named 'Big Bird'; his current record was achieved in a Faulcon DeLacy Anaconda named 'Rhonda'.

federal-battlecruiser.name: Federal battlecruiser
federal-battlecruiser.bio: Federal battlecruiser is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3302-07-13 to 3302-07-13. Developed or used by Empire, Admiral Denton Patreus, Zemina Torval. Following Senator Zemina Torval's criticism of the Federal blockade in Merope, Admiral Denton Patreus announced that an Imperial fleet will be dispatched to the system under his personal command. Patreus did not clarify whether the fleet would engage Federal forces or establish a counter-blockade.

decontamination-limpet.name: Decontamination Limpet
decontamination-limpet.bio: Decontamination Limpet is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3304-01-13 to 3304-01-13. Developed or used by Aegis. Aegis has released the decontamination limpet, a new device designed to counter the caustic properties of Thargoid enzyme missiles.

black-market.name: Black market
black-market.bio: Black market is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-04-30 to 3307-04-30. Developed or used by Archon Delaine, Kumo Crew, Kay Volantyne. Arch-Corsair Kay Volantyne claims they encourage legitimate trade, though neighbouring systems fear black market activity.

caustic-enzyme-bomb.name: Caustic enzyme bomb
caustic-enzyme-bomb.bio: Caustic enzyme bomb is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-07-29 to 3307-07-29. Developed or used by Verity Dexter, Theta Seven, Marlinism Reformation Party. The NMLA bombs Stillman Hub in HIP 22550 and Tilman Point in Hyades Sector RO-P b6-6, killing tens of thousands.

muon-imager.name: Muon imager
muon-imager.bio: Muon imager is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3307-06-17 to 3307-06-24. Developed or used by Pilots Federation, Sinclair Faraldo.

trailblazer-fleet-megaships.name: Trailblazer fleet megaships
trailblazer-fleet-megaships.bio: Trailblazer fleet megaships is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3311-04-30 to 3311-04-30. Developed or used by Federal Times, Brewer Corporation, Irene Ralston.

banshee-drone.name: Banshee drone
banshee-drone.bio: Banshee drone is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-10-31 to 3309-10-31. Developed or used by Maximo Fonseca, Ishmael Palin.

biological-contaminant.name: biological contaminant
biological-contaminant.bio: biological contaminant is a technology in the Elite Dangerous universe, mentioned from 3309-11-10 to 3309-12-07. Developed or used by Ishmael Palin, Aegis, Maximo Fonseca. Professor Palin's biological contaminant successfully halts Thargoid spire site operations in the Hyades Sector ST-Q B5-5 system, confirming a vulnerability in Thargoid infrastructure. Palin discovers genetic commonalities between spire compounds and Titan hull fragments, synthesising a biological contaminant to disrupt spire processing chains.
biological-contaminant.bio_full:
The biological contaminant developed by Professor Ishmael Palin represents a groundbreaking application of xenobiological research to military purposes, designed specifically to disrupt Thargoid infrastructure by exploiting genetic vulnerabilities in their organic-technological systems. Palin's research identified common genetic markers between compounds found in Thargoid spire sites and fragments recovered from Titan hulls, revealing underlying biological commonalities that could be targeted.
